About the role

PT Diamulia Internusa is seeking a talented and creative Content Creator to join our dynamic team in South Tangerang, Banten. This is a full-time position that plays a vital role in shaping our brand's digital presence and engaging our audience across multiple platforms. As a Content Creator, you will be responsible for conceptualising, producing, and distributing compelling content that resonates with our target audience, drives engagement, and supports our business objectives. This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on our company's growth and visibility in the competitive advertising, arts and media landscape.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop creative concepts and ideas for content across various digital platforms including social media, blogs, video, and other multimedia channels

  • Produce high-quality written content including articles, captions, scripts, and promotional materials tailored to different audience segments

  • Create, edit, and optimise visual and video content to ensure maximum engagement and brand consistency

  • Research trending topics, industry news, and competitor content to inform content strategy and maintain relevance

  • Collaborate with marketing, design, and editorial teams to align content with broader campaign objectives and brand guidelines

  • Manage content calendars and ensure timely delivery of content across all platforms

  • Monitor content performance metrics, gather audience insights, and adjust content strategy based on analytics and feedback

  • Engage with audience members through comments, messages, and community management activities

  • Stay informed about emerging content trends, platform algorithms, and best practices in digital media

  • Support the development and maintenance of brand voice and editorial standards across all content


What we're looking for

  • Proven experience as a Content Creator, Digital Content Specialist, or similar role within the advertising, media, or publishing industry

  • Strong writing skills with excellent grammar, clarity, and the ability to adapt tone and style for different platforms and audiences

  • Proficiency in content creation tools and software, including video editing, graphic design, and social media management platforms

  • Demonstrated ability to develop engaging content ideas and execute them across multiple digital channels

  • Knowledge of social media platforms, content distribution strategies, and digital marketing principles

  • Strong analytical skills with experience using analytics tools to measure content performance and inform strategy

  • Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities with a keen eye for visual aesthetics and user experience

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams

  • Time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Media Studies, or a related field is preferred

  • Portfolio demonstrating previous content creation work across different formats and platforms


What we offer

At PT Diamulia Internusa, we are committed to supporting the professional growth and wellbeing of our team members. We offer competitive compensation packages, opportunities for career development, and the chance to work on creative projects that make a real impact. We foster a collaborative and innovative work environment where your ideas are valued and your contributions are recognised. As a full-time employee, you will benefit from a supportive company culture that prioritises both professional achievement and work-life balance. We encourage our team members to continuously develop their skills and explore new creative possibilities within the dynamic advertising and media sector.

About us

PT Diamulia Internusa is a leading organisation in the advertising, arts and media industry, committed to delivering innovative creative solutions and high-quality content that captures audiences and drives results. We specialise in editing and publishing services, working with clients to develop engaging narratives and compelling materials across multiple formats. Our team is passionate about creativity, excellence, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible in digital media. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative culture where creative talent thrives, innovative ideas are celebrated, and every team member has the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects that resonate with audiences and clients alike.

Apply now

If you are a passionate and creative Content Creator ready to make your mark in the advertising and media industry, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter outlining your relevant experience, and links to your portfolio or samples of previous content work. Join PT Diamulia Internusa and help us create content that inspires and engages audiences across the region.

jobs.title: fitness consultant
jobs.description: Seorang Fitness Consultant adalah profesional di bidang kebugaran yang bertugas membantu klien mencapai tujuan kesehatan dan kebugaran mereka melalui program latihan yang terarah dan personal. Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab: Melakukan konsultasi awal dengan member untuk mengetahui tujuan (penurunan berat badan, pembentukan otot, kebugaran umum, dll.) Membuat dan menyusun program latihan yang sesuai dengan kondisi dan kebutuhan klien Memberikan arahan teknik latihan yang benar dan aman Memantau perkembangan fisik dan performa member secara berkala Memberikan motivasi dan edukasi mengenai gaya hidup sehat (olahraga, nutrisi, dan recovery) Menjaga hubungan baik dengan member untuk meningkatkan retensi dan kepuasan pelanggan Bekerja sama dengan tim trainer dan manajemen gym untuk meningkatkan kualitas layanan Kualifikasi Umum: Memiliki pengetahuan dasar hingga lanjutan tentang fitness dan latihan beban Komunikatif dan mampu membangun hubungan dengan klien Berorientasi pada target dan pelayanan Disiplin, energik, dan memiliki penampilan profesional Sertifikasi fitness (nilai tambah, bukan wajib di semua tempat) Tujuan Utama: Membantu klien mencapai hasil terbaik secara efektif, aman, dan berkelanjutan dengan pendekatan yang personal dan profesional.

jobs.title: In-House Sales Promoter (SPG)
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari In-House Sales Promoter (SPG) yang energik, profesional, dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim penjualan kami di PT Diamulia Internusa. Sebagai In-House Sales Promoter, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam meningkatkan penjualan produk dan membangun hubungan yang kuat dengan pelanggan di lokasi penjualan kami. Posisi ini memerlukan individu dengan kemampuan komunikasi yang excellent, antusiasme tinggi, dan komitmen untuk mencapai target penjualan. jobs.title: Research and Development Staff  (Skincare & Cosmetic)
jobs.description: PT Her Bayu Inti mencari R&D Formulator untuk bergabung dalam tim pengembangan produk kami. Posisi ini memegang siklus penuh pengembangan formula — dari pencarian dan pengembangan di skala laboratorium, uji stabilitas, hingga scale-up ke produksi massal dan penanganan masalah langsung di lini produksi. Jobdesc: Melakukan seluruh aktivitas riset dan pengembangan formula produk baru yang berkualitas, efektif, efisien, dan sesuai dengan standar perusahaan. Melakukan scale-up formula dari skala laboratorium ke skala produksi massal, termasuk melakukan troubleshooting terhadap permasalahan yang terjadi di lini produksi. Mengikuti perkembangan tren bahan aktif, teknologi formulasi, dan tren pasar untuk memberikan usulan pengembangan dan inovasi produk baru. Melakukan riset dan evaluasi terhadap bahan baku baru dan alternatif yang dapat mendukung pengembangan produk maupun optimasi formula. Memantau dan mengikuti perkembangan peraturan BPOM yang berkaitan dengan produk kosmetik dan pengembangan formula. Bekerja sama dengan tim QA, QC, Produksi, dan departemen terkait untuk memastikan formula dan proses produksi memenuhi persyaratan BPOM, CPKB/GMP, serta standar mutu internal perusahaan. Melakukan dokumentasi dan pelaporan terkait proses pengembangan, trial, evaluasi, dan scale-up formula. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal S1 Farmasi atau Kimia. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Formulator/R&D di industri kosmetik, khususnya skincare dan kosmetik dekoratif. Memiliki pengalaman hands-on dalam formulasi dan pengembangan produk kosmetik. Memiliki pengetahuan mengenai penerapan CPKB, ISO 9001, GMP, dan Sistem Jaminan Halal. Memiliki kemampuan analitis, problem-solving, dan troubleshooting yang baik. Mampu bekerja secara tim dan memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Jujur, teliti, inovatif, dan bertanggung jawab. Bersedia ditempatkan di Bitung, Tangerang.

jobs.title: Sales Supervisor
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Infinix, bagian dari PT Transisi Mobile Indonesia , mencari Sales Supervisor yang cakap dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Cirebon. Dalam peran ini, Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk mengembangkan dan mempertahankan hubungan yang kuat dengan pelanggan kami (Dealer & Pelanggan) , serta secara proaktif mengidentifikasi dan memenuhi kebutuhan produk dan layanan Infinix. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengembangkan dan mengelola portofolio pelanggan yang ditugaskan secara efektif untuk memaksimalkan penjualan dan kepuasan pelanggan. Melakukan prospeksi dan mengidentifikasi peluang penjualan baru dengan pelanggan potensial. Mempertahankan hubungan yang erat dengan pelanggan yang ada untuk mendorong penjualan berulang dan peningkatan volume. Mematuhi target penjualan bulanan dan triwulanan yang ditetapkan serta berkontribusi pada pertumbuhan bisnis secara keseluruhan. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal 1 tahun pengalaman kerja dalam peran SPV penjualan atau hubungan pelanggan di industri teknologi atau smartphone elektronik. Memiliki pengetahuan yang kuat tentang tren dan perkembangan pasar dalam industri perangkat dan aksesori seluler. Kemampuan komunikasi yang unggul, baik lisan maupun tertulis, dengan keterampilan presentasi yang meyakinkan. Kemampuan negosiasi yang baik dan orientasi pada pencapaian target. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Officer
jobs.description: PT Samarinda Central Plaza , salah satu pusat perbelanjaan terkemuka di Samarinda yang saat ini tengah melakukan transformasi peremajaan ( rejuvenation ) mengundang para profesional yang detail oriented dan memiliki intergritas tinggi untuk mengisi posisi Quality Assurance Officer . Kami mencari individu yang tidak hanya mampu mengidentifikasi ketidaksesuaian operasional, tetapi juga mampu menjadi agen perubahan dalam menjaga standar kualitas layanan dan kenyamanan bagi seluruh pengunjung dan tenant kami. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Managemen, Teknik Industri, Administrasi Bisnis, Hospitality Management atau bidang relevan lainnya. Pengalaman kerja minimal 2 tahun di bidang Quality Assurance, Quality Control, atau Operational Compliance (diutamakan dari industri properti/mall/retail). Mampu melakukan audit operasional, inspeksi lapangan dan memahami metode mysteri shopper. Mampu menyusun dan mengevaluasi dokumen SOP. Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Excel untuk analisa data dan pembuatan laporan KPI. Memahami penanganan keluhan (complaint handling), standar operasional Mall (K3, keamanan, parkir, kebersihan, maupun tenant relations) Komunikasi persuasif dan mampu memberikan solusi praktis (problem solving). Familiar degan regulasi yang relevan: perda setempat, SNI, standar BPJS ketenagakerjaan terkait K3. Nilai tambahan bagi yang memiliki sertfikasi ISO 9001 (Internal Auditor). Benefit & Fasilitas Gaji kompetitif. Paket tunjangan kesehatan dan ketenagakerjaan. Peluang pengembangan karier di sektor properti.

jobs.title: Front Office/Hostess
jobs.description: About the role We are seeking a dedicated and professional Front Office professional to join the team at Boy N Cow Seminyak. This is a full-time position based in our Seminyak, Bali location. As Front Office staff, you will be the first point of contact for our guests and play a crucial role in delivering exceptional service experiences. This role is integral to maintaining the high standards of hospitality our guests expect and contributes directly to the overall reputation and success of our establishment. Key responsibilities Greeting guests upon arrival with warmth and professionalism, ensuring a positive first impression Managing the check-in and check-out process efficiently and courteously Responding to guest inquiries and requests promptly and professionally Providing information about our facilities, services, local attractions and dining options Processing reservations and managing the booking system accurately Maintaining guest records and ensuring confidentiality and data security Coordinating with housekeeping and other departments to ensure guest satisfaction Handling guest concerns and complaints with empathy and finding appropriate solutions Managing key cards, room access and security protocols Assisting with concierge services, arranging transportation, tours and dining reservations as needed Maintaining a clean, organised and welcoming reception area Contributing to a positive and collaborative work environment Minimum 1 years experience in same position What we're looking for Previous experien in front office, guest services or a similar hospitality role Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage guests from diverse backgrounds Strong organisational and time management abilities Proficiency with hotel management systems and computer reservations software Fluency in English; additional languages are advantageous Professional appearance and demeanour Ability to remain calm and composed when handling difficult situations A genuine passion for providing outstanding customer service Reliability, punctuality and a strong work ethic Problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team Knowledge of Bali's attractions, restaurants and services is desirable What we offer Boy N Cow Group is committed to creating a supportive and rewarding work environment for our team members. We offer competitive remuneration, opportunities for professional development and training to enhance your skills within the hospitality industry. We foster a culture of teamwork and collaboration where your contributions are valued and recognised. As part of our team, you will have access to employee benefits and the opportunity to work in a dynamic, guest-focused setting that celebrates excellence in service delivery. About us Boy N Cow Seminyak is a boutique hospitality establishment located in the vibrant heart of Seminyak, Bali. We are committed to delivering exceptional guest experiences through personalised service, attention to detail and a genuine commitment to making every visitor's stay memorable. jobs.title: Key Account Specialist (E-Commerce)
jobs.description: Job Responsibilities 1. Responsible for the overall operation of one category of smart wearables, or mobile accessories, and coordinating the operational strategies and pace of the three major platforms: Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop . 2. Independently responsible for the full lifecycle operation of the category, including product selection and testing, large-scale growth, and stable operations, and regularly producing business reviews and next-phase business strategies 3. Conduct weekly market analysis on the platform to identify market gaps in price ranges, product selling points, and content strategies, and form a list of opportunity points; Continuously track competitor trends, anticipate market trends, and develop response strategies. 4. Deeply understand the usage scenarios and needs of local Indonesian users regarding TWS and smart wearable products, transform user pain points into product requirements, and collaborate with headquarters product managers to drive implementation. 5. Responsible for category profit management, including formulating pricing strategies for different stages (measurement period, growth period, stable phase), and reviewing the profit and loss model for individual SKUs 6. Coordinate internal team resources such as operations, influencers/KOLs, platforms, and products to promote major promotions and new product launches; Identify issues promptly and promote escalation when resources are insufficient Job Requirements 1. 1-2years of experience operating e-commerce categories, focused on consumer electronics such as audio, smartwatches/bands, earphones, power banks, or mobile phone accessories is preferred 2. Familiar with the core operational logic of at least two platforms: Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop , with quantifiable category growth cases. 3. Strong data analysis skills, able to break down business issues based on traffic × conversion rate × average transaction value × gross margin framework, identify growth opportunities, and drive execution. 4. Possess the perspective of a category operator, strong product sense , able to distinguish between performance-oriented and brand seeding-based marketing strategies; practical experience in TikTok Shop content e-commerce is preferred 5. English can be used as a working language, supporting daily communication and collaboration between cross-national teams and platform partners At Transsion, you’ll enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package , along with the chance to grow your career in a dynamic, fast-paced international environment.

  • Proactively identify potential clients, generate leads, and build strong relationships

jobs.title: Deputy Director Hospital
jobs.description: Position Overview: The Hospital Deputy Director will assist the Hospital Director/CEO in overseeing the overall operations of the hospital. This role involves strategic planning, staff management, financial oversight, and ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations. The Deputy Director will work collaboratively with department heads to ensure the delivery of high-quality patient care and the efficient operation of the hospital. Key Responsibilities: Operational Management: Assist in the development and implementation of hospital policies and procedures. Ensure effective and efficient hospital operations in alignment with organizational goals. Oversee daily administrative and clinical operations to ensure smooth functioning. Strategic Planning: Contribute to the development of the hospitals strategic plans and initiatives. Analyze healthcare trends and recommend adjustments to hospital strategies. Support the implementation of strategic initiatives to improve patient care and hospital performance. Financial Oversight: Assist in budget preparation and financial management. Monitor financial performance and ensure cost-effective operations. Identify and implement opportunities for revenue enhancement and cost reduction. Staff Management: Supervise and support department heads and other senior staff. Foster a positive and productive work environment. Participate in recruitment, training, and performance evaluation of staff. Quality and Compliance: Ensure the hospital complies with all healthcare regulations and standards. Oversee quality assurance programs to enhance patient care quality and safety. Address and resolve patient care issues and complaints. Community Relations: Represent the hospital in community and professional meetings. Develop and maintain relationships with healthcare partners, stakeholders, and the community. Promote hospital services and programs to enhance community engagement. Emergency Management: Develop and implement emergency preparedness plans. Coordinate response efforts during emergencies to ensure patient and staff safety. Qualifications: Education: Masters degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience: Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive leadership experience in a healthcare setting. Skills: Strong leadership and managerial skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities. Proficiency in financial management and strategic planning. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and quality standards. Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in a large hospital or healthcare system. Proven track record of successful project management and implementation. Familiarity with electronic health records (EHR) systems.

Sebagai Sales Canvassing, kamu akan datang langsung ke toko atau UMKM untuk menawarkan dan memasarkan mesin EDC serta membantu merchant memahami cara penggunaannya. Tanggung Jawab: - Mencari dan mengunjungi UMKM atau merchant secara langsung di area yang sudah ditentukan - Melakukan canvassing/door to door untuk menawarkan mesin EDC - Menjelaskan produk, manfaat, dan cara penggunaan mesin EDC kepada calon merchant - Mengajak merchant untuk menggunakan dan mendaftarkan mesin EDC - Menjaga hubungan baik dengan merchant yang sudah bergabung - Membantu merchant jika mengalami kendala terkait penggunaan produk - Mengejar target penjualan yang sudah ditentukan - Membuat laporan hasil kunjungan dan penjualan Kualifikasi: - Minimal pendidikan SMA/SMK - Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar - Tidak wajib punya pengalaman sales, pengalaman di bidang sales menjadi nilai tambah - Suka bertemu dan berkomunikasi dengan orang baru - Percaya diri untuk menawarkan produk secara langsung - Bersedia bekerja di lapangan dan melakukan kunjungan ke UMKM - Aktif, punya inisiatif, dan tidak mudah menyerah - Terbiasa bekerja dengan target - Bisa bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim Benefit: - Gaji pokok - Allowance pulsa dan transport - BPJS Kesehatan dan Ketenagakerjaan - Training dan kesempatan belajar tentang sales - Kesempatan berkembang dan membangun karier di bidang sales - Lingkungan kerja yang suportif dan kolaboratif Fresh graduate welcome! Kalau kamu suka pekerjaan yang aktif, suka bertemu banyak orang, dan tertantang untuk mencapai target, posisi ini cocok untuk kamu.

jobs.title: Sales Executive
jobs.description: Kemampuan Sales Farmer: Mampu menjaga dan mengembangkan hubungan dengan customer existing. Terbiasa melakukan follow-up customer secara rutin dan terstruktur. Mampu mengidentifikasi kebutuhan customer dan menawarkan produk yang sesuai. Mampu meningkatkan repeat order dan volume pembelian customer. Mampu melakukan pendekatan untuk mendapatkan proyek atau kebutuhan baru dari customer yang sudah ada. Mampu membangun hubungan jangka panjang dengan PIC purchasing, procurement, site manager, project manager, kontraktor, developer, dan owner. Mampu melakukan negosiasi harga dan menjaga margin perusahaan. Mampu menangani komplain customer dengan cepat dan profesional. Mampu menjaga customer agar tidak berpindah ke kompetitor. Memiliki kemampuan upselling dan cross-selling produk Masterblock seperti paving block, grass block, kanstin, dan street inlet

jobs.title: Management System (ISO) Consultant
jobs.description: PT Mitra Berdaya Optima (MBO) We are a consulting firm specializing in consultancy, training, and system development aligned with ISO (International Organization for Standardization) standards. In essence, we help clients implement ISO standards and achieve certification. Based in Yogyakarta, we operate as a B2B business and have successfully assisted over 500 organizations in the past seven years. Management System Associate (ISO Consultant) Responsibilities Advise and guide clients in achieving and maintaining ISO compliance. jobs.title: Sales Akuisisi EDC - Penajam Paser Utara
jobs.description: Kami sedang mencari Sales Canvassing untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Posisi ini cocok untuk kamu yang suka bertemu orang baru, aktif di lapangan, dan tertarik dengan dunia sales. Sebagai Sales Canvassing, kamu akan datang langsung ke toko atau UMKM untuk menawarkan dan memasarkan mesin EDC serta membantu merchant memahami cara penggunaannya. Tanggung Jawab: - Mencari dan mengunjungi UMKM atau merchant secara langsung di area yang sudah ditentukan - Melakukan canvassing/door to door untuk menawarkan mesin EDC - Menjelaskan produk, manfaat, dan cara penggunaan mesin EDC kepada calon merchant - Mengajak merchant untuk menggunakan dan mendaftarkan mesin EDC - Menjaga hubungan baik dengan merchant yang sudah bergabung - Membantu merchant jika mengalami kendala terkait penggunaan produk - Mengejar target penjualan yang sudah ditentukan - Membuat laporan hasil kunjungan dan penjualan Kualifikasi: - Minimal pendidikan SMA/SMK - Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar - Tidak wajib punya pengalaman sales, pengalaman di bidang sales menjadi nilai tambah - Suka bertemu dan berkomunikasi dengan orang baru - Percaya diri untuk menawarkan produk secara langsung - Bersedia bekerja di lapangan dan melakukan kunjungan ke UMKM - Aktif, punya inisiatif, dan tidak mudah menyerah - Terbiasa bekerja dengan target - Bisa bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim Benefit: - Gaji pokok - Allowance pulsa dan transport - BPJS Kesehatan dan Ketenagakerjaan - Training dan kesempatan belajar tentang sales - Kesempatan berkembang dan membangun karier di bidang sales - Lingkungan kerja yang suportif dan kolaboratif Fresh graduate welcome! Kalau kamu suka pekerjaan yang aktif, suka bertemu banyak orang, dan tertantang untuk mencapai target, posisi ini cocok untuk kamu.

jobs.title: Senior TechOps & Release Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Get to Know the Team Our team operates at the intersection of partner experience, platform reliability, and release execution. We manage DevHome and the operational systems that support partner onboarding, access, documentation publishing, and partner-facing product releases across mobile and web surfaces. This team focuses on more than feature development. A large part of our work is making sure critical platforms remain stable, secure, and operationally efficient. That means managing incidents, improving deployment safety, maintaining infrastructure, and building automation that removes manual work from daily operations. As part of the team, you will work closely with various departments, including Engineering, QA, Release Train, PM, BD, Legal, and Operations. Your collaboration will focus on keeping launches moving and ensuring that partner-facing platforms are reliable at scale. Get to Know the Role As a Senior TechOps & Release Automation Engineer (G4), you will lead the operational health and release readiness of DevHome and related partner-facing platforms. This is a hybrid engineering role for someone who enjoys solving operational problems with code, improving reliability, and taking ownership across the full platform lifecycle. You will help keep systems production-safe, supporting partner onboarding and access workflows, managing release execution for Android and iOS, and driving automation across operational processes. You will span application support, infrastructure maintenance, incident response, deployment safety, and internal tooling. You will report to the Tech Support Engineering Manager and onsite in the Jakarta office based. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Manage end-to-end DevHome operations, partner onboarding support, and release execution from intake through post-release verification. Manage Android and iOS release activities, including cutoffs, submissions, phased rollouts, cherry-picks, rollback readiness, and release tracking. Resolve operational escalations related to partner access, login issues, onboarding blockers, scope or configuration requests, and documentation publishing flows. Make safe production changes across Go services, React/Docusaurus surfaces, configurations, secrets, tokens, and developer documentation. Maintain Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure, GitLab runners, CI/CD pipelines, and other reliability-critical operational tooling. Investigate and respond to production incidents using Datadog, Kibana, and system-level troubleshooting to resolve performance, latency, and partner-helping issues. Support infrastructure lifecycle work such as AMI rotation, EC2 and Docklet maintenance, backend scaling, and migration to MEKS. Develop automation, scripts, and internal tools that reduce manual effort across release management, approvals, assessment, and partner operations. Contribute to on-call readiness, RCA follow-ups, SOP improvements, and runbook maintenance. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders and external partners to unblock launches and keep platform operations moving smoothly.

Description

Sebagai Area Manager, posisi ini akan bertanggung jawab atas keseluruhan pengelolaan & monitoring Kantor Point/Cabang meliputi:

  • Memastikan seluruh KPI Cabang di lingkup Area dapat dicapai dengan baik

  • Memastikan kualitas dan kuantitas portofolio berkembang sesuai dengan tujuan dan sasaran yang ditetapkan oleh Amartha

  • Memastikan proses perekrutan, pelayanan dan pendampingan mitra dilakukan sesuai dengan SOP

  • Memastikan strategi, pengelolaan, proses dan operasional seluruh cabang dalam lingkup area yang dibina

  • Memastikan keseluruhan administrasi kantor cabang lengkap dan tertib

  • Memastikan operasional kantor cabang dapat berjalan dengan baik dengan memastikan perizinan, infrastruktur, dan inventaris terpenuhi

  • Memastikan bahwa kebijakan dan prosedur secara ketat ditaati oleh semua staf di kantor cabang

  • Memastikan seluruh staf memberikan kinerja terbaik dengan memperoleh training, pemantauan kinerja dan pengelolaan konflik

 

Requirements

  • Pendidikan terakhir minimum Sarjana

  • Memiliki pengalaman bertanggung jawab dalam memimpin minimal 2 Cabang

  • Berpengalaman memimpin lebih dari 15 anggota di Micro Finance sebagai Koordinator/Supervisor/Kepala Cabang/Area Manager

  • Dapat menyusun strategi sales & marketing sebagai paduan tim untuk mencapai target

  • Mempunyai motor dan SIM C

  • Bersedia mobile ke cabang kelolaan yaitu Cigeulis, Cipeucang, Cimanggu, Labuan , Menes, Panimbang

Kemampuan yang Dibutuhkan:

  • Disiplin Tinggi (berintegritas, jujur & transparan)

  • Memiliki kekuatan komunikasi & berkolaborasi dengan tim

  • Memiliki semangat belajar yg tinggi terutama untuk menganalisa informasi dan data

  • Mudah beradaptasi pada perubahan dan berorientasi pada target

  • Mampu membangun budaya coaching untuk meningkatkan performa tim

jobs.title: Sales Akuisisi EDC - Bulungan
jobs.description: Kami sedang mencari Sales Canvassing untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Posisi ini cocok untuk kamu yang suka bertemu orang baru, aktif di lapangan, dan tertarik dengan dunia sales. Sebagai Sales Canvassing, kamu akan datang langsung ke toko atau UMKM untuk menawarkan dan memasarkan mesin EDC serta membantu merchant memahami cara penggunaannya. Tanggung Jawab: - Mencari dan mengunjungi UMKM atau merchant secara langsung di area yang sudah ditentukan - Melakukan canvassing/door to door untuk menawarkan mesin EDC - Menjelaskan produk, manfaat, dan cara penggunaan mesin EDC kepada calon merchant - Mengajak merchant untuk menggunakan dan mendaftarkan mesin EDC - Menjaga hubungan baik dengan merchant yang sudah bergabung - Membantu merchant jika mengalami kendala terkait penggunaan produk - Mengejar target penjualan yang sudah ditentukan - Membuat laporan hasil kunjungan dan penjualan Kualifikasi: - Minimal pendidikan SMA/SMK - Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar - Tidak wajib punya pengalaman sales, pengalaman di bidang sales menjadi nilai tambah - Suka bertemu dan berkomunikasi dengan orang baru - Percaya diri untuk menawarkan produk secara langsung - Bersedia bekerja di lapangan dan melakukan kunjungan ke UMKM - Aktif, punya inisiatif, dan tidak mudah menyerah - Terbiasa bekerja dengan target - Bisa bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim Benefit: - Gaji pokok - Allowance pulsa dan transport - BPJS Kesehatan dan Ketenagakerjaan - Training dan kesempatan belajar tentang sales - Kesempatan berkembang dan membangun karier di bidang sales - Lingkungan kerja yang suportif dan kolaboratif Fresh graduate welcome! Kalau kamu suka pekerjaan yang aktif, suka bertemu banyak orang, dan tertantang untuk mencapai target, posisi ini cocok untuk kamu.

assessment, and incident response Capability in load/demand management, energy performance analysis, reliability, and maintenance management Proven experience leading technical teams and supervising contractors/service providers and managing stakeholders

  • Control and supervise all activities within the IKIP Project related to energy utilization, including tenant connections, metering, and external contractor activities, ensuring full compliance and providing management with corrective-action reports

  • Manage energy performance by conducting daily monitoring, documenting operational data, and reviewing KPIs (consumption, power quality, losses, and operating costs)

  • Formulate data-driven recommendations for asset improvement and technical risk mitigation

  • Develop strategic work plans encompassing team capacity building, daily workflow monitoring, OHS protocol enforcement, and emergency/outage response protocols

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering

  • 7 years of professional experience in electrical system maintenance or the energy sector

  • Certifications in Energy Management, SMK2, AK3 Umum, and AK3 Listrik

  • Strong understanding of power generation components, electrical occupational health and safety (OHS), and electrical measurement instruments

  • Experience in industrial estates, mining, mineral processing, heavy industry, utilities, and/or remote-site operations

  • Practical exposure to power distribution, substations/transformers, protection systems, metering, backup supply/generation, and maintenance planning

  • Competency certification in electrical operation and maintenance

  • Strong knowledge of electrical safety, permit to work, LOTO, switching/isolation, risk assessment, and incident response

  • Capability in load/demand management, energy performance analysis, reliability, and maintenance management

  • Proven experience leading technical teams and supervising contractors/service providers and managing stakeholders

jobs.title: Operator Mesin
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Operator Mesin yang berpengalaman dan bertanggung jawab untuk bergabung dengan tim produksi PT Cipta Arta Plasindo. Sebagai Operator Mesin, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam memastikan proses produksi berjalan dengan lancar dan efisien di fasilitas manufaktur kami di Cakung, Jakarta. Posisi ini adalah pekerjaan waktu penuh yang menuntut keahlian teknis, perhatian terhadap detail, dan komitmen terhadap keselamatan dan kualitas. Anda akan bertanggung jawab mengoperasikan mesin produksi dengan presisi tinggi dan memastikan semua standar operasional terpenuhi. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengoperasikan mesin produksi sesuai dengan spesifikasi dan standar operasional yang telah ditetapkan. Memantau kinerja mesin secara real-time untuk memastikan output berkualitas tinggi dan meminimalkan waktu henti. Melakukan pemeriksaan rutin pada mesin termasuk pengecekan suhu, tekanan, dan parameter operasional lainnya. Melakukan perawatan mesin dasar seperti pelumasan, pembersihan, dan penggantian suku cadang sederhana sesuai prosedur yang ditetapkan. Menangani bahan baku dengan hati-hati untuk memastikan tidak ada pemborosan dan menjaga standar kebersihan area kerja. Melaporkan masalah teknis atau kerusakan mesin kepada supervisor atau tim pemeliharaan dengan segera. Mematuhi semua protokol keselamatan kerja dan menggunakan peralatan pelindung diri dengan benar. Mencatat data produksi harian dan menyelesaikan laporan sesuai persyaratan perusahaan. Berkontribusi pada inisiatif peningkatan kualitas dan efisiensi produksi dalam tim. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Diploma atau Sertifikat dari Sekolah Menengah Kejuruan (SMK) di bidang Teknik Mesin atau bidang terkait. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman sebagai Operator Mesin di industri manufaktur atau pabrik. Pemahaman mendalam tentang prinsip operasional mesin dan kemampuan untuk membaca serta mengikuti instruksi teknis. Keterampilan dalam melakukan pemeliharaan dasar mesin dan troubleshooting masalah operasional sederhana.

jobs.title: Credit Analyst (CA) - Jakarta
jobs.description: Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Semua Jurusan, jurusan Ekonomi/Akuntansi menjadi nilai tambah Terbuka untuk fresh graduate maupun yang sudah memiliki pengalaman kerja Memiliki kemampuan analisa kredit yang baik dan mengetahui konsep 5C Memiliki integritas dan loyalitas yang tinggi serta mau bekerja keras dan memiliki ketelitian yang baik Mampu melakukan analisa kelayakan debitur menggunakan metode 5C, 1P dan SUB (Siapa, Untuk Apa dan Bagaimana) Berdomisili dan bersedia ditempatkan di Jakarta. Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Mampu melakukan analisa kelayakan debitur menggunakan metode 5C, 1P dan SUB (Siapa, Untuk Apa dan Bagaimana). Memberikan pandangan dan latar belakang calon debitur kepada komite kredit secara komprehensif. Memverifikasi dan menganalisa dokumen persyaratan kredit yang dilampirkan oleh calon debitur. Memberikan concern atau rekomendasi atas permohonan pembiayaan yang diajukan oleh calon debitur. Memastikan bahwa syarat dan ketentuan pembiayaan telah sesuai dengan ketentuan atau program pembiayaan yang berlaku. Memastikan kebijakan mengenai ketentuan kredit dijalankan dan konsisten. Mengidentifikasi potensi resiko dari setiap pengajuan kredit. Bertanggung Jawab terhadap First Installment Default (FID) atas hasil analisa yang dilakukan. PT Maybank Indonesia Finance tidak pernah memungut biaya apapun dalam proses seleksi karyawan.

jobs.title: waiters
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Waiter berpengalaman dan profesional untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Le ezmod Pizza', sebuah restoran pizza berkualitas yang terletak di Surabaya, Jawa Timur. Sebagai Waiter, Anda akan menjadi wajah perusahaan kami yang melayani pelanggan dengan dedikasi, keahlian, dan keramahan. Posisi ini memerlukan kemampuan untuk memberikan layanan pelanggan yang luar biasa, menangani pesanan dengan akurat, dan memastikan setiap tamu mendapatkan pengalaman bersantap yang berkesan. Ini adalah posisi pekerjaan penuh waktu yang berbasis di lokasi Surabaya kami, memberikan kesempatan untuk berkembang dalam industri perhotelan dan pariwisata. Tanggung Jawab Utama Menyambut dan melayani pelanggan dengan ramah, profesional, dan penuh perhatian di setiap kunjungan mereka ke restoran. Mengambil pesanan makanan dan minuman dengan akurat dan mencatat preferensi khusus atau kebutuhan diet pelanggan. Mengantar pesanan ke meja dengan presentasi yang baik dan memastikan makanan dan minuman disajikan pada waktu yang tepat. Memberikan rekomendasi menu yang tepat berdasarkan preferensi dan kebutuhan pelanggan untuk meningkatkan kepuasan. Memelihara standar kebersihan dan ketertiban area layanan termasuk meja, peralatan, dan area sekitarnya. Menangani pembayaran dengan akurat, memproses transaksi, dan memberikan kembalian uang dengan benar. Berkolaborasi dengan tim dapur dan kru lainnya untuk memastikan layanan yang lancar dan efisien. Mengatasi keluhan pelanggan dengan profesional dan melaporkan masalah kepada manajer untuk penyelesaian. Menjaga standar presentasi pribadi yang tinggi dan mematuhi semua protokol keselamatan dan kesehatan restoran. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal 1-2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Waiter di restoran, kafe, atau industri perhotelan lainnya. Pendidikan minimal SMA atau setara; pelatihan formal dalam layanan makanan dan minuman sangat diinginkan. Kemampuan komunikasi yang sangat baik dalam bahasa Indonesia dengan kemampuan bahasa Inggris dasar merupakan nilai tambah. Pengetahuan tentang menu restoran, jenis makanan, dan minuman termasuk kemampuan memberikan saran yang tepat. Keterampilan interpersonal yang kuat dengan kemampuan membangun hubungan positif dengan pelanggan dan rekan kerja. Ketepatan dan perhatian terhadap detail dalam mengambil dan melayani pesanan dengan akurat. Kemampuan untuk bekerja dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan cepat dengan manajemen waktu yang efektif. Integritas tinggi, keandalan, dan sikap profesional dalam setiap interaksi dengan pelanggan dan tim. Kesediaan untuk bekerja dalam shift termasuk malam, akhir pekan, dan hari libur sesuai kebutuhan operasional restoran. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan standar industri perhotelan dan pengalaman Anda. Lingkungan kerja yang suportif dan tim yang solid dengan budaya kerja yang positif. Pelatihan dan pengembangan berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan keterampilan layanan pelanggan Anda. Jadwal kerja yang terstruktur dengan jelas dan istirahat yang memadai sesuai peraturan ketenagakerjaan. Program kesejahteraan karyawan yang mencakup asuransi dasar dan tunjangan operasional. Peluang untuk berkembang karier menjadi posisi supervisor atau manajer restoran. Makanan dan minuman gratis atau dengan harga khusus karyawan selama jam kerja. Bonus dan insentif kinerja berdasarkan evaluasi layanan pelanggan yang luar biasa. Tentang Kami Le ezmod Pizza' adalah restoran pizza berkualitas yang berlokasi di Surabaya, Jawa Timur, Indonesia. Kami berkomitmen untuk menyediakan pengalaman bersantap yang autentik dan memuaskan dengan menawarkan pizza berkualitas tinggi dan hidangan pelengkap lainnya. Misi kami adalah menciptakan lingkungan yang hangat dan ramah di mana setiap pelanggan merasa dihargai dan istimewa. Kami mempercayai bahwa layanan pelanggan yang luar biasa adalah kunci kesuksesan kami, dan kami mencari individu yang berbagi nilai-nilai kami akan keunggulan, integritas, dan keramahan. Restoran kami adalah tempat yang sempurna untuk mengembangkan karir Anda dalam industri perhotelan sambil memberikan kontribusi nyata kepada kepuasan pelanggan kami setiap hari. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda tertarik untuk bergabung dengan tim Le ezmod Pizza' dan memberikan layanan pelanggan yang luar biasa, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Hubungi kami melalui saluran yang tersedia dan tunjukkan kepada kami mengapa Anda adalah kandidat ideal untuk posisi Waiter kami.

  • Bonus dan insentif kinerja berdasarkan evaluasi layanan pelanggan yang luar biasa.


Tentang Kami
Le ezmod Pizza' adalah restoran pizza berkualitas yang berlokasi di Surabaya, Jawa Timur, Indonesia. Kami berkomitmen untuk menyediakan pengalaman bersantap yang autentik dan memuaskan dengan menawarkan pizza berkualitas tinggi dan hidangan pelengkap lainnya. Misi kami adalah menciptakan lingkungan yang hangat dan ramah di mana setiap pelanggan merasa dihargai dan istimewa. Kami mempercayai bahwa layanan pelanggan yang luar biasa adalah kunci kesuksesan kami, dan kami mencari individu yang berbagi nilai-nilai kami akan keunggulan, integritas, dan keramahan. Restoran kami adalah tempat yang sempurna untuk mengembangkan karir Anda dalam industri perhotelan sambil memberikan kontribusi nyata kepada kepuasan pelanggan kami setiap hari.

Lamar Sekarang
Jika Anda tertarik untuk bergabung dengan tim Le ezmod Pizza' dan memberikan layanan pelanggan yang luar biasa, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Hubungi kami melalui saluran yang tersedia dan tunjukkan kepada kami mengapa Anda adalah kandidat ideal untuk posisi Waiter kami.

Key responsibilities Ensure that financial reports are free from material misstatements, prepared accurately and on time, fully accountable, and compliant with the applicable accounting standards in Indonesia. Ensure effective control, monitoring, and accurate recording of the company's fixed assets and inventory to safeguard company resources and maintain data integrity. Ensure the availability, maintenance, and continuous update of documented accounting policies, procedures, and systems in line with accounting standards and the company's operational requirements About you Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in a manufacturing company and/or a Public Accounting Firm (KAP). Preferably have leadership experience. Strong willingness and eagerness to learn, with the ability to adapt to a dynamic business environment. Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, and internal controls. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel. jobs.title: Service Crew (Barista, Waiter/Waitress, Cashier)

Posisi ini bertanggung jawab dalam memberikan pengalaman terbaik bagi pelanggan melalui pelayanan yang cepat, ramah, dan profesional, serta mendukung operasional harian outlet. Responsibilities * Menyambut dan melayani pelanggan dengan ramah, sopan, dan profesional. * Menjelaskan menu serta memberikan rekomendasi sesuai kebutuhan pelanggan. * Mencatat dan memproses pesanan secara akurat. * Mengoperasikan mesin kasir (POS) dan memproses transaksi pembayaran. * Mengoperasikan mesin kopi dan menyiapkan minuman sesuai standar operasional. * Menyiapkan, menyajikan, dan mengantarkan makanan serta minuman kepada pelanggan. * Menjaga kebersihan area kerja, ruang pelayanan, meja pelanggan, dan peralatan operasional. * Membantu menawarkan promo, produk baru, atau menu spesial kepada pelanggan. * Berkoordinasi dengan tim dapur dan rekan kerja untuk memastikan pesanan tersaji dengan baik dan tepat waktu. * Memberikan pengalaman pelayanan yang positif dan berkesan bagi setiap pelanggan. Requirements * Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau sederajat. * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan pelayanan pelanggan yang baik. * Berpenampilan rapi serta memiliki sikap ramah, jujur, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab. * Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Barista, Waiter/Waitress, Cashier, atau posisi terkait menjadi nilai tambah. * Memiliki pengetahuan dasar mengenai kopi menjadi nilai tambah. * Mampu mengoperasikan mesin kasir atau sistem POS. * Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift. * Bersedia bekerja pada akhir pekan dan hari libur nasional. * Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. * Mampu bekerja dengan baik di bawah tekanan, terutama saat jam operasional ramai. * Fresh graduate dipersilakan untuk melamar. Benefits * Kesempatan belajar dan berkembang di industri F&B. * Lingkungan kerja yang suportif dan kolaboratif. Placement: Jagakarsa, Jakarta Selatan Employment Type: Full-time / Shift-based

jobs.title: Procurement – Printing & Promotional Items
jobs.description: Job Description: Mencari vendor untuk kebutuhan printing, merchandise, promotional items, packaging, produksi event, dan kebutuhan branding lainnya. Membandingkan dan mengevaluasi quotation dari beberapa vendor. Melakukan negosiasi harga, spesifikasi, metode pembayaran, dan waktu produksi. Memastikan barang atau jasa sesuai dengan brief, spesifikasi, anggaran, dan timeline proyek. Membuat serta memproses purchase order dan dokumen pengadaan. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Account, Creative, Production dan Finance. Melakukan evaluasi performa vendor secara berkala. Memelihara database vendor dan riwayat harga pembelian. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 dari semua jurusan. Memiliki pengalaman 1–2 tahun di bidang procurement, produksi, atau bidang terkait. Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman di agency periklanan, percetakan, merchandise, event, retail, atau industri kreatif. Memiliki kemampuan sourcing vendor dan negosiasi yang baik. Teliti dalam memeriksa harga, spesifikasi, kuantitas, kualitas, dan deadline. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik. Terbiasa menggunakan Microsoft Excel atau Google Sheets. jobs.title: WATER & WASTEWATER PROCESS ENGINEER
jobs.description: WATER & WASTEWATER PROCESS ENGINEER Water & Wastewater Treatment Consultancy & EPC Projects We are seeking an experienced and motivated Water & Wastewater Process Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development and execution of water and wastewater treatment consultancy and EPC projects . This is an opportunity to work on technically challenging projects, collaborate with multidisciplinary and international professionals, and develop your expertise in water and wastewater treatment engineering. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Develop and review process designs for water and wastewater treatment systems. Prepare process calculations, design criteria, Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs) , and Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) . Select, evaluate, and optimize appropriate water and wastewater treatment technologies. Prepare equipment specifications, technical datasheets, design documentation, and other process-related deliverables. Perform process simulations, hydraulic calculations, mass balances, water balances, and treatment performance evaluations . Evaluate treatment processes and develop technically and economically appropriate solutions. Coordinate with MEP, Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, and other engineering disciplines . Provide technical support during project execution, operator training, commissioning, start-up, and troubleshooting . Participate in client meetings and present technical solutions and recommendations. Support the preparation of technical and commercial proposals and other project documentation as required. Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering methods, design standards, and technical solutions. REQUIREMENTS Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering, Water/Wastewater Engineering related background Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in water and/or wastewater treatment process design. Strong understanding of physical, chemical, and biological wastewater treatment processes . Good knowledge of treatment processes and technologies, including: Pre-treatment process Multimedia filtration Biological wastewater treatment Membrane technologies, including membrane modelling & simulation, and application Sludge treatment and management Other advanced water and wastewater treatment technologies Ability to prepare and review engineering calculations, technical specifications, design criteria, and engineering documents . Demonstrated experience with PFDs, P&IDs, process calculations, and treatment system design . Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Fluent in English , both written and spoken. Professional, respectful, and courteous when communicating with clients, colleagues, contractors, suppliers, and business partners . Previous experience in EPC, engineering consultancy, or water/wastewater treatment projects is highly desirable. Willingness to learn, take ownership, and work effectively within a multidisciplinary and international team . Willing to travel to project sites across Indonesia. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a professional who is: Technically strong and analytical Hands-on, practical, and solution-oriented Able to work independently while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary team Confident and professional when communicating with clients and business partners Responsible, reliable, and committed to delivering high-quality engineering work Curious and willing to continuously develop technical knowledge Interested in developing project management and leadership capabilities Creative in developing practical, technically sound, and cost-effective solutions Interested and moreover suitable candidates are invited to submit their CV and relevant project experience. Only candidates that fit the profile will be invited for an interview. We look forward to welcoming a talented engineer who is ready to grow with our team and contribute to innovative water and wastewater treatment solutions.

jobs.title: PRIVATE NANNY & FAMILY PERSONAL ASSISTANT
jobs.description: POSITION OVERVIEW We are seeking a highly professional, trustworthy, discreet, caring, and well-organised Private Nanny & Family Personal Assistant to provide dedicated support to a private family. This role combines full childcare, personal assistance, and family coordination responsibilities. The successful candidate will be responsible for the daily care and wellbeing of the children, while also assisting with the family's daily personal and administrative needs. The ideal candidate must be proactive, responsible, flexible, patient, and able to anticipate the family's needs while maintaining the highest standards of confidentiality and professionalism. CHILDCARE & CHILDREN'S DAILY CARE - Take full responsibility for the daily care, safety, comfort, and wellbeing of the children. - Supervise and care for both children according to their individual age, personality, routine, and needs. - Manage the children's daily schedules, including school, activities, appointments, meals, study time, playtime, and rest. - Prepare, arrange, or coordinate meals and snacks according to the family's requirements. - Maintain a detailed understanding of each child's food preferences, dietary requirements, allergies, routines, and personal preferences. - Accompany and safely transport the children to and from school, extracurricular activities, appointments, social engagements, and family events. - Assist the children with daily routines, learning activities, reading, play, personal organisation, and age-appropriate development. - Support the children with school routines, homework, activities, appointments, and personal organisation while respecting her growing independence and privacy. - Ensure school uniforms, bags, books, sports equipment, clothing, and personal belongings are prepared and organised. - Monitor the children's schedules and ensure they arrive at all activities on time. - Keep parents informed of important matters relating to the children's schedules, activities, school matters, and general wellbeing. - Provide appropriate supervision when the parents are travelling, working, or unavailable. - Accompany the children during family travel when required and assist with all childcare needs throughout the journey. FAMILY & PERSONAL ASSISTANCE - Manage and coordinate family schedules, appointments, activities, reservations, and daily arrangements. - Handle personal errands, shopping, purchases, deliveries, bookings, and other family requests. - Assist with travel arrangements, packing, itineraries, transportation, accommodation, and travel necessities. - Coordinate with drivers, household staff, tutors, teachers, chefs, schools, activity providers, and other service providers. - Assist in organising family events, celebrations, private functions, and special occasions. - Maintain accurate records of schedules, important dates, preferences, and family requirements. - Anticipate the family's needs and proactively arrange solutions before being asked. SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY This is a full-time, live-in position. The successful candidate will reside with the family and must be comfortable with a highly flexible schedule based on the family's daily requirements. As the primary support person for two children, the candidate is expected to be available to provide childcare and family assistance whenever required, including evenings, weekends, school holidays, family activities, and travel. This is not a conventional 9-to-5 position and does not follow a standard Monday-to-Friday schedule. There is no fixed weekly day off. Rest periods and personal time will be arranged according to the family's schedule and operational requirements, while ensuring the role is managed in accordance with applicable employment requirements. The position requires a high level of commitment, flexibility, reliability, and personal responsibility. ACCOMMODATION & MEALS • Live-in accommodation within the family residence. • Daily meals and food provision. • A comfortable and professional living environment. CONFIDENTIALITY & PROFESSIONALISM • Maintain absolute confidentiality regarding all family, personal, financial, social, business, and household matters. • Exercise complete discretion with VIP guests, friends, business associates, schools, and service providers. • Never disclose, photograph, share, or discuss private family information without authorisation. • Maintain professional boundaries while developing a warm and trusted relationship with the children. • Represent the family with excellent manners, professionalism, discretion, and integrity. CANDIDATE PROFILE • Experienced in caring for children of different age groups. • Fully capable of independently managing the daily care of both children. • Caring, patient, attentive, emotionally mature, responsible, and safety-conscious. • Trustworthy, discreet, proactive, highly organised, and adaptable. • Excellent communication skills and professional personal presentation. • Comfortable working in a high-standard or VIP private household. • Willing to travel with the family when required. THE RIGHT CANDIDATE We are looking for someone who does not simply wait for instructions, but can anticipate needs, take initiative,solve problems, and provide dependable support to the family. This position requires trust, discretion, loyalty,maturity, a good attitude, flexibility, and genuine dedication to the family's wellbeing and the safety of the children.

jobs.title: Hospital Director
jobs.description: About us PT Metro Mitra Sarana is a dedicated healthcare provider committed to delivering high-quality medical services and innovative healthcare solutions. We operate modern healthcare facilities designed to serve our communities with excellence, compassion, and a patient-centred approach. Our mission is to provide accessible, comprehensive healthcare whilst maintaining the highest standards of clinical care and operational efficiency. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative culture where healthcare professionals work together to improve patient outcomes and advance medical practice. About the role We are seeking an experienced and visionary Hospital Director to lead our healthcare facility. This is a full-time position that represents a pivotal leadership role within our organisation. As Hospital Director, you will be responsible for the strategic direction, operational management, and overall performance of the hospital. You will oversee all clinical and administrative functions, ensuring the facility meets regulatory requirements whilst delivering exceptional patient care and achieving organisational objectives. This role requires a dynamic leader who can inspire teams, drive continuous improvement, and position the hospital as a centre of excellence within the region. Key responsibilities Providing strategic leadership and direction for all hospital operations, including clinical services, nursing, support services, and administrative functions Developing and implementing hospital policies, procedures, and protocols that comply with healthcare regulations and standards Overseeing financial management, budget planning, resource allocation, and cost control to ensure operational sustainability and profitability Ensuring the delivery of high-quality patient care and maintaining clinical excellence across all departments Managing relationships with medical staff, consultants, and healthcare professionals to foster collaborative and productive working environments Leading human resources management, including recruitment, staff development, performance management, and organisational culture building Monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) and implementing quality assurance programmes to measure and improve hospital performance Representing the hospital at stakeholder meetings, community engagement initiatives, and regulatory bodies Driving innovation and implementing new healthcare technologies and best practices to enhance service delivery Managing risk, compliance, and safety protocols across all hospital operations What we're looking for Master's degree in Healthcare Management, Business Administration, or a related field; medical degree with healthcare management qualifications is preferred Minimum 8+ years of senior management experience in healthcare, with at least 3 years in a hospital director or equivalent executive leadership role Proven track record of successfully managing large, complex healthcare organisations with multiple departments and diverse staffing Strong understanding of healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and compliance requirements in Indonesia Demonstrated expertise in financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, and revenue optimisation Exceptional leadership and people management skills with the ability to build and motivate high-performing teams Strategic thinking and business acumen with the ability to drive organisational growth and innovation Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at all organisational levels Experience in quality improvement, patient safety initiatives, and clinical governance Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a data-driven approach to decision-making Knowledge of healthcare technology systems and digital transformation is advantageous What we offer PT Metro Mitra Sarana is committed to supporting the wellbeing and career development of our leadership team. We offer competitive remuneration packages commensurate with experience and qualifications, comprehensive benefits including health insurance and retirement provisions, and opportunities for continuous professional development through training and industry engagement. As a Hospital Director, you will have the opportunity to lead innovative healthcare initiatives, influence strategic direction, and make a meaningful impact on patient care and community health. We provide a supportive work environment that values excellence, collaboration, and professional growth. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Apply now If you are an accomplished healthcare leader with a passion for excellence and the vision to advance our hospital, we encourage you to submit your application. Please provide your CV, a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and leadership philosophy, and contact information for professional references. Join PT Metro Mitra Sarana and lead the future of healthcare in our region.

You will oversee all clinical and administrative functions, ensuring the facility meets regulatory requirements whilst delivering exceptional patient care and achieving organisational objectives. This role requires a dynamic leader who can inspire teams, drive continuous improvement, and position the hospital as a centre of excellence within the region.

Key responsibilities

  • Providing strategic leadership and direction for all hospital operations, including clinical services, nursing, support services, and administrative functions

  • Developing and implementing hospital policies, procedures, and protocols that comply with healthcare regulations and standards

  • Overseeing financial management, budget planning, resource allocation, and cost control to ensure operational sustainability and profitability

  • Ensuring the delivery of high-quality patient care and maintaining clinical excellence across all departments

  • Managing relationships with medical staff, consultants, and healthcare professionals to foster collaborative and productive working environments

  • Leading human resources management, including recruitment, staff development, performance management, and organisational culture building

  • Monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) and implementing quality assurance programmes to measure and improve hospital performance

  • Representing the hospital at stakeholder meetings, community engagement initiatives, and regulatory bodies

  • Driving innovation and implementing new healthcare technologies and best practices to enhance service delivery

  • Managing risk, compliance, and safety protocols across all hospital operations


What we're looking for

  • Master's degree in Healthcare Management, Business Administration, or a related field; medical degree with healthcare management qualifications is preferred

  • Minimum 8+ years of senior management experience in healthcare, with at least 3 years in a hospital director or equivalent executive leadership role

  • Proven track record of successfully managing large, complex healthcare organisations with multiple departments and diverse staffing

  • Strong understanding of healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and compliance requirements in Indonesia

  • Demonstrated expertise in financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, and revenue optimisation

  • Exceptional leadership and people management skills with the ability to build and motivate high-performing teams

  • Strategic thinking and business acumen with the ability to drive organisational growth and innovation

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at all organisational levels

  • Experience in quality improvement, patient safety initiatives, and clinical governance

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a data-driven approach to decision-making

  • Knowledge of healthcare technology systems and digital transformation is advantageous


What we offer

PT Metro Mitra Sarana is committed to supporting the wellbeing and career development of our leadership team. We offer competitive remuneration packages commensurate with experience and qualifications, comprehensive benefits including health insurance and retirement provisions, and opportunities for continuous professional development through training and industry engagement. As a Hospital Director, you will have the opportunity to lead innovative healthcare initiatives, influence strategic direction, and make a meaningful impact on patient care and community health. We provide a supportive work environment that values excellence, collaboration, and professional growth. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

Apply now

If you are an accomplished healthcare leader with a passion for excellence and the vision to advance our hospital, we encourage you to submit your application. Please provide your CV, a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and leadership philosophy, and contact information for professional references. Join PT Metro Mitra Sarana and lead the future of healthcare in our region.

jobs.title: Waiter/ Waiters Restoran
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Waiter/Waiters berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim Resto Mama Bie' di Jakarta. Sebagai Waiter, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam memberikan pengalaman bersantap yang luar biasa kepada setiap pelanggan kami. Posisi ini menuntut profesionalisme, keramahan, dan kemampuan untuk bekerja dengan efisien dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan ramai. Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk melayani makanan dan minuman dengan standar tertinggi, memastikan kepuasan pelanggan, dan berkontribusi pada suasana restoran yang positif. Ini adalah posisi fulltime yang berlokasi di Jakarta, memberikan stabilitas karir dan peluang pertumbuhan di industri perhotelan dan kuliner. Tanggung Jawab Utama Menyambut dan melayani pelanggan dengan ramah, profesional, dan responsif sejak mereka tiba hingga meninggalkan restoran. Menjelaskan menu, menawarkan rekomendasi hidangan dan minuman, serta mencatat pesanan dengan akurat. Menyajikan hidangan dan minuman kepada meja dengan presentasi yang menarik dan sesuai standar layanan restoran. Memastikan meja selalu rapi, bersih, dan dilengkapi dengan peralatan makan yang tepat sebelum dan sesudah pelanggan makan. Menangani pembayaran dengan cara yang profesional, memberikan perubahan dengan akurat, dan memproses berbagai metode pembayaran. Berkolaborasi dengan tim dapur dan receptionis untuk memastikan layanan yang lancar dan efisien. Mengatasi keluhan pelanggan dengan tenang, profesional, dan berusaha menemukan solusi yang memuaskan. Menjaga standar kebersihan dan keselamatan kerja sesuai regulasi yang berlaku. Membantu tugas-tugas restoran lainnya seperti menyiapkan meja, menata kursi, dan membersihkan area makan. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan non pengalaman welcome Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau setara. Penguasaan bahasa Indonesia yang baik Kemampuan komunikasi yang sangat baik dengan sikap ramah, sopan, dan profesional. Keterampilan layanan pelanggan yang luar biasa dengan fokus pada kepuasan dan pengalaman pelanggan. Kemampuan untuk bekerja dalam tim dan beradaptasi dengan cepat dalam lingkungan yang sibuk. Kesabaran, perhatian terhadap detail, dan kapabilitas multitasking. Kesadaran akan standar kebersihan dan keselamatan kerja yang ketat. Manfaat Utama Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai standar industri perhotelan dengan sistem insentif dan bonus kinerja. Tunjangan makan dan minuman selama jam kerja. Kesempatan pengembangan karir dan pelatihan layanan pelanggan berkelanjutan. Lingkungan kerja yang positif, mendukung, dan menghargai dedikasi karyawan. Kesempatan untuk bekerja dengan tim profesional yang berpengalaman. Program kesejahteraan karyawan dan asuransi kesehatan dasar. Jadwal kerja yang terstruktur dengan hari libur yang jelas. Tentang Kami Resto Mama Bie' adalah restoran yang berdedikasi untuk memberikan pengalaman bersantap yang hangat, nyaman, dan berkesan kepada setiap pelanggan. Dengan fokus pada kualitas hidangan dan pelayanan yang tulus, kami menciptakan komunitas tempat keluarga dan teman-teman berkumpul untuk berbagi momen berharga. Kami percaya bahwa setiap anggota tim kami adalah wajah restoran dan memainkan peran penting dalam membangun reputasi kami. Di Resto Mama Bie', kami menghargai keragaman, profesionalisme, dan dedikasi tim kami. Kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, mendukung, dan memberikan peluang pertumbuhan kepada setiap karyawan untuk berkembang dan meraih kesuksesan bersama. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda bersemangat tentang memberikan layanan pelanggan yang luar biasa dan siap untuk menjadi bagian dari tim Resto Mama Bie', kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan jadilah bagian dari kisah sukses restoran yang terus berkembang di Jakarta!

jobs.title: NUTRITIONIST – WELLNESS & MEAL PLANNING
jobs.description: About the role Reload Sanctuary is looking for a knowledgeable and guest-focused Nutritionist with hands-on experience in personalized meal planning and excellent English communication skills. In this role, you will support our guests' wellness goals through practical nutrition guidance and work closely with our kitchen and fitness teams to develop balanced, enjoyable meal options. Key responsibilities Assess guests' eating habits, dietary preferences, activity levels, and wellness goals to develop appropriate nutrition recommendations. Create personalized meal plans supporting goals such as weight management, muscle gain, sports performance, and general wellbeing. Calculate calorie and macronutrient requirements and translate them into practical food choices and portion sizes. Work closely with chefs to develop nutritionally balanced menus, standardized recipes, and suitable meal alternatives. Account for food allergies, intolerances, and dietary restrictions, coordinating preparation requirements with the kitchen. Conduct nutrition consultations and follow-up sessions in English, monitor progress, and adjust plans when appropriate. Collaborate with personal trainers and the wellness team to provide consistent guest support. Deliver nutrition education through consultations, workshops, and easy-to-understand educational materials. Maintain accurate, confidential consultation records and meal-plan documentation. Recognize cases requiring medical or specialist care and refer guests to appropriately qualified healthcare professionals. About you Bachelor's degree in Nutrition, Nutrition Science, or Dietetics. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience, including hands-on experience creating personalized meal plans and conducting nutrition consultations. Strong knowledge of calorie calculations, macronutrients, portion control, and evidence-based nutrition. Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to conduct consultations and explain nutrition concepts to international guests. Experience working in a wellness center, fitness facility, hospitality setting, or nutrition practice is preferred. Ability to collaborate with chefs and translate nutrition recommendations into practical, appealing meals. Proficiency in nutrition analysis software and Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets. Strong interpersonal skills, attention to detail, and a professional, non-judgmental approach. Relevant professional credentials and additional training in sports nutrition are an advantage.

  • Calculate calorie and macronutrient requirements and translate them into practical food choices and portion sizes.

  • Work closely with chefs to develop nutritionally balanced menus, standardized recipes, and suitable meal alternatives.

  • Account for food allergies, intolerances, and dietary restrictions, coordinating preparation requirements with the kitchen.

  • Conduct nutrition consultations and follow-up sessions in English, monitor progress, and adjust plans when appropriate.

  • Collaborate with personal trainers and the wellness team to provide consistent guest support.

  • Deliver nutrition education through consultations, workshops, and easy-to-understand educational materials.

  • Maintain accurate, confidential consultation records and meal-plan documentation.

  • Recognize cases requiring medical or specialist care and refer guests to appropriately qualified healthcare professionals.

About you

  • Bachelor's degree in Nutrition, Nutrition Science, or Dietetics.

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience, including hands-on experience creating personalized meal plans and conducting nutrition consultations.

  • Strong knowledge of calorie calculations, macronutrients, portion control, and evidence-based nutrition.

  • Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to conduct consultations and explain nutrition concepts to international guests.

  • Experience working in a wellness center, fitness facility, hospitality setting, or nutrition practice is preferred.

  • Ability to collaborate with chefs and translate nutrition recommendations into practical, appealing meals.

  • Proficiency in nutrition analysis software and Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, attention to detail, and a professional, non-judgmental approach.

  • Relevant professional credentials and additional training in sports nutrition are an advantage.

jobs.title: SUPERVISOR
jobs.description: Tim Hebat Butuh Pemimpin Hebat — Mungkin Kamu Orangnya. Kalau Kamu Bisa Memimpin Tim, Posisi Ini Untukmu. Jangan sia-siakan pengalaman kerja berharga anda. Waktunya keahlianmu dipakai di tempat yang tepat. Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan CV. Omnico Indonesia mencari seorang Supervisor yang berpengalaman dan berkemampuan tinggi untuk bergabung dengan tim manajemen kami di lokasi Mempawah, Kalimantan Barat. Sebagai Supervisor, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam memimpin, mengawasi, dan mengkoordinasikan operasional harian di divisi Anda untuk memastikan efisiensi maksimal, keamanan kerja, dan kualitas hasil kerja. Perusahaan ini membuka lowongan posisi supervisor oven, produksi dan packing. Tanggung Jawab Utama Memimpin dan mengelola tim kerja, termasuk melakukan briefing harian, memberikan arahan kerja, dan memastikan semua anggota tim memahami tugas dan target mereka. Mengawasi pelaksanaan pekerjaan di lapangan atau di area operasional untuk memastikan standar kualitas, keselamatan kerja, dan efisiensi operasional terjaga dengan baik. Melakukan evaluasi kinerja terhadap anggota tim secara berkala dan memberikan feedback yang konstruktif untuk pengembangan kompetensi mereka. Mengelola dan mengoptimalkan penggunaan sumber daya, termasuk peralatan, material, dan waktu kerja, untuk mencapai efisiensi dan produktivitas maksimal. Memastikan keselamatan kerja dan implementasi protokol kesehatan dan keselamatan kerja (K3) di lingkungan kerja. Mencatat dan melaporkan laporan harian, mingguan, dan bulanan mengenai produktivitas, masalah operasional, dan pencapaian target kepada manajemen. Menangani masalah atau konflik yang timbul dalam tim dengan profesional dan adil. Berkoordinasi dengan departemen lain untuk memastikan kelancaran operasional lintas fungsi. Melakukan inspeksi rutin terhadap kondisi mesin, peralatan, dan area kerja untuk mencegah kerusakan dan memastikan pemeliharaan yang tepat. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau diploma di bidang Manajemen, Teknik, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 3-5 tahun pengalaman kerja sebagai Supervisor, Team Leader, atau posisi kepemimpinan serupa di industri manufaktur. Memiliki pengalaman praktis dalam mengelola dan memimpin tim dengan ukuran minimal 10-20 orang. Manguasai microsoft office. Keterampilan problem solving dan pengambilan keputusan yang cepat dan tepat dalam situasi yang dinamis. Kemampuan analitik dan perhatian terhadap detail untuk memantau KPI dan metrik performa. Bersedia di tempatkan di lokasi pabrik di Wajok Hulu KM 11,2 Mempawah, Kalimantan Barat Bersedia kerja di shift malam (tergantung divisi yang dipimpin) Tentang Perusahaan CV. Omnico Indonesia adalah perusahaan produksi arang briket skala internasional. Kami sudah mengekspor ke 5 benua dan dipercaya lebih dari 10 tahun oleh customer. Stablitias dan Konsistensi adalah kunci perusahaan untuk terus berkembang setiap tahun. Perusahaan sudah terbukti kuat melewati banyak krisis.
