jobs.title: Front Office Team Leader
jobs.description: 🌟 Join Our Team at Utopia Concept Bali 🌿 Front Office Team Leader Utopia Concept Bali is looking for a warm, experienced, and service-minded Front Office Team Leader to join our boutique hospitality team. We are seeking someone who can lead by example , support and develop our Front Office team, and ensure every guest receives attentive, personal, and professional service throughout their stay. Your Role As our Front Office Team Leader, you will: • Lead and support the Front Office team during daily operations • Welcome guests warmly and ensure smooth, professional check-in and check-out experiences • Remain actively involved in guest communication and day-to-day Front Office duties • Coordinate arrivals, departures, room readiness, special requests, and guest preferences • Communicate clearly and professionally with guests through WhatsApp, email, phone, and OTA platforms • Assist guests with transfers, activities, restaurant bookings, scooters, massages, and other experiences • Handle guest requests, feedback, and service issues calmly and confidently • Support the team in finding thoughtful solutions when unexpected situations arise • Organize daily tasks, shift handovers, and Front Office priorities • Train and coach team members on service standards, procedures, and guest communication • Ensure reservations, payments, guest information, and operational records are handled accurately • Encourage natural and elegant upselling of room upgrades and guest experiences • Communicate closely with Housekeeping, F&B, Security, and Management to ensure smooth operations • Help maintain Utopia’s service standards consistently throughout the guest journey Special Skills Highly Valued We are especially looking for someone with experience in: • Front Office or Guest Relations within hotels, villas, or boutique hospitality • Leading or supervising a small hospitality team • Handling guest complaints and service recovery • Hotel reservation systems and OTA platforms such as Booking.com and Expedia • Professional written and spoken guest communication • Reservations, payments, and basic Front Office administration • Training and supporting junior team members • Upselling rooms, services, and guest experiences naturally and professionally What We’re Looking For • Previous Front Office or Guest Relations experience, ideally with Team Leader, Supervisor, Senior Front Office, or similar responsibilities • Good spoken and written English • Warm, confident, and professional guest approach • Strong communication and organizational skills • Able to lead a small team while remaining fully hands-on • Calm and resourceful when handling guest concerns or unexpected situations • Strong attention to detail and accuracy • Honest, reliable, responsible, and well-presented • Able to multitask in a dynamic boutique environment • Positive attitude and strong teamwork with other departments • Genuine passion for 🌟 Join Our Team at Utopia Concept Bali 🌿
Front Office Team Leader

Utopia Concept Bali is looking for a warm, experienced, and service-minded Front Office Team Leader to join our boutique hospitality team.

We are seeking someone who can lead by example, support and develop our Front Office team, and ensure every guest receives attentive, personal, and professional service throughout their stay.

Your Role

As our Front Office Team Leader, you will:

• Lead and support the Front Office team during daily operations
• Welcome guests warmly and ensure smooth, professional check-in and check-out experiences
• Remain actively involved in guest communication and day-to-day Front Office duties
• Coordinate arrivals, departures, room readiness, special requests, and guest preferences
• Communicate clearly and professionally with guests through WhatsApp, email, phone, and OTA platforms
• Assist guests with transfers, activities, restaurant bookings, scooters, massages, and other experiences
• Handle guest requests, feedback, and service issues calmly and confidently
• Support the team in finding thoughtful solutions when unexpected situations arise
• Organize daily tasks, shift handovers, and Front Office priorities
• Train and coach team members on service standards, procedures, and guest communication
• Ensure reservations, payments, guest information, and operational records are handled accurately
• Encourage natural and elegant upselling of room upgrades and guest experiences
• Communicate closely with Housekeeping, F&B, Security, and Management to ensure smooth operations
• Help maintain Utopia’s service standards consistently throughout the guest journey

Special Skills Highly Valued

We are especially looking for someone with experience in:

• Front Office or Guest Relations within hotels, villas, or boutique hospitality
• Leading or supervising a small hospitality team
• Handling guest complaints and service recovery
• Hotel reservation systems and OTA platforms such as Booking.com and Expedia
• Professional written and spoken guest communication
• Reservations, payments, and basic Front Office administration
• Training and supporting junior team members
• Upselling rooms, services, and guest experiences naturally and professionally

What We’re Looking For

• Previous Front Office or Guest Relations experience, ideally with Team Leader, Supervisor, Senior Front Office, or similar responsibilities
• Good spoken and written English
• Warm, confident, and professional guest approach
• Strong communication and organizational skills
• Able to lead a small team while remaining fully hands-on
• Calm and resourceful when handling guest concerns or unexpected situations
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy
• Honest, reliable, responsible, and well-presented
• Able to multitask in a dynamic boutique environment
• Positive attitude and strong teamwork with other departments
• Genuine passion for hospitality and creating memorable guest experiences

What We Offer

🌴 Competitive salary
🌴 Service Performance Bonus
🌴 Supportive and respectful team culture
🌴 Responsibility and opportunity to contribute ideas
🌴 Growth opportunities within Utopia Group
🌴 The opportunity to be part of a distinctive boutique hospitality concept in Bali

If you love hospitality, enjoy leading by example, and take pride in helping both guests and your team have an exceptional experience, we would love to meet you.

📩 Apply today and become part of the Utopia Concept Bali journey.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description: Area Sales Manager Location: Jakarta | Medan | Surabaya About the Role PT Hoki Distribusi Niaga (HDN) is looking for an experienced and driven Area Sales Manager to lead sales activities and drive business performance across the assigned territory. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and developing the sales team, monitoring stock and sales performance, ensuring the execution of sales and promotional programs, and providing market insights to support business growth. This position will work closely with sales teams and distributors to ensure effective execution and achievement of key sales targets across the assigned area. Key Responsibilities Lead, coordinate, and develop the Sales team within the assigned area to ensure effective daily sales activities, discipline, and achievement of targets. This includes maintaining strong collaboration with Sales Managers at distributor level. Monitor stock levels at each stock point, ensuring product availability, stock rotation, and sales performance are well maintained, including achievement of Effective Call (EC) within the assigned territory. Ensure sales and promotional programs are properly executed in the area through active coordination and effective communication of company directions, policies, and plans to the field Sales team. Collect and regularly report field feedback to the central team, including market insights, competitor conditions, and territory development opportunities based on field visits and distributor coordination. Propose, monitor, and evaluate in-store promotional programs, ensuring proper implementation, tracking progress, and analysing their effectiveness and impact on area sales performance. What We're Looking For Bachelor's degree ( S1 ) in any field. 2–4 years of experience in Area Sales or Regional Sales, preferably within the FMCG industry . Proven experience in leading Sales teams and working closely with distributors. Comfortable working with sales targets, including sales achievement, Effective Call (EC), and coverage . Strong communication, analytical, and leadership skills. Willing to travel for business trips as required by the assigned territory. Area Jakarta | Medan | Surabaya If you are a strong sales leader who enjoys developing teams, managing distributor relationships, and driving territory performance, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Drafter
jobs.description: Intramega Global, a leading provider of warehouse solutions specializing in systems, technology, infrastructure, and consulting services, is seeking a Drafter to join our growing team. This role is instrumental in supporting project execution by developing detailed solution designs for warehouse infrastructure, including racking systems, automation layouts, and storage optimization plans. The Drafter will collaborate closely with sales, engineering, and project teams to translate client needs and site conditions into precise technical drawings and design proposals. In addition to creating 2D/3D designs and layout drawings, this position involves reviewing site measurements, applying warehouse efficiency principles, and ensuring design feasibility for implementation. The ideal candidate should have a keen eye for spatial planning, knowledge of material handling systems, and proficiency in design software such as AutoCAD or SketchUp. This role also contributes to continuous improvement by supporting standardization of design templates, maintaining a solutions database, and integrating input from ongoing project feedback to refine design practices. Key Responsibilities: Propose racking layout designs that meet client requirements and warehouse specifications. Create detailed 2D and 3D drawings for warehouse racking and automation solutions using AutoCAD. Calculate and finalize product pricing based on approved designs. Process and transform raw data into structured, presentation-ready reports. Coordinate with internal departments including Sales, Project, Order Processing, and Purchasing to ensure accurate implementation of approved designs. Requirements Minimum education: Bachelor Degree in Architecture or Civil Engineering. Minimum 1 year of relevant experience; fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Proficiency in AutoCAD is mandatory – candidates will be tested during the interview process. Skilled in 3D drawing and Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Strong attention to detail and spatial awareness. Able to work independently and under pressure. Creative, proactive, and eager to learn. Work location : Alam Sutera, Tangerang

jobs.title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: Full-Stack AI Engineer Location: Jakarta, Indonesia Employment Type: Full-time About the Company We are building a digital employee team for North American real estate agents. Our AI-powered digital employees operate through WhatsApp and are designed to perform real operational tasks, including tracking transaction deadlines, managing follow-ups, drafting property listings and social media content, and supporting administrative workflows. We are looking for a Full-Stack AI Engineer with a strong backend focus to help design and develop the infrastructure powering these AI employees. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain backend systems supporting AI agent orchestration, tool execution, task queues, scheduling, memory, and state management. Build and maintain integrations with WhatsApp, calendars, email, MLS, and real estate transaction systems. Develop reliable production systems with appropriate idempotency, retry mechanisms, observability, and evaluation processes. Develop user-facing features and interfaces when required. Build and maintain LLM-based agents capable of handling real-world user interactions. Implement tool use, memory, state management, error handling, and other components required for reliable AI agents. Collaborate with the team to identify technical issues and continuously improve system reliability and performance. Utilize AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor to improve development efficiency and output. Requirements: Minimum 3 years of professional experience in production backend engineering . Strong proficiency in Node.js or Python . Experience with PostgreSQL and relational database systems. Experience with asynchronous programming, task queues, and backend architecture. Experience with cloud deployment and production systems. Strong working knowledge of TypeScript, React, and/or Next.js . Experience developing and deploying LLM/AI agents used by real users . Understanding of AI agent concepts including tool use, memory, state management, and error handling. Regular experience using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted development tools . Good written and spoken English. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, preferably from a leading university. Previous professional experience in an AI company or AI-focused environment . Experience building AI-powered products or production LLM applications. Experience working with third-party APIs and complex system integrations.

jobs.title: Warehouse Manager - Frozen Food Manufacturing
jobs.description: Kami mencari seorang Warehouse Manager yang berpengalaman dan profesional untuk mengelola operasional pergudangan kami di fasilitas Frozen Food Manufacturing di Mojokerto, Jawa Timur. Sebagai Warehouse Manager, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengoptimalkan efisiensi operasional, mengelola inventaris, dan memastikan standar kualitas serta keamanan produk beku terjaga dengan sempurna. Tanggung Jawab Mengelola dan mengawasi semua operasi pergudangan, termasuk penerimaan, penyimpanan, dan pengiriman produk frozen food dengan standar kualitas tertinggi. Memimpin dan membina tim warehouse untuk memastikan produktivitas, keselamatan kerja, dan kepatuhan terhadap prosedur operasional yang telah ditetapkan. Memelihara dan mengoptimalkan sistem penyimpanan dingin, termasuk mesin pendingin dan fasilitas cold storage sesuai dengan persyaratan suhu produk frozen food. Melakukan kontrol inventaris secara berkala, memastikan akurasi data stok, dan meminimalkan risiko kerusakan atau kerugian produk. Merencanakan dan mengatur pengiriman produk ke berbagai lokasi dengan efisien dan tepat waktu sesuai permintaan pelanggan. Menerapkan dan memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar keselamatan kerja, hygiene, dan regulasi yang berlaku di industri makanan dan pergudangan. Melakukan monitoring terhadap performa karyawan warehouse dan memberikan pelatihan berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan keterampilan dan efisiensi kerja. Membuat laporan operasional berkala dan memberikan rekomendasi untuk perbaikan proses dan efisiensi biaya. Berkoordinasi dengan departemen produksi, penjualan, dan logistik untuk memastikan kelancaran operasional secara keseluruhan. Mengelola anggaran warehouse dan mengontrol pengeluaran operasional agar tetap efisien dan sesuai target yang ditetapkan. Kualifikasi : Berpengalaman pada gudang Pendingin / Cold Storage . Berpengalaman sebagai Kepala Gudang minimal 5 (Tiga) tahun. Mampu bekerja secara individual serta tim. serta mampu mengelola Tim Internal untuk menjalankan fungsi dan tanggung jawab sesuai dengan kebutuhan. Memiliki leadership yang baik , mampu mengarahkan, monitoring dan evaluasi Tim serta berkoordinasi dengan lintas Department. Memahami sistem operasional Gudang khususnya gudang Pendingin / Cold Storage. Memiliki kemampuan menganalisa kebutuhan barang gudang berdasarkan permintaan dan kebutuhan operasional. Jujur , teliti, aktif, berintegritas tinggi serta komunikatif. Bersedia di tempatkan di Mojokerto.

jobs.title: Site Project Manager - Villa & Hotel Construction
jobs.description: PT Nusa Laras Konstruksi is a Bali based construction company building villas and boutique hotels. We are staffing our site organisation to take over a project already under construction, and to carry the team into the projects that follow it. THE ROLE You own delivery on site. You take over an ongoing build, get a clear picture of where it actually stands, and drive it to completion on programme, on budget and on quality. Once it hands over, you lead the next project. WHAT YOU WILL DO Run daily site execution across CSA and MEP, with the two site supervisors reporting to you. Take over the existing programme, re-baseline it honestly, and manage the critical path week by week. Chair weekly site coordination and produce a weekly progress report to management. Control manpower, subcontractors and site productivity against the plan. Enforce the rule that no work starts without an approved and revision controlled drawing. Escalate design clashes, variations and cost impacts early, in writing. Work with Quality Control and Purchasing and K3 as independent control functions, not as your subordinates. Keep the site safe, clean and inspection ready at all times. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Bachelor degree in Civil Engineering or Architecture, or equivalent site experience. Minimum 5 years running building sites, at least 2 as Project Manager or Site Manager. Proven delivery on villa, hotel or high end residential projects, in Bali or wider Indonesia. You have taken over a project mid construction before, and you know how to audit what you inherit. Strong on planning: MS Project or Primavera, S curve, weekly look ahead. Comfortable reading structural, architectural and MEP drawings and spotting the clash before site does. Fluent Bahasa Indonesia and English, both spoken and written. SKA or SKK Konstruksi certification is an advantage. WHAT WE OFFER An ongoing project now, and a pipeline of new villa and hotel projects after. Direct line to the decision makers, short chain of command. PKWT, project based, extended onto the next project on performance. BPJS Kesehatan and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan from day one, THR, meal and transport allowance. Overtime paid separately on top of basic salary, per Indonesian labour law. -- BAHASA INDONESIA PT Nusa Laras Konstruksi adalah perusahaan konstruksi yang berbasis di Bali, membangun villa dan hotel butik. Kami sedang membentuk tim proyek untuk mengambil alih sebuah proyek yang sedang berjalan, dan melanjutkan bersama tim tersebut ke proyek proyek berikutnya. TENTANG POSISI INI Anda bertanggung jawab penuh atas pelaksanaan di lapangan. Anda mengambil alih proyek yang sedang berjalan, memetakan kondisi sebenarnya di lapangan, lalu membawanya sampai selesai sesuai jadwal, biaya dan mutu. Setelah serah terima, Anda memimpin proyek berikutnya. TUGAS DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB Memimpin pelaksanaan harian di lapangan untuk lingkup CSA dan MEP, dengan dua site supervisor melapor kepada Anda. Mengambil alih jadwal proyek yang ada, menyusun ulang baseline secara realistis, dan mengendalikan lintasan kritis setiap minggu. Memimpin rapat koordinasi lapangan mingguan dan membuat laporan progres mingguan untuk manajemen. Mengendalikan tenaga kerja, subkontraktor dan produktivitas lapangan terhadap rencana. Menegakkan aturan: tidak ada pekerjaan yang dimulai tanpa gambar kerja yang sudah disetujui dan ber-revisi jelas. Melaporkan lebih awal dan secara tertulis setiap bentrok desain, variation order dan dampak biayanya. Bekerja bersama Quality Control dan Purchasing dan K3 sebagai fungsi kontrol yang independen, bukan sebagai bawahan Anda. Menjaga lapangan tetap aman, bersih dan siap diinspeksi kapan saja. KUALIFIKASI S1 Teknik Sipil atau Arsitektur, atau pengalaman lapangan yang setara. Minimal 5 tahun memimpin proyek gedung, minimal 2 tahun sebagai Project Manager atau Site Manager. Rekam jejak nyata pada proyek villa, hotel atau residensial kelas atas, di Bali atau di Indonesia. Pernah mengambil alih proyek di tengah jalan dan tahu cara mengaudit apa yang Anda warisi. Kuat dalam perencanaan: MS Project atau Primavera, kurva S, look ahead mingguan. Mampu membaca gambar struktur, arsitektur dan MEP, serta menemukan bentrok sebelum terjadi di lapangan. Lancar berbahasa Indonesia dan Inggris, lisan maupun tulisan. Sertifikat SKA atau SKK Konstruksi menjadi nilai tambah. YANG KAMI TAWARKAN Satu proyek berjalan sekarang, dan rangkaian proyek villa dan hotel berikutnya. Akses langsung ke pengambil keputusan, jalur komando pendek. PKWT berbasis proyek, diperpanjang ke proyek berikutnya berdasarkan kinerja. BPJS Kesehatan dan BPJS Ketenagakerjaan sejak hari pertama, THR, tunjangan makan dan transport. Lembur dibayar terpisah di luar gaji pokok, sesuai peraturan ketenagakerjaan.

jobs.title: Driver & Delivery

Perawatan Kendaraan: Memeriksa kondisi fisik, kebersihan, bahan bakar, dan melakukan perawatan ringan pada kendaraan. 5. Komunikasi & Layanan: Melaporkan status pengiriman kepada admin atau atasan serta melayani pelanggan dengan ramah. Kualifikasi: 1. Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK sederajat. 2. Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Driver minimal 3 tahun. 3. Teliti, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan jujur. 4. Memiliki SIM A dan C 5. Paham perawatan dasar kendaraan. 6. Menguasai daerah jakarta dan bisa membaca Maps 7. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. 8. Mampu bekerja dengan target dan dalam kondisi operasional yang dinamis. 9. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift.

5. Paham perawatan dasar kendaraan.

7. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim.

8. Mampu bekerja dengan target dan dalam kondisi operasional yang dinamis.

9. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift.

jobs.title: Branch Manager Jawa Tengah
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan Memimpin dan mengelola tim (Leader dan teknisi/sales) di areanya untuk memastikan penyelesaian tiket pekerjaan operasional aplikasi Payment dan target penjualan produk aplikasi PPOB / POS sesuai kebijakan perusahaan. Melakukan monitoring performa harian, baik terkait penyelesaian tiket pekerjaan operasional maupun pencapaian penjualan. Menetapkan target harian secara objektif dan terukur untuk tim teknisi / sales Bertanggung jawab penuh atas pemenuhan Service Level Agreement (SLA) tiket pekerjaan opersional Melakukan pemantauan dan eskalasi terhadap Tiket Urgent agar terselesaikan tepat waktu. Menganalisis dan melakukan mapping/remapping populasi teknisi secara merata, serta proaktif mengajukan penambahan teknisi jika area tersebut sudah overload . Membuka peluang bisnis baru di areanya melalui penawaran strategis produk POSe (PPOB / POS). Menjaga relasi dengan merchant prioritas pengguna Produk POSe dan engagement dengan Kantor Wilayah/Cabang Klien. Mendukung kegiatan sosialisasi dan edukasi Produk POSe (PPOB/POS), serta menguasai product knowledge secara mendalam. Kualifikasi Minimum Pendidikan: Minimal Sarjana (S1) dari segala jurusan. Latar Belakang Industri (Wajib B2B): Pengalaman minimal 3-4 tahun sebagai Area Manager , Branch Manager , atau Senior Sales Leader . Wajib berasal dari industri: PPOB, POS, Payment Gateway , atau Perbankan (khususnya Divisi EDC/QRIS/Merchant Acquisition). Rekam Jejak Penjualan (Sales Track Record): Terbiasa dan terbukti mampu menjual produk dengan dan mencapai target yang diberikan Karakter & Kepemimpinan Eksekusi: Memiliki pengalaman nyata dalam merestrukturisasi tim yang underperforming ATAU pengalaman membangun tim operasional/sales dari nol ( built team from scratch ). Memiliki pencapaian penjualan yang jelas berupa nominal Rupiah/Omzet ( Revenue atau Gross Transaction Value /GTV)

jobs.title: Business Development Intern
jobs.description: Intramega Global is a leading provider of warehouse technology solutions, specializing in the design, development, and optimization of warehouse operations. Our offerings include warehouse infrastructure, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), automation technology, automated storage, RFID, and consulting services. By partnering with global technology leaders, we deliver customized solutions that address each client's unique challenges and drive measurable improvements in efficiency and performance. We are opening our Business Development Internship Program for students and fresh graduates who want to build a career in B2B technology sales. You will work alongside our sales team on real prospects and real accounts, learning how enterprise warehouse technology is sold — from market research through to proposal support. What You Will Do Research target industries and build qualified prospect lists across manufacturing, retail, logistics, and mining Conduct first-touch outreach to assigned prospects and qualify inbound leads Maintain accurate prospect and pipeline records in the company CRM Support the sales team in preparing client presentations, company profiles, and solution proposals Assist in gathering client requirements and site information for solution design Monitor industry trends, market movements, and competitor activity, and share findings with the team Support marketing on campaign material, events, and exhibition preparation Join client meetings and site visits with senior sales as an observer and note-taker What We Are Looking For Final-year student or fresh graduate in Information Technology, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related field Available for a minimum 6-month full-time internship, on-site in Alam Sutera, Tangerang Good spoken and written English Comfortable with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; Canva is a plus Clear communicator, curious, and comfortable reaching out to people you have not met Interest in technology, logistics, or supply chain; prior exposure to ERP, WMS, or B2B sales is a plus but not required Organized and reliable — able to follow through on tasks without being chased What You Will Get Monthly allowance Direct mentorship from our Business Development and Solution teams Internship certificate on completion Priority consideration for a full-time role based on performance

jobs.title: Demand Planning Supervisor
jobs.description: About the role At Lesaffre Indonesia, the Demand Planning Supervisor plays an important role in balancing customer demand, inventory, service level, and cash flow. This role involves working across Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain to help the business make smarter decisions and improve forecast and inventory performance. This is a full-time position based in Malang, East Java Key responsibilities Lead demand forecasting & analysis using historical data, market trends, seasonality, promotions, and business plans. Challenge and improve forecasts to increase Forecast Accuracy . Drive inventory optimization and ensure the right balance between availability, service level, and inventory value. Facilitate S&OP discussions and translate demand insights into actionable plans. Monitor key Supply Chain KPIs : Forecast Accuracy, Inventory Days/Value, OTIF, OFR, and CTP. Identify supply-demand risks and drive mitigation actions. Develop team capability through coaching, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and relevant training. Build a collaborative, data-driven, and continuous improvement mindset within the team. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in supply chain, Business, Engineering, Management, or related field. 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain & Planning. Strong understanding of Demand Planning & Inventory Management. Good analytical skills with Excel and ERP; SAP experience is an advantage . Proactive, problem solver, result-oriented, and comfortable working cross-functionally. CSCA/CSCP or relevant certification is a plus . What we offer At Lesaffre Indonesia, we value our employees and are committed to providing a supportive work environment where you can thrive. We offer competitive salary packages commensurate with experience, opportunities for professional development and career progression within our growing organisation, and a collaborative team culture where your contributions are recognised and valued. We provide ongoing training to help you develop your skills and advance your career in customer service. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package designed. About us Lesaffre Indonesia is a dynamic and customer-oriented company committed to delivering high-quality products and services to our clients across Indonesia. We pride ourselves on our customer centric approach and our team's dedication to excellence. Our company values integrity, professionalism, and continuous improvement, and we foster a workplace culture that encourages innovation and teamwork. We are proud of our reputation in the industry and are always looking for talented individuals who share our commitment to outstanding customer service. If you are passionate about delivering excellent customer service and believe you would be an asset to our team, we encourage you to apply now . Please submit your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you would be an excellent fit for this role.

jobs.title: Leader Food & Beverage team
jobs.description: 🌿 Join Our Team at Utopia Concept Bali Food & Beverage Team Leader Utopia Concept Bali is looking for a warm, experienced, and service-minded Food & Beverage Team Leader to join our boutique hospitality team. We are seeking someone who combines genuine hospitality with strong operational skills and can confidently lead a small F&B team while remaining actively involved in daily service. Your Role As our Food & Beverage Team Leader, you will: • Lead and support the F&B team during daily operations and service • Ensure consistently warm, professional, and attentive guest service • Coordinate breakfast, lunch, dinner, bar, and beverage service • Welcome guests, take orders, serve food and drinks, and remain hands-on during busy periods • Prepare and supervise quality coffee, barista-style beverages, cocktails, mocktails, and simple bar drinks • Maintain service standards, presentation, cleanliness, and organization across restaurant and bar areas • Brief the team and help organize daily tasks and responsibilities • Train and coach team members on service, menu knowledge, drinks, and guest interaction • Monitor stock levels, bar supplies, and basic inventory control • Help minimize waste and ensure proper handling of F&B products • Communicate closely with the kitchen, front office, housekeeping, and management • Handle guest requests, feedback, and small service issues calmly and professionally • Encourage natural and elegant upselling of food, drinks, and guest experiences • Help ensure that Utopia’s service standards are followed consistently every day Special Skills Highly Valued We are especially looking for someone with strong experience in: • Leading or supervising a restaurant, bar, café, hotel, or villa F&B team • Barista work and coffee preparation • Cocktail and mocktail preparation • Restaurant and table service • Bar setup, stock control, and cleanliness • Training and supporting junior team members • Guest interaction and service recovery • Upselling in a natural, guest-focused way • Maintaining high service standards in a boutique hospitality environment What We’re Looking For • Previous experience in Food & Beverage, ideally with Team Leader, Captain, Supervisor, or similar responsibilities • Good English communication skills • Confident leadership with a warm and respectful approach • Strong attention to detail and service standards • Able to organize a small team and remain calm during busy periods • Hands-on attitude and willingness to work alongside the team • Honest, reliable, responsible, and well-presented • Able to multitask and solve day-to-day operational issues independently • Positive attitude and good communication with other departments • Genuine passion for hospitality and creating memorable guest experiences What We Offer 🌴 Competitive salary 🌴 Service charge share 🌴 Supportive and respectful team culture 🌴 Responsibility and opportunity to contribute ideas 🌴 Growth opportunities within Utopia Group 🌴 The opportunity to be part of a distinctive boutique hospitality concept in Bali If you love hospitality, enjoy leading by example, and take pride in developing a team while delivering 🌿 Join Our Team at Utopia Concept Bali
Food & Beverage Team Leader

Utopia Concept Bali is looking for a warm, experienced, and service-minded Food & Beverage Team Leader to join our boutique hospitality team.

We are seeking someone who combines genuine hospitality with strong operational skills and can confidently lead a small F&B team while remaining actively involved in daily service.

Your Role

As our Food & Beverage Team Leader, you will:

• Lead and support the F&B team during daily operations and service
• Ensure consistently warm, professional, and attentive guest service
• Coordinate breakfast, lunch, dinner, bar, and beverage service
• Welcome guests, take orders, serve food and drinks, and remain hands-on during busy periods
• Prepare and supervise quality coffee, barista-style beverages, cocktails, mocktails, and simple bar drinks
• Maintain service standards, presentation, cleanliness, and organization across restaurant and bar areas
• Brief the team and help organize daily tasks and responsibilities
• Train and coach team members on service, menu knowledge, drinks, and guest interaction
• Monitor stock levels, bar supplies, and basic inventory control
• Help minimize waste and ensure proper handling of F&B products
• Communicate closely with the kitchen, front office, housekeeping, and management
• Handle guest requests, feedback, and small service issues calmly and professionally
• Encourage natural and elegant upselling of food, drinks, and guest experiences
• Help ensure that Utopia’s service standards are followed consistently every day

Special Skills Highly Valued

We are especially looking for someone with strong experience in:

• Leading or supervising a restaurant, bar, café, hotel, or villa F&B team
• Barista work and coffee preparation
• Cocktail and mocktail preparation
• Restaurant and table service
• Bar setup, stock control, and cleanliness
• Training and supporting junior team members
• Guest interaction and service recovery
• Upselling in a natural, guest-focused way
• Maintaining high service standards in a boutique hospitality environment

What We’re Looking For

• Previous experience in Food & Beverage, ideally with Team Leader, Captain, Supervisor, or similar responsibilities
• Good English communication skills
• Confident leadership with a warm and respectful approach
• Strong attention to detail and service standards
• Able to organize a small team and remain calm during busy periods
• Hands-on attitude and willingness to work alongside the team
• Honest, reliable, responsible, and well-presented
• Able to multitask and solve day-to-day operational issues independently
• Positive attitude and good communication with other departments
• Genuine passion for hospitality and creating memorable guest experiences

What We Offer

🌴 Competitive salary
🌴 Service charge share
🌴 Supportive and respectful team culture
🌴 Responsibility and opportunity to contribute ideas
🌴 Growth opportunities within Utopia Group
🌴 The opportunity to be part of a distinctive boutique hospitality concept in Bali

If you love hospitality, enjoy leading by example, and take pride in developing a team while delivering beautiful guest experiences, we would love to meet you.

📩 Apply today and become part of the Utopia Concept Bali journey.

About the Role

PT Hoki Distribusi Niaga (HDN) is looking for a Sales Executive – B2B & Foodservice to join our team.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing existing accounts, developing new customers, expanding business opportunities within your territory, and supporting the growth of our foodservice and B2B business.

This position is field-oriented and requires regular customer visits and prospecting activities across Jababeka, Cikarang, Bekasi, Karawang, and Bogor.

You will report directly to the B2B & Foodservice Business Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and maintain existing B2B & foodservice accounts.

  • Identify and acquire new customers and business opportunities.

  • Develop sales opportunities within the assigned territory.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with foodservice distributors.

  • Conduct regular customer visits and prospecting activities.

  • Maintain sales reports and manage sales pipeline.

  • Support collection activities and follow up with customers when required.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–4 years of experience in B2B sales.

  • Experience in foodservice, HoReCa suppliers, FMCG distributors, frozen food, beverage, or rice/staple food is preferred.

  • Having a database or network within HoReCa/foodservice is a strong advantage.

  • Experienced in negotiating price, volume, payment terms, and commercial deals.

  • Field-oriented and comfortable conducting sales calls at least 3 days per week.

  • Have your own motorcycle and valid SIM C.

  • Strong communication, negotiation, relationship-building, and sales skills.

  • Target-oriented and able to develop new business opportunities.

Area

Jababeka, Cikarang, Bekasi, Karawang & Bogor

Reporting to:
B2B & Foodservice Business Manager

Why Join Us?

If you are someone who enjoys building relationships, developing business, and creating new sales opportunities, this could be the right opportunity for you.

Build Relationship. Grow Business. Make Impact.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV to:

••••@hdn.co.id

jobs.title: Controls & Automation Engineer (Freelance for 2 months)
jobs.description: Before applying, please notes : This role is 1-2 months contract base 3 years of experience of managing integrating automation projects is required Fluent in Chinese is a must Professional Profile Experienced Freelance Controls & Automation Engineer specializing in industrial automation, machine control systems, drive technology, and process optimization. Proven expertise in PLC programming, motion control, industrial communication networks, machine safety, and troubleshooting within highly automated production environments. Strong track record of improving machine performance, reducing cycle times, optimizing positioning accuracy, and ensuring reliable operation through systematic diagnostics and continuous technical improvements. Scope of work: analyses current issues from the automation technique, error handling and develop solutions together with the supplier solving the same analyses of current process and throughput issues improving the solutions Core Competencies: PLC Programming & Automation Extensive experience with leading automation platforms such as Siemens TIA Portal and Beckhoff TwinCAT. Development, commissioning, testing, and optimization of machine control software for industrial applications. Drive Technology & Motion Control Hands-on experience with drive technologies from SEW-Eurodrive, Siemens Sinamics, and others. Industrial Networks & Communication Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols and fieldbus systems, including Profinet, EtherCAT, and Ethernet/IP. Design, integration, and troubleshooting of networked automation systems for seamless machine and plant communication. HMI & SCADA Systems Customization and enhancement of HMI and SCADA interfaces to improve operator usability and productivity. Development of intuitive machine operation concepts, clear alarm management, and user-friendly diagnostic tools. Functional Safety & Machine Safety Practical implementation of machine safety functions according to ISO 13849 standards. Experience with Safety Integrated concepts, emergency stop systems, safety door interlocks, and risk-reduction measures in industrial machinery. Diagnostics & Process Optimization Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis Rapid interpretation of electrical schematics (EPLAN and similar systems). Systematic fault finding in control cabinets using measurement equipment such as multimeters and diagnostic tools. Efficient identification and resolution of electrical, mechanical, and software-related issues. Cycle Time Optimization Fine-tuning of control algorithms, motion profiles, and process parameters to maximize throughput while minimizing wear and downtime. Continuous performance analysis and implementation of efficiency improvements in automated production systems. Areas of Expertise Industrial Automation PLC Software Development Commissioning & Start-Up Support Motion Control Systems Machine Safety Engineering Production Line Optimization Industrial Networking Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis Manufacturing Process Improvement

Before applying, please notes :

  • This role is 1-2 months contract base

  • 3 years of experience of managing integrating automation projects is required

  • Fluent in Chinese is a must


Professional Profile

Experienced Freelance Controls & Automation Engineer specializing in industrial automation, machine control systems, drive technology, and process optimization. Proven expertise in PLC programming, motion control, industrial communication networks, machine safety, and troubleshooting within highly automated production environments. Strong track record of improving machine performance, reducing cycle times, optimizing positioning accuracy, and ensuring reliable operation through systematic diagnostics and continuous technical improvements.

Scope of work:

  • analyses current issues from the automation technique, error handling and develop solutions together with the supplier solving the same

  • analyses of current process and throughput issues improving the solutions


Core Competencies:

PLC Programming & Automation

  • Extensive experience with leading automation platforms such as Siemens TIA Portal and Beckhoff TwinCAT.

  • Development, commissioning, testing, and optimization of machine control software for industrial applications.

Drive Technology & Motion Control

  • Hands-on experience with drive technologies from SEW-Eurodrive, Siemens Sinamics, and others.

Industrial Networks & Communication

  • Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols and fieldbus systems, including Profinet, EtherCAT, and Ethernet/IP.

  • Design, integration, and troubleshooting of networked automation systems for seamless machine and plant communication.

HMI & SCADA Systems

  • Customization and enhancement of HMI and SCADA interfaces to improve operator usability and productivity.

  • Development of intuitive machine operation concepts, clear alarm management, and user-friendly diagnostic tools.

Functional Safety & Machine Safety

  • Practical implementation of machine safety functions according to ISO 13849 standards.

  • Experience with Safety Integrated concepts, emergency stop systems, safety door interlocks, and risk-reduction measures in industrial machinery.

Diagnostics & Process Optimization

Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis

  • Rapid interpretation of electrical schematics (EPLAN and similar systems).

  • Systematic fault finding in control cabinets using measurement equipment such as multimeters and diagnostic tools.

  • Efficient identification and resolution of electrical, mechanical, and software-related issues.

Cycle Time Optimization

  • Fine-tuning of control algorithms, motion profiles, and process parameters to maximize throughput while minimizing wear and downtime.

  • Continuous performance analysis and implementation of efficiency improvements in automated production systems.


Areas of Expertise

  • Industrial Automation

  • PLC Software Development

  • Commissioning & Start-Up Support

  • Motion Control Systems

  • Machine Safety Engineering

  • Production Line Optimization

  • Industrial Networking

  • Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis

  • Manufacturing Process Improvement

Melakukan survey exit customer dengan cara interview sesuai dengan standar, prosedur dan target SLA yang telah ditetapkan, sehingga dapat dijadikan sebagai bahan masukan dalam pengembangan strategi retention. Memiliki manajemen waktu yang baik. Terbiasa bekerja dengan target Training & Professional Development

jobs.title: Regional HCBP Specialist
jobs.description: Job Description Melakukan Proses Rekrutmen untuk memenuhi kebutuhan SDM di cabang Melaksanakan rangkaian proses Orientasi Karyawan Baru untuk memastikan karyawan baru mengetahui proses kerja perusahan dan gambaran pekerjaan yang akan diberikan kepada karyawan yang bersangkutan, guna mendukung kelancaran bisnis proses perusahaan. Bertindak sebagai internal trainer bagi karyawan cabang khususnya untuk materi yang berhubungan dengan produk guna mendukung peningkatan kompetensi karyawan. Memproses semua administrasi yang berhubungan dengan Human Capital di cabang sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku, guna meminimalisasi tingkat penyimpangan yang terjadi. Melakukan sosialisasi dan melaksanakan semua program yang berkaitan dengan Human Capital di cabang yang menjadi tanggung jawabnya, guna mendukung pencapaian target Human Capital Business Partner secara keseluruhan. Bertindak sebagai counselor bagi karyawan di cabang yang menjadi tanggungjawabnya untuk mengetahui issue mengenai Human Capital yang terjadi di cabang, guna mencari solusi yang tepat bagi penyelesaian masalah yang terjadi. Mencapai target pemenuhan karyawan, training, event, dan target lainnya yang ditetapkan oleh perusahaan Requirements Pendidikan minimal S1 Psikologi / Manajemen SDM / Hukum / jurusan relevan lainnya Siap untuk melakukan perjalanan dinas jika diperlukan. (Memiliki SIM A & C) Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang Human Capital, khususnya di area recruitment, training & development, organisasi, atau talent management. Memiliki pemahaman menyeluruh tentang proses HC (rekrutmen, training, people development, dan hubungan industrial merupakan nilai tambah). Komunikatif, percaya diri, dan mampu bersosialisasi secara efektif dengan seluruh level organisasi. Terbiasa melakukan public speaking, membawakan sesi pelatihan, atau menjadi fasilitator diskusi. Mampu berpikir analitis dan memiliki pendekatan solutif terhadap masalah ketenagakerjaan. Memiliki kemampuan menyusun materi pelatihan dan program pengembangan karyawan. Menguasai Microsoft Office dan tools presentasi (PowerPoint, Canva, dsb). Memiliki integritas tinggi, inisiatif, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun tim. Car/Motorcycle Owner Program BFI Care Performance Bonus Training & Professional Development Maternity & Paternity Leave Retirement Benefit Plans Subsidi Pemeliharaan Kendaraan Paid Sick Leave Medical & Health Insurance Business Trip Life Insurance

Job Description

  1. Melakukan Proses Rekrutmen untuk memenuhi kebutuhan SDM di cabang
  2. Melaksanakan rangkaian proses Orientasi Karyawan Baru untuk memastikan karyawan baru mengetahui proses kerja perusahan dan gambaran pekerjaan yang akan diberikan kepada karyawan yang bersangkutan, guna mendukung kelancaran bisnis proses perusahaan.
  3. Bertindak sebagai internal trainer bagi karyawan cabang khususnya untuk materi yang berhubungan dengan produk guna mendukung peningkatan kompetensi karyawan.
  4. Memproses semua administrasi yang berhubungan dengan Human Capital di cabang sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku, guna meminimalisasi tingkat penyimpangan yang terjadi.
  5. Melakukan sosialisasi dan melaksanakan semua program yang berkaitan dengan Human Capital di cabang yang menjadi tanggung jawabnya, guna mendukung pencapaian target Human Capital Business Partner secara keseluruhan.
  6. Bertindak sebagai counselor bagi karyawan di cabang yang menjadi tanggungjawabnya untuk mengetahui issue mengenai Human Capital yang terjadi di cabang, guna mencari solusi yang tepat bagi penyelesaian masalah yang terjadi.
  7. Mencapai target pemenuhan karyawan, training, event, dan target lainnya yang ditetapkan oleh perusahaan

Requirements

  1. Pendidikan minimal S1 Psikologi / Manajemen SDM / Hukum / jurusan relevan lainnya
  2. Siap untuk melakukan perjalanan dinas jika diperlukan. (Memiliki SIM A & C)
  3. Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang Human Capital, khususnya di area recruitment, training & development, organisasi, atau talent management.
  4. Memiliki pemahaman menyeluruh tentang proses HC (rekrutmen, training, people development, dan hubungan industrial merupakan nilai tambah).
  5. Komunikatif, percaya diri, dan mampu bersosialisasi secara efektif dengan seluruh level organisasi.
  6. Terbiasa melakukan public speaking, membawakan sesi pelatihan, atau menjadi fasilitator diskusi.
  7. Mampu berpikir analitis dan memiliki pendekatan solutif terhadap masalah ketenagakerjaan.
  8. Memiliki kemampuan menyusun materi pelatihan dan program pengembangan karyawan.
  9. Menguasai Microsoft Office dan tools presentasi (PowerPoint, Canva, dsb).
  10. Memiliki integritas tinggi, inisiatif, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun tim.

jobs.title: Service Center Supervisor
jobs.description: Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field Min. 3 years of experience as an Aftersales / Service Center Supervisor, preferably in multi-branch operations. Strong technical background in equipment repair, troubleshooting, and spare part forecasting/demand planning. Proven leadership, analytical thinking, quality control, and cross-branch management skills. Willingness to travel frequently/periodically for site visits and branch audits. Key Responsibilities: Supervise, evaluate, and technical-upskill service center teams across all locations to ensure high operational throughput and service consistency. Lead complex repair, troubleshooting, and maintenance operations while enforcing strict QA/QC standards and safety protocols. Collaborate with the warehouse team to forecast spare part requirements, monitor usage rates, and ensure part availability to minimize repair downtime. Resolve high-level customer complaints and analyze operational data to optimize repair workflows and report performance trends to management. Conduct routine business trips to audit branch operations, enforce SOP compliance, and drive KPI improvements (SLA, repair quality, customer satisfaction).

jobs.title: Head Of Procurement
jobs.description: Job Descriptions : Develop and execute the overall procurement strategy aligned with business objectives, expansion plans, and company requirements. Lead strategic sourcing, purchasing, and supplier management for food ingredients, packaging, equipment, services, and other business requirements. Drive cost optimization, savings initiatives, and commercial negotiations while maintaining quality and service standards. Manage and develop relationships with key suppliers, including supplier selection, evaluation, performance monitoring, and contract negotiation . Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, SOPs, governance, and applicable regulations. Establish and monitor procurement KPIs, budgets, service levels, and supplier performance. Manage procurement risks, including supply continuity, price fluctuations, supplier dependency, and business continuity . Job Requirements : Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Engineering, or a related field . Minimum 10 years of experience in Procurement/Purchasing , with at least 3–5 years in a managerial or leadership position . Strong experience in Retail, F&B, QSR, FMCG, or other fast-paced consumer businesses is highly preferred. Proven track record in strategic sourcing, cost optimization, supplier management, and commercial negotiation . Strong understanding of procurement processes, contract management, supplier evaluation, and procurement governance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to support procurement decisions. Experience in procurement systems/ERP and digital procurement tools . Strong leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills. Able to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, and highly collaborative environment . Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal. Willing to work and be mobile between the Head Office and warehouse locations as required

jobs.title: Freelance Packer
jobs.description: Job Overview Freelance Packer bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan seluruh proses packing barang berjalan rapi, cepat, dan sesuai standar sebelum dikirim ke customer atau store Torch. Role: Melakukan proses packing produk sesuai SOP yang berlaku Memastikan jenis, jumlah, dan kondisi barang yang di- pack sesuai dengan data Menjaga kualitas dan kerapihan packing (aman & layak kirim) Membantu proses sorting & labeling barang sebelum pengiriman Melaporkan jika ada barang rusak / tidak sesuai Menjaga kebersihan dan kerapihan area kerja Bekerja sama dengan tim terkait untuk memastikan proses berjalan lancar. Requirement: Minimal pendidikan SMA/SMK atau sederajat Memiliki ketelitian yang baik dan cekatan Mampu bekerja dengan target harian Memiliki fisik yang cukup kuat untuk aktivitas operasional (angkat, susun barang) Disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan tepat waktu Bersedia bekerja secara freelance / harian (shift-based) Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman di warehouse / packing / logistik. Bersedia ditempatkan di Torch Bandung.

jobs.description: Jobdesk: · Menjadi host dalam sesi live streaming di TikTok, Shopee, Instagram, atau platform lainnya. · Mempresentasikan dan menjelaskan produk secara menarik, jelas, dan persuasif. · Berinteraksi aktif dengan penonton melalui komentar, pertanyaan, dan respons selama live. · Meningkatkan engagement, jumlah penonton, serta penjualan selama sesi live. · Membuat suasana live yang seru, komunikatif, dan tidak membosankan. · Menjalankan promo, voucher, giveaway, dan program penjualan sesuai arahan. · Menjaga image dan komunikasi yang baik sesuai standar perusahaan/brand. · Bekerja sama dengan tim untuk menyiapkan materi, produk, dan konsep live. · Melakukan evaluasi hasil live dan mengikuti target yang telah ditentukan. Kami sedang mencari Finance Accounting Tax Manager yang strategis, detail-oriented, dan memiliki kemampuan analitis yang kuat untuk memimpin fungsi Finance, Accounting & Tax perusahaan secara menyeluruh. Posisi ini akan berperan penting dalam memastikan kesehatan finansial perusahaan, kepatuhan perpajakan, efisiensi operasional, serta penguatan kontrol internal di lingkungan bisnis retail, wholesale, dan impor yang dinamis.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Menyusun laporan keuangan bulanan, kuartalan, dan tahunan (Profit & Loss, Neraca, Arus Kas) sesuai PSAK/IFRS

  • Menyajikan analisis mendalam terkait performa bisnis, kondisi keuangan, dan cash flow perusahaan

  • Melakukan variance analysis dan performance review beserta insight yang dapat digunakan manajemen dalam pengambilan keputusan

  • Memastikan proses monthly closing berjalan tepat waktu dan akurat

Cash Flow Management

  • Mengelola perencanaan, monitoring, dan analisis arus kas perusahaan secara menyeluruh

  • Membuat proyeksi kebutuhan kas dan mengidentifikasi potensi risiko finansial secara proaktif

  • Mengoptimalkan working capital untuk operasional retail, wholesale, dan import

  • Mengawasi pengelolaan rekening bank, transaksi harian, dan kontrol pergerakan dana

Tax Compliance & Planning

  • Menangani kepatuhan perpajakan perusahaan meliputi PPN, PPh 21/23/25/26/29, dan PPh Badan

  • Memastikan seluruh pelaporan pajak bulanan dan tahunan dilakukan tepat waktu dan akurat

  • Mengelola perpajakan impor dan berkoordinasi dengan DJBC maupun DJP

  • Menjalankan tax planning untuk optimalisasi pajak perusahaan secara legal dan efisien

  • Mengelola transfer pricing documentation dan risiko perpajakan pada struktur multi-entitas

  • Memantau perubahan regulasi perpajakan dan mengevaluasi dampaknya terhadap bisnis

Inventory & Procurement Control

  • Mengawasi inventory accounting termasuk costing, valuasi, dan rekonsiliasi stok

  • Membuat stock forecasting dan reorder planning berdasarkan tren penjualan dan lead time

  • Menganalisis pola pembelian, harga supplier, serta efisiensi procurement

  • Membangun kontrol keuangan untuk meminimalkan fraud, overbilling, dan potensi kolusi pada proses purchasing

Multi-Entity & Intercompany Accounting

  • Mengelola proses accounting dan financial reporting lintas entitas perusahaan

  • Melakukan rekonsiliasi transaksi intercompany serta eliminasi yang tepat

  • Memastikan kepatuhan dan dokumentasi transfer pricing berjalan dengan baik

Import, Wholesale & Payroll Management

  • Mengelola pencatatan biaya impor termasuk bea masuk, freight, insurance, dan landed cost

  • Mengawasi account receivable wholesale, credit terms, aging, dan collection

  • Memastikan payroll processing berjalan akurat dan tepat waktu

  • Menjamin kepatuhan terkait PPh 21, BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, dan BPJS Kesehatan

Internal Control & Leadership

  • Merancang dan menerapkan kontrol internal yang efektif di seluruh fungsi finance dan operasional

  • Menyusun serta menegakkan SOP Finance, Accounting & Tax

  • Memimpin, mengembangkan, dan mengevaluasi performa tim FAT

  • Menjadi escalation point dan decision maker untuk tim


Requirements

  • Min 8 tahun pengalaman dalam bidang Keuangan, Akuntansi & Pajak

  • Min 5 tahun sebagai manager atau assistant manager

  • S1 Akuntansi, Keuangan, atau bidang terkait (wajib)

  • Sertifikasi CPA / CA atau pendidikan S2 menjadi nilai tambah

  • Wajib memiliki Brevet Pajak A & B (Memiliki Brevet C menjadi nilai tambah)

  • Memiliki pengalaman di industri retail, FMCG, import/trading, wholesale atau e-commerce

  • Berpengalaman menangani multi-entity accounting, intercompany transaction, dan transfer pricing

  • Memahami kepatuhan pajak Indonesia secara menyeluruh

  • Memahami penggunaan Accurate Accounting Software, Coretax dan Omnichannel (Pernah menggunakan Odoo menjadi nilai plus)

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Table, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial modeling, dynamic reporting)

  • Memahami PSAK dan regulasi perpajakan Indonesia

  • Berpengalaman membuat cash flow projection dan stock forecasting

  • Memahami proses payroll end-to-end

  • Strong analytical thinking, memiliki integritas dan sense of ownership yang tinggi

  • Detail-oriented dan mampu bekerja dengan deadline ketat

  • Komunikatif dan mampu menjelaskan insight keuangan kepada stakeholder non-finance

  • Proaktif dalam mengidentifikasi risiko dan problem solving

  • Memiliki leadership dan people management yang kuat

  • Bersedia bekerja full WFO di Pluit, Jakarta Utara

jobs.title: SUPERVISOR CLEANING SERVICE
jobs.description: Kami mencari Supervisor Cleaning Service yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT Dana Purna Investama, perusahaan Facility Management Service di Indonesia. Sebagai Supervisor Cleaning Service, Anda akan bertanggung jawab memastikan kebersihan dan kerapian seluruh area gedung. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengawasi dan memastikan seluruh area gedung. Membina, melatih, dan mengevaluasi kinerja tim kebersihan untuk memastikan standar kebersihan yang tinggi. Menyusun jadwal kerja dan penugasan bagi tim kebersihan secara efektif. Melakukan inspeksi rutin dan mengambil tindakan korektif jika diperlukan. Mengelola persediaan dan memastikan ketersediaan perlengkapan kebersihan. Mengidentifikasi peluang untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan efektivitas proses kebersihan gedung. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun sebagai Supervisor Cleaning Service di office/building/service property Memahami standar atas kebersihan area, kerapihan dan keindahan Memahami ruang lingkup kerja washroom hygine, pest control, garbage removal dan gondola Bisa membuat parameter standar kebersihan dan melakukan penilaian atas kinerja outsourching kebersihan tsb Mempunyai leadership yang kuat, tegas dan berwibawa, komunikatif, objektif. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik secara lisan maupun tertulis. Teliti, disiplin, dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan. Siap bekerja lembur

jobs.title: Host live
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Host Live yang berbakat dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim PT Semarak Media Bisnis di Jakarta Utara. Sebagai Host Live, Anda akan menjadi wajah dan suara brand kami dalam acara-acara media live yang menarik dan interaktif. Posisi ini memerlukan profesional yang karismatik, komunikatif, dan mampu mengelola situasi dengan percaya diri di depan kamera. Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam membangun engagement dengan audiens dan menyampaikan pesan brand secara efektif melalui berbagai platform media. Ini adalah posisi full-time yang berlokasi di Jakarta Utara . Tanggung Jawab Utama Memandu dan memandu acara live dengan presentasi yang profesional, energik, dan menarik sesuai dengan naskah dan arahan kreatif yang telah disiapkan. Berinteraksi secara real-time dengan audiens, merespons pertanyaan, dan memfasilitasi diskusi yang relevan dan engaging selama siaran langsung. Mengikuti timing yang ketat dan mengelola transisi antar segmen acara dengan lancar dan profesional. Berkolaborasi dengan tim produksi, tim kreatif, dan tim teknis untuk memastikan eksekusi acara yang sempurna. Menyesuaikan konten dan delivery berdasarkan feedback real-time dan dinamika audiens selama acara berlangsung. Mempersiapkan diri secara menyeluruh termasuk riset topik, pemahaman brand guidelines, dan penguasaan materi presentasi sebelum setiap acara. Mengembangkan kepribadian on-air yang konsisten dan autentik yang selaras dengan identitas brand PT Semarak Media Bisnis. Mendokumentasikan feedback dan insights dari setiap acara untuk perbaikan berkelanjutan. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman Diploma atau Sarjana dalam bidang Komunikasi, Jurnalisme, Broadcasting, atau bidang terkait diprioritaskan. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman sebagai Host Live, MC, atau presenter di media broadcast, event, atau platform digital. Kemampuan komunikasi verbal yang sangat baik dengan artikulasi jelas, intonasi natural, dan kontrol vokal yang profesional. Kepribadian yang karismatik, energik, dan mampu membangun rapport dengan audiens dengan cepat. Kenyamanan dan keahlian dalam bekerja di depan kamera dan dalam lingkungan live yang dinamis dan high-pressure. Kemampuan improvisasi dan adaptasi terhadap perubahan situasi atau kendala teknis tanpa mengganggu alur acara. Pengetahuan tentang media communications dan marketing yang mendukung pesan brand. Fleksibilitas dalam jadwal kerja, termasuk kemungkinan acara di luar jam kerja regular atau di akhir pekan. Pengalaman dengan media sosial dan platform digital streaming merupakan nilai tambah. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif dan sesuai dengan standar industri media dan komunikasi. Kesempatan pengembangan karier melalui pelatihan, workshop, dan mentoring dari profesional berpengalaman. Lingkungan kerja yang kreatif dan kolaboratif dengan tim yang supportif dan berprofesional. Eksposur media dan pengalaman yang berharga dalam industri broadcasting dan komunikasi. Fleksibilitas dalam bekerja dengan keseimbangan kehidupan kerja yang baik. Tentang PT Semarak Media Bisnis PT Semarak Media Bisnis adalah agensi digital yang sedang berkembang pesat dan berfokus penuh pada pemasaran serta periklanan digital. Kami membantu berbagai brand untuk meningkatkan penjualan online. Dengan fokus pada marketing communications yang strategis dan engaging, kami berkomitmen untuk membantu brand menyampaikan pesan mereka dengan efektif melalui berbagai platform media. Kami memiliki tim profesional yang bersemangat tentang kreativitas, keunggulan, dan storytelling yang autentik. Perusahaan kami menghargai keberagaman, inovasi, dan pengembangan bakat, menciptakan lingkungan kerja di mana setiap anggota tim dapat berkontribusi secara bermakna dan mencapai potensi penuh mereka. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda adalah Host Live yang berbakat dengan passion dalam komunikasi dan media, kami mengundang Anda untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Lamar sekarang dan mulai perjalanan karier Anda bersama PT Semarak Media Bisnis!

  • Conduct daily walk-throughs to verify EPC contractor physical progress against baseline schedule and report field bottlenecks immediately

  • High proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PPT)

  • Strong initiative with excellent communication and negotiation skill

  • Able to work with less supervision

  • Proficient in Japanese will be an advantage

jobs.title: KOL Specialist
jobs.description: Are you a beauty enthusiast who is passionate about social media, influencer marketing, and building strong relationships with KOLs? If you are highly organized, detail-oriented, and confident in negotiation, we are looking for you! PT Cantik Alami Sehat is continuously growing, and we are looking for a KOL Specialist who is ready to support our brand growth through effective influencer and social media campaigns. You will play an important role in identifying the right KOLs, managing influencer campaigns, negotiating collaborations, and analyzing campaign performance to drive brand awareness and business results. As a KOL Specialist, you will work closely with the Marketing and Brand teams to develop and execute influencer campaigns that align with our brand objectives. You will also have the opportunity to build strong relationships with KOLs, influencers, agencies, and content creators while staying up-to-date with the latest social media trends. Here are the qualifications you must have: Bachelor's degree (S1) in Marketing, Communication, Business, or a related field. Have 1–3 years of experience Beauty enthusiast with a strong interest in beauty, skincare, and lifestyle trends. Active and familiar with TikTok and Instagram Proven negotiation and communication skills Proficient in using social media analytics tools and preparing data-driven reports. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously. What will you do? Research, identify, and recruit relevant KOL, influencers, and content creators (nano to macro) aligned with brand goals End-to-end management of influencer campaigns, including dealing, administration process, scheduling posts, reviewing content for brand compliance, and tracking deliverables Lead outreach, negotiate rate cards and terms, manage contracts, and handle talent payments efficiently. Establish and maintain strong long-term relationships with KOLs, agencies, and talent management entities Monitor campaign performance metrics (Reach, Engagement, ROI, Conversion), evaluate success, and present actionable insights in weekly/monthly reports. Stay up-to-date with social media trends, platform updates (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube), and competitor influencer strategies.

jobs.title: Product Monitoring
jobs.description: Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal D3/S1, diutamakan dari bidang Sistem Informasi/Teknik Informatika/Ilmu komputer atau sebidangnya Memiliki pengalaman di bidang Product Monitoring, Purchasing, Procurement, Product Specialist, Sales Support, atau bidang terkait menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami cara mencari dan membandingkan produk, spesifikasi, serta harga dari berbagai supplier/distributor. Mampu melakukan analisis harga, perhitungan margin, dan perbandingan harga supplier. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan negosiasi yang baik dengan supplier maupun pihak internal. Mampu menggunakan Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets, terutama untuk pengolahan dan perbandingan data. Teliti dalam melakukan pengecekan spesifikasi, harga, tipe, dan informasi produk. Mampu bekerja dengan target dan deadline serta memiliki kemampuan mencari informasi secara cepat dan akurat. Memiliki kemampuan problem solving dan mampu mencari alternatif produk ketika terdapat kendala harga, stok, maupun spesifikasi. Mampu bekerja sama dengan Sales, Purchasing, Tender, dan divisi terkait. Memiliki inisiatif, ketelitian, tanggung jawab, dan kemampuan belajar produk baru dengan cepat.

jobs.title: SPA SUPERVISOR
jobs.description: About the role As Spa Supervisor, you will be responsible for the day-to-day supervision of the team and the overall standards of the spa. You will be the eyes and ears on the floor — making sure our team is performing at their best, our spaces are always guest-ready and our operations run smoothly. jobs.description: About the role As a KOL Specialist , – Facebook & Instagram Creator Partnership Job Description We are looking for a proactive and results-driven KOL to develop Puainta’s Facebook and Instagram creator network and build long-term partnerships with pet influencers and content creators. The main responsibility of this role is to identify, approach, and establish relationships with relevant creators to support brand awareness, product exposure, and sales growth. Social media account operation will be a secondary responsibility. Key Responsibilities 1. Creator & Influencer Partnership – Main Responsibility Research and identify potential pet creators and influencers on Facebook and Instagram. Proactively reach out to creators and establish collaboration opportunities. Build and maintain long-term relationships with creators. Negotiate collaboration terms, including commission-based and paid-posting partnerships. Manage creator communication and follow-ups from initial outreach until collaboration completion. Expand and maintain a creator database for future campaigns. Coordinate product seeding and creator campaigns. Ensure creators follow campaign briefs and agreed collaboration requirements. Collect published content links and Partnership Ad Codes from creators for paid advertising purposes. Monitor creator performance and identify high-potential creators for continued collaboration. 2. Facebook & Instagram Account Operation – Secondary Responsibility Manage Brand Facebook and Instagram accounts on a daily basis. Publish 2–3 posts per day according to the content plan. Maintain consistent brand tone, style, and positioning. Create and manage weekly giveaway activities to increase engagement and follower growth. Monitor and respond to comments and direct messages. Support organic audience growth and account engagement. Coordinate with the relevant team for content materials, visuals, and promotional activities. 3. Performance Tracking & Optimization Track creator collaboration performance, content engagement, and sales results. Conduct weekly reviews of social media and creator performance. Identify successful creators, content formats, and collaboration methods. Provide insights and recommendations to improve creator acquisition and partnership performance. Support monthly performance reviews and future creator strategy planning. Requirements 1–3 years of experience in influencer marketing, KOL/creator management, business development, social media, affiliate marketing, or a related field. Experience working with Facebook and Instagram creators is highly preferred. Strong communication and negotiation skills. Proactive and comfortable with cold outreach and approaching new creators. Able to build and maintain good relationships with creators. Good understanding of social media trends and creator ecosystems. Strong follow-up and organizational skills. Able to work independently and manage multiple creator collaborations simultaneously. Experience in the pet industry, e-commerce, affiliate marketing, or FMCG is a plus. Data-oriented and comfortable tracking campaign and creator performance. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Number of new relevant creators identified and contacted. Number of creators successfully onboarded. Number of active creator partnerships. Creator collaboration and conversion performance. Creator-generated sales / GMV. Creator retention and repeat collaboration rate. Facebook & Instagram follower and engagement growth. Consistency of social media content publication. Preferred Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is not only good at managing social media, but more importantly, is comfortable with hunting, approaching, negotiating, and building relationships with creators . Candidates with strong communication skills, high initiative, and a “don't wait for creators to come to us” mindset are highly preferred.

About the role

As a KOL Specialist , – Facebook & Instagram Creator Partnership

Job Description

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven KOL to develop Puainta’s Facebook and Instagram creator network and build long-term partnerships with pet influencers and content creators.

The main responsibility of this role is to identify, approach, and establish relationships with relevant creators to support brand awareness, product exposure, and sales growth. Social media account operation will be a secondary responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

1. Creator & Influencer Partnership – Main Responsibility

  • Research and identify potential pet creators and influencers on Facebook and Instagram.

  • Proactively reach out to creators and establish collaboration opportunities.

  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with creators.

  • Negotiate collaboration terms, including commission-based and paid-posting partnerships.

  • Manage creator communication and follow-ups from initial outreach until collaboration completion.

  • Expand and maintain a creator database for future campaigns.

  • Coordinate product seeding and creator campaigns.

  • Ensure creators follow campaign briefs and agreed collaboration requirements.

  • Collect published content links and Partnership Ad Codes from creators for paid advertising purposes.

  • Monitor creator performance and identify high-potential creators for continued collaboration.

2. Facebook & Instagram Account Operation – Secondary Responsibility

  • Manage Brand Facebook and Instagram accounts on a daily basis.

  • Publish 2–3 posts per day according to the content plan.

  • Maintain consistent brand tone, style, and positioning.

  • Create and manage weekly giveaway activities to increase engagement and follower growth.

  • Monitor and respond to comments and direct messages.

  • Support organic audience growth and account engagement.

  • Coordinate with the relevant team for content materials, visuals, and promotional activities.

3. Performance Tracking & Optimization

  • Track creator collaboration performance, content engagement, and sales results.

  • Conduct weekly reviews of social media and creator performance.

  • Identify successful creators, content formats, and collaboration methods.

  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve creator acquisition and partnership performance.

  • Support monthly performance reviews and future creator strategy planning.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in influencer marketing, KOL/creator management, business development, social media, affiliate marketing, or a related field.

  • Experience working with Facebook and Instagram creators is highly preferred.

  • Strong communication and negotiation skills.

  • Proactive and comfortable with cold outreach and approaching new creators.

  • Able to build and maintain good relationships with creators.

  • Good understanding of social media trends and creator ecosystems.

  • Strong follow-up and organizational skills.

  • Able to work independently and manage multiple creator collaborations simultaneously.

  • Experience in the pet industry, e-commerce, affiliate marketing, or FMCG is a plus.

  • Data-oriented and comfortable tracking campaign and creator performance.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Number of new relevant creators identified and contacted.

  • Number of creators successfully onboarded.

  • Number of active creator partnerships.

  • Creator collaboration and conversion performance.

  • Creator-generated sales / GMV.

  • Creator retention and repeat collaboration rate.

  • Facebook & Instagram follower and engagement growth.

  • Consistency of social media content publication.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is not only good at managing social media, but more importantly, is comfortable with hunting, approaching, negotiating, and building relationships with creators.

Candidates with strong communication skills, high initiative, and a “don't wait for creators to come to us” mindset are highly preferred.

jobs.title: Functional Consultant Financial Module
jobs.description: Support the implementation and maintenance of ERP Financial modules based on business requirements. Assist in gathering and analyzing business and functional requirements from users. Translate business requirements into functional specifications for system configuration and development. Assist in the configuration and setup of ERP Financial modules according to business processes and requirements. Work closely with Business Users, Technical Consultants, Developers, and other stakeholders to ensure functional requirements are properly addressed. Prepare and maintain functional documentation, including business requirements, functional specifications, and process documentation. Support system testing, integration testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test case preparation and issue tracking. Analyze and troubleshoot functional issues and coordinate with technical teams when further technical investigation is required. Provide user support and assistance related to ERP Financial module functionality and business processes. Assist in data validation, reconciliation, and other activities required during ERP implementation or enhancement projects. Participate in project meetings and provide regular updates regarding assigned tasks and functional activities. Support the preparation of user guides, training materials, and knowledge transfer for ERP Financial users.
