Monitoring aktivitas sales, prospek, SPK, approval leasing, delivery, dan indikator operasional lainnya. Melakukan review pelaksanaan program kerja, aktivitas penjualan, dan kebijakan perusahaan yang sedang berjalan di cabang. Memastikan implementasi program, kebijakan, dan standar operasional perusahaan di cabang. Mengumpulkan dan menganalisis data penjualan serta operasional sebagai bahan evaluasi Region Head. Menyusun laporan kinerja harian, mingguan, dan bulanan wilayah. Melakukan evaluasi kinerja cabang, tim, dan dealer. Melakukan analisis pasar dan kompetitor untuk mengidentifikasi peluang dan risiko. Mendukung Region Head dalam penyusunan strategi, evaluasi kinerja, dan pengembangan wilayah. Mendukung kajian peluang ekspansi dan pengembangan dealer baru. Kualifikasi: Minimal S1 dari semua jurusan. Minimal 3–4 tahun pengalaman di bidang Sales, Business Development, atau Operasional. Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Supervisor atau Coordinator. Berpengalaman dalam monitoring dan evaluasi performa multi-cabang/multi-dealer . Memahami sales performance, KPI, analisis target, dan operasional cabang . Memiliki kemampuan analisis data, problem solving, leadership, dan komunikasi yang baik. Berorientasi pada target dan hasil , proaktif, serta mampu bekerja mandiri. Menguasai Microsoft Office , khususnya Excel dan PowerPoint. Bersedia melakukan kunjungan/perjalanan dinas ke cabang Pengalaman di industri otomotif/dealer/leasing menjadi nilai tambah.

jobs.title: Management Trainee (Branch Medan)
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Management Trainee yang bersemangat dan berbakat untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT Batik Sukses Sejahtera di Medan, Sumatera Utara. Sebagai Management Trainee, Anda akan memulai perjalanan pengembangan karir yang komprehensif dengan kesempatan untuk belajar langsung dari para pemimpin berpengalaman di organisasi kami. Posisi ini menawarkan pengalaman praktis dalam berbagai aspek operasional, termasuk manajemen sumber daya manusia, perencanaan proyek, dan kepemimpinan tim. Anda akan menjadi bagian integral dari tim yang berdedikasi untuk memberikan layanan berkualitas tinggi di industri perdagangan dan jasa. Ini adalah posisi penuh waktu yang berbasis di Medan, Sumatera Utara, di mana Anda akan mengembangkan keterampilan kepemimpinan yang kuat sambil berkontribusi pada kesuksesan cabang kami. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mendukung operasional harian cabang dan membantu manajemen senior dalam pelaksanaan strategi bisnis. Mengembangkan pemahaman mendalam tentang proses operasional, termasuk manajemen inventori, pengelolaan kualitas, dan efisiensi biaya. Membantu dalam perencanaan dan pelaksanaan proyek-proyek strategis yang mendukung pertumbuhan cabang. Melakukan monitoring terhadap performa tim dan memberikan dukungan dalam mencapai target yang ditetapkan. Mengidentifikasi peluang peningkatan proses dan mengajukan rekomendasi untuk optimalisasi operasional. Membangun hubungan profesional dengan klien, mitra bisnis, dan anggota tim internal. Mendokumentasikan pembelajaran dan pengalaman selama program pelatihan manajemen. Mengikuti sesi pelatihan dan pengembangan yang dirancang untuk membangun kompetensi manajerial. jobs.title: TAX ACCOUNTING
jobs.description: Job Descriptions: Melakukan perhitungan pajak, pelaporan, dan administrasi pajak untuk perusahaan sesuai dengan peraturan perpajakan yang berlaku. Memastikan semua transaksi dan dokumen perpajakan sesuai dengan peraturan yang berlaku. Menyusun dan mencocokkan data perpajakan dengan laporan keuangan. Berkoordinasi dengan pihak internal dan eksternal terkait urusan perpajakan, termasuk proses audit jika diperlukan. Memberikan masukan dan rekomendasi mengenai hal-hal yang berkaitan dengan perpajakan untuk mendukung kepatuhan. Job Requirements: Minimal gelar sarjana di bidang Akuntansi dengan IPK minimal 3,00 (skala 4,00). Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang Pajak atau Akuntansi Pajak. Memahami peraturan perpajakan Indonesia dan proses pelaporan pajak. Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Office, khususnya Microsoft Excel. Memiliki kemampuan analitis yang kuat, teliti, bertanggung jawab, mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan, dan menjaga kerahasiaan data. jobs.description: Menyusun serta mengawal rencana strategis dan program pengembangan institusi untuk meningkatkan kualitas dan daya saing perguruan tinggi. Mengawasi pelaksanaan Tri Dharma Perguruan Tinggi yang meliputi pendidikan, penelitian, dan pengabdian kepada masyarakat. Mendorong inovasi dan pengembangan institusi agar mampu beradaptasi dengan perkembangan pendidikan dan kebutuhan dunia kesehatan. Melakukan evaluasi kinerja institusi serta menetapkan langkah perbaikan dan pengembangan secara berkelanjutan. Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal S2 di bidang kesehatan. Memiliki integritas, komunikasi yang baik dan orientasi pada peningkatan mutu pendidikan. Memiliki kemampuan analisis, ketelitian dan akurasi yang tinggi dalam mengelola data. Memiliki kemampuan kepemimpinan dan pengambilan keputusan strategis yang kuat.

jobs.title: Admin Warehouse
jobs.description: Menerima dan mencatat seluruh barang yang masuk ke gudang sesuai dengan dokumen penerimaan. Mengklasifikasikan dan menata barang berdasarkan jenis, kategori, atau lokasi penyimpanan yang telah ditentukan. Melakukan pencocokan data barang dengan jumlah stok fisik untuk memastikan keakuratan inventaris. Melaksanakan pengecekan stok barang secara berkala serta melaporkan apabila terdapat selisih stok. Melakukan pengawasan terhadap masa kedaluwarsa produk dan memastikan penerapan sistem penyimpanan yang sesuai (FIFO/FEFO). Menjaga kerapihan, kebersihan, dan keamanan area gudang. Berkoordinasi dengan tim terkait dalam proses penerimaan, penyimpanan, dan pengeluaran barang. Memastikan seluruh aktivitas operasional gudang berjalan sesuai dengan prosedur perusahaan.

Prana Home Development creates villas designed for deep rest, healing, and genuine recovery — spaces built with real craftsmanship, real materials, and zero shortcuts. Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM

jobs.title: Engineering Staff
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT Melium Nusantara (Seminyak Village) mencari Engineering Staff yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Bali. Sebagai Engineering Staff, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam memastikan operasional fasilitas dan infrastruktur berjalan dengan optimal. Posisi ini menuntut profesional yang memiliki keahlian teknis yang kuat, perhatian terhadap detail, dan kemampuan untuk menyelesaikan masalah dengan efisien. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi full-time yang berbasis di Bali, memungkinkan Anda untuk bekerja dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan mendukung pertumbuhan properti premium kami. jobs.title: Head of HRGA
jobs.description: Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab: Menentukan arah dan tujuan departemen HR yang mendukung visi dan misi perusahaan secara keseluruhan. Membimbing, melatih, dan memotivasi tim HR untuk mencapai target yang ditetapkan, menurut beberapa sumber. Membuat dan memastikan implementasi kebijakan dan prosedur HR yang efektif dan sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan. Memastikan proses rekrutmen dan seleksi berjalan lancar dan menghasilkan karyawan yang berkualitas sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan, menurut beberapa sumber. Merencanakan dan melaksanakan program pelatihan dan pengembangan untuk meningkatkan kompetensi karyawan dan mempersiapkan mereka untuk jenjang karir yang lebih tinggi. Merancang dan mengelola sistem kompensasi dan benefit yang menarik dan kompetitif untuk memotivasi karyawan dan meningkatkan retensi. Membangun dan memelihara hubungan yang baik antara perusahaan dan karyawan, serta menyelesaikan masalah terkait hubungan industrial. Melakukan evaluasi kinerja karyawan secara berkala dan memberikan umpan balik untuk perbaikan. Memastikan bahwa semua kegiatan HR sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Berperan aktif dalam membangun dan memelihara budaya perusahaan yang positif dan produktif. Mengumpulkan, menganalisis, dan menggunakan data HR untuk membuat keputusan yang tepat dan strategis, menurut beberapa sumber. Kualifikasi: Usia maksimal 45 tahun Pengalaman bekerja sebagai HR&GA Direktur atau HR&GA Chief selama 5 tahun di bidang Retail atau Distribusi Elektronik Mahir dalam pembuatan SOP dan KPI Terbiasa mengurus lebih dari 2000 karyawan Terbiasa bekerja tepat, cepat, dan teliti Logical thinker dan decision maker Terbiasa follow-up pekerjaan kepada CEO atau Owner

jobs.title: Kapster
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Kapster berpengalaman dan berpassion untuk bergabung dengan tim Oligarki Barbershop Tulungagung. Sebagai Kapster, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam memberikan layanan potong rambut dan perawatan rambut berkualitas tinggi kepada pelanggan kami. Posisi ini menawarkan kesempatan untuk menunjukkan keterampilan profesional Anda, membangun hubungan jangka panjang dengan klien, dan berkontribusi pada reputasi excellence yang kami jaga. Ini adalah posisi paruh waktu yang fleksibel, memungkinkan Anda untuk menyeimbangkan komitmen lainnya sambil mengembangkan karir di industri kecantikan rambut. Tanggung Jawab Utama Memberikan layanan potong rambut, styling, dan perawatan rambut berkualitas tinggi sesuai dengan preferensi dan kebutuhan pelanggan Berkonsultasi dengan pelanggan untuk memahami keinginan mereka dan merekomendasikan gaya rambut yang sesuai dengan fitur wajah dan preferensi pribadi Menggunakan peralatan dan produk perawatan rambut profesional dengan aman dan higienis Menjaga standar kebersihan dan sanitasi tertinggi di area kerja sesuai dengan protokol kesehatan Membangun dan mempertahankan hubungan positif dengan pelanggan untuk mendorong loyalitas dan referensi Menangani transaksi pembayaran dengan akurat dan profesional Tetap update dengan tren terbaru dalam styling rambut dan teknik pemotongan Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Kami mencari Kapster berpengalaman dan berpassion untuk bergabung dengan tim Oligarki Barbershop Tulungagung.   • Menggunakan peralatan dan produk perawatan rambut profesional dengan aman dan higienis

  • Menjaga standar kebersihan dan sanitasi tertinggi di area kerja sesuai dengan protokol kesehatan

  • Membangun dan mempertahankan hubungan positif dengan pelanggan untuk mendorong loyalitas dan referensi

  • Menangani transaksi pembayaran dengan akurat dan profesional

  • Akses ke produk perawatan rambut berkualitas premium untuk penggunaan profesional

jobs.title: Dispatcher (Transport Planner)
jobs.description: Dispatcher bertanggung jawab mengelola operasional armada harian, termasuk koordinasi pengemudi, perencanaan rute, dan pengelolaan SLA. Memantau pemeliharaan kendaraan serta pemeriksaan sebelum perjalanan, menangani komunikasi dengan pelanggan terkait status pengiriman, dan mengelola dokumentasi administratif yang penting. Key responsibilities Mengatur unit & driver Mengatur Route Plan (SLA management) Monitor Driver (kepatuhan SOP, cuci unit, precooling, kelengkapan unit, dll) Koordinasi dengan customer (update pengiriman/ handle daily problem) Koordinasi dengan mekanik apabila ada perbaikan/ kendala unit Monitor all daily shipment & Pre trip inspection (PTI) sesuai shiftnya Administration (DO, UJP, dll) About you Lulusan S1 bidang Administrasi, Manajemen Logistik, Transportasi, atau bidang terkait Minimum 1-3 tahun pengalaman dalam bidang administrasi, logistik atau transportasi Familiar dengan sistem manajemen transportasi dan perangkat lunak pelacakan kendaraan (GPS, TMS) Kemampuan dalam penggunaan software administrasi dan manajemen data Kemampuan dalam pemecahan masalah yang baik Kemampuan dalam mengoperasikan Microsoft Office seperti Excel, Word, dan PowerPoint Bersedia shift malam

jobs.title: SMKP AUDITOR / MINING SAFETY AUDITOR
jobs.description: SMKP AUDITOR / MINING SAFETY AUDITOR Industri: Pertambangan / Jasa Pertambangan Job Description Melaksanakan audit internal Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Pertambangan (SMKP) sesuai dengan ketentuan dan standar yang berlaku di sektor pertambangan. Melakukan evaluasi terhadap penerapan SMKP di lingkungan perusahaan dan/atau area operasional pertambangan. Memastikan pelaksanaan kegiatan perusahaan memenuhi ketentuan keselamatan pertambangan serta persyaratan yang berlaku bagi perusahaan pemegang IUJP. Mengidentifikasi temuan audit, ketidaksesuaian, risiko, serta area yang memerlukan perbaikan. Menyusun laporan hasil audit SMKP beserta rekomendasi dan rencana tindak lanjut. Melakukan monitoring terhadap penyelesaian temuan dan tindakan perbaikan hasil audit. Berkoordinasi dengan Departemen HSE/Safety, operasional, manajemen, dan departemen terkait dalam pelaksanaan dan tindak lanjut audit. Membantu perusahaan dalam mempersiapkan dokumen dan administrasi yang berkaitan dengan penerapan serta audit SMKP. Memastikan dokumentasi audit, bukti pelaksanaan, dan laporan SMKP tersusun dengan baik dan sesuai ketentuan. Mengikuti perkembangan peraturan Kementerian ESDM dan ketentuan keselamatan pertambangan yang berkaitan dengan SMKP dan kegiatan usaha jasa pertambangan. Requirements Pendidikan minimal D3/S1, diutamakan dari jurusan Teknik Pertambangan, Teknik Geologi, K3, Teknik Industri, atau bidang terkait. Wajib memiliki pengalaman melakukan audit di perusahaan pertambangan atau perusahaan jasa pertambangan. Wajib memiliki sertifikat Auditor SMKP yang relevan dan masih dapat digunakan sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku. Sertifikat/kompetensi auditor wajib memiliki nomor registrasi atau pengakuan yang dipersyaratkan oleh Kementerian ESDM/Kepala Inspektur Tambang (KaIT), sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku. Memahami Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Pertambangan (SMKP) dan penerapannya di perusahaan pertambangan/IUJP. Memahami regulasi keselamatan pertambangan dan ketentuan Kementerian ESDM terkait kegiatan usaha jasa pertambangan. Memiliki kemampuan melakukan audit, menyusun laporan audit, mengidentifikasi ketidaksesuaian, serta memberikan rekomendasi tindakan perbaikan. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik serta mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas dan/atau bekerja di lokasi proyek/site pertambangan apabila diperlukan. Memiliki sertifikat POP (Pengawas Operasional Pertama) dan/atau POM (Pengawas Operasional Madya) menjadi nilai tambah .

jobs.title: Quality Assurance
jobs.description: Receive Impact Analysis Document, design comprehensive test scenarios covering happy path, edge cases, negative cases, and integration points. Execute manual testing for critical transactional flows where automated validation is insufficient. Leverage AI-generated test cases as baseline. Validate completeness, add domain-specific scenarios, and refine coverage. Critically assess AI output rather than accept without review. Collaborate with PO during UAT sessions. Provide technical support when users encounter issues, help reproduce bugs, and ensure test evidence is properly documented. Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected vs actual results, severity classification, and supporting evidence (logs, screenshots, API traces). Sebagai One Stop Korean Food yang Menyajikan Kenikmatan serta Cita Rasa Makanan dan Minuman Khas Korea Selatan, Haewoo Lahir dari Kecintaan Kami Terhadap Kekayaan dan Kecantikan Budaya Negeri Ginseng. Melalui Haewoo, Kami Berharap dapat Mengenalkan Keindahannya Kepada Lebih Banyak Orang, Terlebih Lagi Masyarakat Indonesia. Setiap Menu yang Ada di Haewoo One Stop Korean Food Telah Dikurasi dengan Baik dan Diproduksi dengan Fasilitas Kelas Dunia serta Operasi Prosedur Standar oleh Team & Management yang Berpengalaman di Bidangnya.

Glory Food Indonesia (Est 1 April 2014), Perusahaan Berkembang yang Berfokus Untuk Menjadi The Leading F&B Company in the World, dengan Berbagai Product dan Brand yang Telah Tersebar Secara Merata di Seluruh Kota Besar yang Ada di Indonesia. Dengan Berkarir di Haewoo, Kandidat Mempunyai Kesempatan untuk Melanjutkan Jenjang Karirnya di CV. Glory Food Indonesia.

We Believe that People is The Heart of the Company. Perusahaan Kami Sangat Mengapresiasi Talenta Unggul, dan Sangat Berfokus Dalam Membimbing dan Mengembangkan Team Untuk Mencapai Potensi Terbaik yang Dimilikinya, Melalui Berbagai Pelatihan Terstruktur dan Pembelajaran Langsung Sambil Bekerja (Kami Menggunakan Sistem Kerja yang Juga Dipakai oleh Perusahaan-Perusahaan Multinasional).

jobs.title: Barista
jobs.description: Part-Time Barista – DO BAR Coffee DO BAR Coffee sedang mencari Part-Time Barista yang memiliki ketertarikan pada dunia kopi, senang melayani pelanggan, dan siap berkembang bersama tim kami. jobs.title: Internal Audit Officer (Kediri)
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan: Melakukan audit operasional secara berkala di kantor cabang maupun area kerja yang ditentukan. Melakukan verifikasi atas laporan, data, dokumen, dan transaksi operasional. Memastikan aktivitas operasional cabang berjalan sesuai prosedur perusahaan. Mengidentifikasi temuan audit dan menyusun ringkasan hasil pemeriksaan. Membuat draft laporan audit secara jelas, akurat, dan tepat waktu. Berkoordinasi dengan tim terkait dalam proses tindak lanjut hasil audit. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal S1 dari semua jurusan, lebih disukai dari jurusan Akuntansi, Keuangan, Manajemen, atau bidang terkait. Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang audit, keuangan, atau operasional menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki kemampuan analisis, ketelitian, dan administrasi yang baik. Mampu mengumpulkan data, melakukan verifikasi dokumen, dan menyusun laporan. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan memiliki integritas kerja yang baik. Mampu menggunakan Microsoft Office, terutama Excel, Word, dan PowerPoint. Memiliki SIM C atau SIM A aktif. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas ke cabang-cabang Bina Artha Ventura. Bersedia ditempatkan dengan homebase di Kediri .

jobs.title: MANDOR BANGUNAN
jobs.description: Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab A. Pengawasan Pekerjaan Lapangan Mengawasi seluruh aktivitas pekerjaan pembangunan di lapangan. Memastikan pekerjaan dilaksanakan sesuai gambar kerja, spesifikasi, dan instruksi dari atasan. Memastikan kualitas hasil pekerjaan sesuai standar yang ditentukan. Mengawasi progres pekerjaan agar sesuai dengan target waktu yang telah ditetapkan. Mengidentifikasi kendala pekerjaan di lapangan dan segera melaporkannya kepada atasan. B. Pengelolaan Tenaga Kerja Mengatur dan membagi tugas tenaga kerja sesuai kebutuhan pekerjaan. Memberikan arahan dan instruksi kerja kepada tukang dan pekerja. Memastikan tenaga kerja bekerja sesuai standar dan prosedur yang berlaku. Memantau kedisiplinan, kehadiran, dan produktivitas tenaga kerja. Mengatur kebutuhan tenaga kerja berdasarkan progres dan jenis pekerjaan. C. Pengawasan Material dan Peralatan Memastikan ketersediaan material sesuai kebutuhan pekerjaan. Memantau penggunaan material agar efektif dan tidak terjadi pemborosan. Memeriksa kualitas dan jumlah material yang diterima di lokasi proyek. Mengawasi penggunaan serta kondisi peralatan kerja. Melaporkan kebutuhan material dan peralatan kepada pihak yang berwenang. D. Kontrol Progres Pembangunan Melakukan monitoring progres pekerjaan secara rutin. Membuat laporan perkembangan pekerjaan kepada atasan. Membandingkan progres aktual dengan target pekerjaan. Mengambil tindakan koordinatif apabila terjadi keterlambatan pekerjaan. Memastikan pekerjaan setiap tahap dapat diselesaikan sesuai jadwal. E. Koordinasi Berkoordinasi dengan Project Manager, Supervisor, bagian terkait, dan pihak lainnya dalam pelaksanaan pembangunan. Menyampaikan instruksi pekerjaan kepada tenaga kerja secara jelas. Melaporkan kendala, kebutuhan, dan perkembangan pekerjaan secara berkala. Berkoordinasi terkait perubahan pekerjaan atau kondisi lapangan yang memerlukan keputusan dari atasan.

  • Mengawasi progres pekerjaan agar sesuai dengan target waktu yang telah ditetapkan.

  • Mengidentifikasi kendala pekerjaan di lapangan dan segera melaporkannya kepada atasan.

B. Pengelolaan Tenaga Kerja

  • Mengatur dan membagi tugas tenaga kerja sesuai kebutuhan pekerjaan.

  • Memberikan arahan dan instruksi kerja kepada tukang dan pekerja.

  • Memastikan tenaga kerja bekerja sesuai standar dan prosedur yang berlaku.

  • Memantau kedisiplinan, kehadiran, dan produktivitas tenaga kerja.

  • Mengatur kebutuhan tenaga kerja berdasarkan progres dan jenis pekerjaan.

C. Pengawasan Material dan Peralatan

  • Memastikan ketersediaan material sesuai kebutuhan pekerjaan.

  • Memantau penggunaan material agar efektif dan tidak terjadi pemborosan.

  • Memeriksa kualitas dan jumlah material yang diterima di lokasi proyek.

  • Mengawasi penggunaan serta kondisi peralatan kerja.

  • Melaporkan kebutuhan material dan peralatan kepada pihak yang berwenang.

D. Kontrol Progres Pembangunan

  • Melakukan monitoring progres pekerjaan secara rutin.

  • Membuat laporan perkembangan pekerjaan kepada atasan.

  • Membandingkan progres aktual dengan target pekerjaan.

  • Mengambil tindakan koordinatif apabila terjadi keterlambatan pekerjaan.

  • Memastikan pekerjaan setiap tahap dapat diselesaikan sesuai jadwal.

E. Koordinasi

  • Berkoordinasi dengan Project Manager, Supervisor, bagian terkait, dan pihak lainnya dalam pelaksanaan pembangunan.

  • Menyampaikan instruksi pekerjaan kepada tenaga kerja secara jelas.

  • Melaporkan kendala, kebutuhan, dan perkembangan pekerjaan secara berkala.

  • Berkoordinasi terkait perubahan pekerjaan atau kondisi lapangan yang memerlukan keputusan dari atasan.

{"@context": "https://schema.org/", "@type": "JobPosting", "title": "Akuntan Keuangan", "description": "

  • Mampu mengoperasikan MS Excel (rekap data, rumus dasar/menengah) dan/atau software akuntansi.

  • Memiliki ketelitian yang tinggi, jujur, bertanggung jawab, dan memiliki kemampuan analisis yang baik.

jobs.title: Head IT - Fullstack Developer (Fintech P2P)
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab: Mengonseptualisasikan dan merumuskan aplikasi end-to-end yang sesuai, mencakup frontend untuk semua jenis perangkat Android dan backend menggunakan teknologi Java. Merancang, mengembangkan, dan memelihara API yang skalabel dan aman untuk mendukung interaksi platform P2P (peminjaman/pendanaan) dan aplikasi Android. Menerapkan langkah-langkah keamanan data tingkat tinggi untuk melindungi informasi sensitif pengguna dan transaksi keuangan sesuai regulasi Fintech. Memastikan bahwa konstruksi dan presentasi aplikasi (frontend dan backend) sesuai dengan standar dan arsitektur perusahaan. Memeriksa source code (full stack) dan memperbaiki kesalahan sebelum setiap fitur atau aplikasi dirilis. Memantau kinerja sistem dan tinjauan aplikasi untuk mendeteksi dan mengoptimalkan area yang perlu ditingkatkan, terutama pada isu latensi dan keamanan transaksi. Membuat pembaruan aplikasi dan sistem, termasuk perbaikan bug dan fitur tambahan (di sisi server dan client). Memiliki kemampuan Desainer UI/UX dan/atau Penguji Perangkat Lunak untuk memastikan user experience (UX) yang rapi dan fungsi yang sempurna. Persyaratan: Gelar di bidang pengembangan perangkat lunak, sarjana komputer, atau yang serupa. Mahir dalam bahasa pemrograman Java (termasuk framework seperti Spring Boot) untuk pengembangan backend. Mampu menggunakan Android Studio dan Android SDK dengan mudah. Pengalaman dalam merancang dan mengelola basis data (misalnya, SQL/NoSQL) serta mengembangkan RESTful API. Pengalaman sebelumnya sebagai Pengembang Full Stack di Perusahaan Fintech P2P (Peer-to-Peer) atau aplikasi keuangan lainnya merupakan nilai tambah utama. Keterampilan coding dan proofreading yang sangat baik, diutamakan untuk kode Java yang aman. Keterampilan kerja tim dan komunikasi yang unggul, mampu berkolaborasi antara tim frontend dan backend.

jobs.title: Delivery Engineer
jobs.description: Job Requirement: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Energy Engineering, or related fields. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in project delivery, installation, commissioning, or engineering, preferably in New Energy, Renewable Energy, BESS/ESS, Solar PV, EMS, or Microgrid. Proficient in English, both written and spoken Good understanding of electrical/power systems and energy storage systems. Experience in system integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and site project management. Able to read and understand electrical drawings and technical specifications. Strong coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills. Fluent in English and Mandarin, both written and spoken is preferred. Willing to travel and work at project sites as required. Job Description: Lead pre-sales activities for New Energy and Integrated Energy solutions, including Solar PV, BESS/ESS, EMS, Microgrid, and related solutions. Understand customer requirements and develop technical and commercial solutions. Prepare technical proposals, solution designs, BoQ/BOM, cost estimates, and tender documents. Conduct technical presentations, customer meetings, site surveys, and solution demonstrations. Work closely with Sales, Engineering, Product, and Project teams to support opportunities from initial assessment to contract award. Provide technical support during negotiations and ensure smooth project handover. Lead and develop the pre-sales team and maintain relationships with customers and technology partners.

jobs.title: Central Kitchen Manager ( FNB ) Restaurant
jobs.description: CENTRAL KITCHEN MANAGER 1. Tujuan Jabatan Bertanggung jawab atas keseluruhan operasional Central Kitchen , mulai dari perencanaan produksi, pengadaan dan penerimaan bahan baku, proses produksi, quality & food safety, inventory, hingga distribusi produk ke seluruh outlet dengan memastikan kualitas, konsistensi, efisiensi biaya, ketepatan waktu, dan standar keamanan pangan . 2. Job Description Area Tanggung Jawab Production Management : Mengatur seluruh proses produksi central kitchen sesuai forecast dan kebutuhan outlet. Production Planning : Menyusun production plan berdasarkan sales forecast, par stock, order outlet, dan kapasitas produksi. Raw Material Management : Memastikan ketersediaan bahan baku, kualitas bahan, quantity, dan spesifikasi sesuai standar. Inventory Management : Mengontrol stock bahan baku dan produk jadi, termasuk FIFO/FEFO dan stock accuracy. Quality Control : Memastikan konsistensi rasa, ukuran, kualitas, yield, dan standar produk sebelum dikirim ke outlet . Food Safety & Hygiene : Memastikan penerapan GMP, HACCP/food safety, hygiene, sanitasi, temperature control, dan SOP. Cost Control : Mengontrol food cost, production cost, waste, yield, overtime, utilities, dan manpower cost. Distribution : Memastikan produk dikirim ke outlet sesuai quantity, quality, temperature, dan delivery schedule. SOP & Standardization Membuat, menjalankan, mengevaluasi, dan memperbaiki SOP produksi central kitchen. Manpower Management : Mengatur manpower, shift, productivity, attendance, performance, dan development team. Equipment Management : Memastikan equipment produksi berfungsi dengan baik dan berkoordinasi dengan Engineering untuk maintenance. Waste Management : Mengidentifikasi dan mengurangi waste akibat overproduction, expired, production defect, dan handling error. Outlet Coordination : Berkoordinasi dengan Operations/Outlet mengenai kebutuhan produk, complaint, forecast, dan perubahan demand. R&D Coordination : Berkolaborasi dengan R&D dalam trial, scale-up recipe, standardisasi proses, dan implementasi produk baru. Problem Solving : Menangani production issue, shortage, quality issue, equipment breakdown, dan keterlambatan distribusi. Reporting : Membuat laporan production, inventory, waste, productivity, cost, quality, dan delivery performance. Continuous Improvement : Mengembangkan improvement untuk meningkatkan kapasitas, produktivitas, kualitas, dan efisiensi biaya. 3. Alur Tanggung Jawab Central Kitchen Forecast Outlet ↓ Production Planning ↓ Material Planning ↓ Receiving & QC Raw Material ↓ Preparation ↓ Production / Cooking ↓ Cooling / Packing ↓ QC & Food Safety Check ↓ Storage ↓ Distribution to Outlet ↓ Monitoring & Evaluation 4. Kualifikasi Pendidikan Minimal D3/S1 Food Technology, Food Science, Culinary, Hospitality, Management, Industrial Engineering, atau bidang terkait. Pendidikan Culinary/Food Technology menjadi nilai tambah. Pengalaman Minimal 5–7 tahun pengalaman di F&B, Central Kitchen, Catering, Food Manufacturing, atau Restaurant Chain . Minimal 2–3 tahun pada posisi Manager/Supervisor Central Kitchen/Production Manager/Kitchen Manager/Executive Chef . Berpengalaman mengelola high-volume production dan multiple outlets. Pengalaman mengelola central kitchen untuk multi-outlet menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki pengalaman dalam opening outlet/new product launch menjadi nilai tambah. Technical Skills Wajib memahami: Production planning & scheduling Food production management Food costing & cost control Inventory management FIFO & FEFO Yield & portion control Waste management Food safety & hygiene GMP, HACCP, SSOP Quality control Recipe & product standardization Manpower planning Productivity management Supply chain & distribution Basic P&L/COGS Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets HRIS/ERP/POS atau production system menjadi nilai tambah 5. Leadership Competency Central Kitchen Manager idealnya memiliki kemampuan: Leadership & People Management Planning & Organizing Problem Solving Analytical Thinking Decision Making Cost Consciousness Quality Orientation Time Management Communication Cross-functional Collaboration Continuous Improvement Attention to Detail

jobs.title: Corporate Secretary
jobs.description: Job Description: Manage corporate secretarial activities and ensure compliance with applicable regulations. Prepare and coordinate RUPS, Annual Report, Public Expose, and other corporate events. Prepare and submit reports, disclosures, and announcements to OJK, IDX, and other relevant authorities. Maintain corporate records, including minutes of meetings, resolutions, and legal documents. Support the implementation of Good Corporate Governance (GCG) practices. Monitor changes in OJK, IDX, capital market, and financing company regulations. Coordinate with internal departments, regulators, shareholders, and other stakeholders. Review and support the preparation of corporate documents and reports. Read, understand, and analyze financial statements. Perform other corporate secretarial duties as required. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in Corporate Secretary, Corporate Legal, or related roles, preferably in a publicly listed company or financing/multifinance company. Familiar with OJK, IDX, capital market, and financing company regulations . Experienced in handling RUPS, Annual Report, Public Expose, corporate disclosures, and GCG reporting . Able to read and understand financial statements. Strong communication, organizational, and documentation skills. Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to work independently or as part of a team

jobs.title: Procurement Specialist
jobs.description: Job Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or related field. Experience in major manufactures in the ICT, Data Center Industries, engineering or technology industries. At least 2 years of experience handling IT procurement, including hardware, software, networking equipment, cloud subscriptions, or IT services. Good knowledge about purchasing processes, local and international trade and commerce rules and best practices. Experience working with IT distributors, vendor and system integrators is preferred. Experience in procurement, vendor management, and contract negotiation. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and procurement reporting. Proficient in English, both written and spoken. Mandarin proficiency is an advantage. Job Description: Source and evaluate suppliers, vendors, and service providers. Request quotations and negotiate prices, terms, and contracts. Issue Purchase Orders (PO) and ensure timely procurement processes. Monitor delivery schedules and follow up with suppliers regarding order status. Coordinate with internal departments to understand purchasing requirements. Maintain procurement records, supplier databases, and contract documentation. Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and procedures. Analyze purchasing costs and identify cost-saving opportunities. Resolve issues related to product quality, delivery delays, and supplier performance.

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Modern Trade (MT)
jobs.description: About us PT Lock & Lock Indonesia is a leading provider of innovative kitchenware and home storage solutions. We are committed to delivering premium quality products that enhance everyday living for families across Indonesia. Our brand is built on principles of durability, innovation and customer satisfaction. We pride ourselves on our strong distribution network and our ability to meet the evolving needs of modern consumers. We are an ambitious, growth-focused organisation that values excellence, teamwork and continuous improvement. About the role We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Sales Manager – Modern Trade (MT) to join PT Lock & Lock Indonesia. This position is based in South Jakarta . As Sales Manager for Modern Trade, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and market penetration across modern retail channels, including hypermarkets, supermarkets, and department stores. This role is critical to our commercial strategy, as modern trade represents a significant distribution channel for our premium kitchenware and home products. You will lead a dedicated team, develop strategic partnerships with key retail accounts, and ensure optimal product visibility and sales performance across all modern trade outlets. Job Description Develop and manage the company's Modern Trade (MT) sales channel . Manage sales activities and maintain strong relationships with Modern Trade and discount store customers . Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve sales targets and business growth . Manage sales orders, product availability, and stock levels across MT channels. Monitor and manage inventory and stock movement to ensure optimal product availability. Coordinate with Warehouse, Supply Chain, and related departments to ensure smooth order fulfillment and inventory management. Monitor sales performance, inventory levels, sell-in/sell-out, and other key sales indicators. Prepare regular sales and inventory reports for management. Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to identify business opportunities. Manage promotions, sales programs, and product activities within MT channels. Conduct regular store and customer visits to monitor product display, stock availability, and sales performance. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field . Minimum 8 years of experience in Sales , with strong experience in Modern Trade / Retail / FMCG / Consumer Goods industries. Proven experience managing Modern Trade or discount store channels . Strong inventory and stock management experience is required. Good understanding of sales planning, inventory management, and order fulfillment . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in analyzing sales and inventory data . Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills. Proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving business growth. Strong leadership and team management skills. Good coordination skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams. Good command of English , both written and verbal. Korean language proficiency is a plus.

Mengelola KOL & Influencer Melakukan komunikasi, negosiasi, dan koordinasi dengan KOL/Influencer. Menyusun brief dan memastikan KOL/Influencer memahami campaign yang dijalankan. Melakukan evaluasi performa KOL berdasarkan reach, engagement, traffic, conversion, dan sales contribution. Mengembangkan Program Affiliate Menjalankan program dan campaign Affiliate untuk meningkatkan penjualan E-Commerce. Menjaga hubungan dan komunikasi dengan Affiliate agar tetap aktif dan produktif. Memantau performa Affiliate berdasarkan GMV, orders, conversion, revenue, dan ROI. Requirements : Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 dari semua jurusan, diutamakan Marketing, Komunikasi, Bisnis, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1–2 tahun di bidang E-Commerce, Digital Marketing, KOL/Influencer Management, Affiliate Marketing, atau Live Commerce. Memiliki pengalaman dalam mengelola KOL, influencer, dan affiliate, mulai dari pencarian talent, komunikasi, negosiasi, briefing, pelaksanaan campaign, hingga evaluasi performa. Memahami Live Commerce/Live Streaming, khususnya melalui TikTok Shop, Shopee, Tokopedia, atau platform sejenis. Mampu mencari dan mengembangkan KOL, Creator, dan Affiliate yang sesuai dengan target audience dan karakter brand. Memahami metrik performa E-Commerce dan Affiliate seperti GMV, Revenue, Conversion Rate, CTR, Engagement Rate, ROAS/ROI, Commission, dan Cost per Order. Mampu melakukan analisis performa Social Media dan E-Commerce serta memberikan rekomendasi berdasarkan data. Memahami tren media sosial, tren konten, dan perilaku audiens, terutama TikTok dan Instagram. Mampu menggunakan Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets untuk pengolahan dan analisis data. Mampu secara mandiri mengembangkan dan menjalankan aktivitas konten Social Media dan Social Commerce ketika aktivitas KOL dan Affiliate sedang Low. Penempatan di Batu Ceper , Kota Tangerang Jika anda adalah seorang yang kreatif & inovatif terhadap perkembangan jaman khususnya social media dan ingin membangun karir di Perusahaan Lighting & Electrical Products Terbesar dan Tersebar di Asia Tenggara PT. Mitra Amertha Sejahtera adalah perusahaan Principle dari merek MEVAL, a Regional Brand for Quality Lighting and Electrical Products: 1. Sebagai Exclusive Distributor dari produk Electrical Lighting dengan kualitas dan merek Global 2. Berkantor pusat di Singapore dengan wilayah operasional di Philiphines, Indonesia dan Vietnam 3. Memiliki Visi : We light up more worlds by providing more affordable durable lighting power solutions 4. Memiliki Value: Customer Satisfaction, Integrity, Continuous Improvement, Flexibility dan Commitment Benefits : Career Development Tunjangan Kesehatan Annual Bonus : berdasarkan kinerja perusahaan dan pribadi Opportunity to grow.

Key responsibilities Greet guests with warmth and professionalism, creating an elegant and memorable first impression Ensure the best guest experience by closely coordinating with servers and the entire service team Handle guest complaints calmly, quickly, and effectively to restore guest satisfaction Provide upselling training to staff so the team can naturally and effectively offer menu items or products Conduct second-visit table checks together with the Manager to ensure guests feel personally attended to and receive the highest service quality Deliver warm and memorable farewell greetings to guests, leaving them with a positive lasting impression Requirements Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Hospitality major Minimum 2 years of experience in Public Relations, preferably in the F&B or hospitality industry Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English Ability to create strategies to achieve sales targets Demonstrates great attitude and high integrity Customer-oriented with strong communication skills Able to work well in a team and has strong attention to detail

About the role

This is a Public Relations role in the hospitality and food & beverage industry, focused on guest experience management and service excellence.

Key responsibilities

  • Greet guests with warmth and professionalism, creating an elegant and memorable first impression

  • Ensure the best guest experience by closely coordinating with servers and the entire service team

  • Handle guest complaints calmly, quickly, and effectively to restore guest satisfaction

  • Provide upselling training to staff so the team can naturally and effectively offer menu items or products

  • Conduct second-visit table checks together with the Manager to ensure guests feel personally attended to and receive the highest service quality

  • Deliver warm and memorable farewell greetings to guests, leaving them with a positive lasting impression

Requirements

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Hospitality major

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Public Relations, preferably in the F&B or hospitality industry

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English

  • Ability to create strategies to achieve sales targets

  • Demonstrates great attitude and high integrity

  • Customer-oriented with strong communication skills

  • Able to work well in a team and has strong attention to detail

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Utama Membangun dan memelihara pipeline ETL/ELT dari sistem sumber yang disetujui lengkap dengan pemantauan. Merancang model data, struktur staging, dan data mart serta pemeriksaan kualitas data sejak data masuk. Mengotomatiskan penyiapan laporan berulang yang saat ini masih dirakit manual. Mengatur lineage, metadata, retensi dan hak akses data bersama fungsi IT Governance, Risk & Compliance. Mendampingi pengguna bisnis dengan data terdokumentasi dan menanggapi pertanyaan kualitas data. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal S1 dalam Ilmu Komputer, Teknik Informatika, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3-5 tahun pengalaman sebagai Data Engineer atau posisi sejenis di industri teknologi atau perusahaan dengan skala data besar. Memiliki keahlian dalam bahasa mendalam pemrograman seperti Python, Java, atau Scala untuk kebutuhan data engineering. Memiliki kemampuan SQL yang kuat termasuk window function dan optimasi query, perancangan dan pembangunan ETL/ELT. Memahami pemodelan data dimensional dan memiliki kemampuan minimal satu bahasa scripting (diutamakan Python) serta memahami penggunaan version control. Menguasai minimal 1 perangkat BI (Power BI/Tableau/Looker Studio) untuk mendukung pembuatan laporan dan visualisasi data. Memiliki kemampuan untuk mengklarifikasi dan mendokumentasikan defisimi definisi metrik tertulis sebelum melakukan otomatisasi pipeline. Memahami pengaturan hak akses data, retensi serta penanganan data pribadi sesuai dengan (UU No. 27/2022).

jobs.title: Inventory Control Manager
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities Lead and manage Inventory Control activities across multiple operational sites . Develop and implement inventory control strategies, policies, and procedures to ensure effective and consistent inventory management. Monitor and maintain optimal minimum/maximum stock levels, safety stock, and replenishment levels . Ensure product and material availability to support daily catering and camp facility operations. Monitor and control stock-outs, overstock, slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete inventory . Analyze inventory movement and improve inventory turnover and working capital efficiency . Monitor inventory accuracy through regular stock reconciliation, stock taking, cycle counting, and inventory audits . Coordinate with Warehouse/Store teams to ensure accurate receiving, storage, issuance, transfer, and movement of inventory. Coordinate with Procurement to ensure timely replenishment and availability of required materials and supplies. Develop inventory requirements based on operational demand, historical consumption, occupancy/headcount, menu requirements, and business forecasts . Monitor and control inventory value, carrying costs, waste, expiry, and inventory losses . Utilize ERP and BI tools for inventory monitoring, analysis, reporting, and decision-making. Establish and monitor key Inventory KPIs , including stock accuracy, inventory turnover, inventory aging, stock availability, stock variance, inventory value, waste, expiry, and slow/non-moving inventory. Identify inventory risks and implement appropriate mitigation and corrective actions. Lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve inventory accuracy, efficiency, cost effectiveness, and operational performance. Lead, develop, and evaluate the performance of the Inventory Control team. Work closely with Operations, Warehouse/Store, Procurement, Finance, and Project Teams to ensure effective inventory management. Prepare regular inventory performance reports and provide analysis and recommendations to management. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration , or a related field. Minimum 8–10 years of experience in Inventory Control, Inventory Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related functions. Proven experience in a Supervisor or Managerial role , with strong team leadership experience. Strong experience in multi-site operations , preferably within catering, camp facility, hospitality, food service , or similar industries. Hands-on experience managing inventory such as food ingredients, dry goods, fresh/chilled/frozen items, beverages, consumables, cleaning supplies, and general supplies . Good understanding of inventory management in remote site/camp operations , including replenishment, inter-site transfers, stock accuracy, inventory optimization, waste, and expiry control. Experience in mining camp, remote camp, or project-based camp operations will be highly advantageous. Strong knowledge and experience in inventory optimization and inventory control systems . Experience with ERP system implementation, enhancement, or process improvement , particularly in inventory and warehouse management. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and/or BI tools for inventory analysis and reporting. Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, and leadership skills . Strong commercial awareness with a focus on inventory accuracy, cost efficiency, operational effectiveness, and continuous improvement .

jobs.title: Warehouse Supervisor
jobs.description: Lead daily warehouse operations, including team assignments, priorities, and operational execution. Optimize warehouse space, storage utilization, and operational workflows. Monitor warehouse KPIs and align performance with 3PL service-level targets. Manage inventory accuracy through cycle counts, audits, stock level monitoring, and aging reviews. Ensure WMS data accurately reflects physical inventory and warehouse operations. Monitor inventory shrinkage, investigate discrepancies, and drive corrective actions. Ensure warehouse operations meet food handling, quality, safety, and regulatory standards. Manage day-to-day WMS operations and coordinate system troubleshooting and improvements with IT. Oversee 3PL operations, including staffing, resource allocation, SOP adherence, and service performance. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve warehouse efficiency, service quality, and operational costs. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or a related field. Experience in warehouse, logistics, inventory, or supply chain operations, preferably in F&B, FMCG, retail, or a fast-paced environment. Experience managing warehouse teams and/or third-party logistics (3PL) partners. Strong knowledge of inventory management, warehouse processes, and WMS. Good understanding of warehouse quality, food safety, and compliance standards. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills. Strong ownership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced operational environment.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Staff
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan : Menyiapkan dan mengelola dokumen registrasi dan perizinan alat kesehatan (produk baru, perpanjangan dan pembaruan) Melakukan proses registrasi produk alat kesehatan melalui sistem/regulator yang berlaku. Memastikan kelengkapan dan kesesuaian dokumen produk sesuai ketentuan regulasi yang berlaku. Melakukan monitoring status registrasi izin edar termasuk masa berlaku izin edar. Berkoordinasi dengan principal/supplier terkait dokumen dan data teknis yang dibutuhkan untuk proses registrasi. Melakukan komunikasi dan koordinasi dengan pihak internal maupun instansi/regulator. Bertanggung jawab sebagai Apoteker Penanggung Jawab (APJ) perusahaan sesuai ketentuan dan peraturan yang berlaku. Kualifikasi : Pendidikan Min. S1 Profesi Apoteker Memiliki STRA yang aktif Memiliki pengalaman kerja di bidang Regulatory Affairs , khususnya alat kesehatan/medical device min. 1 tahun Bersedia untuk menjadi Apoteker Penanggung Jawab Memahami dasar-dasar regulasi dan proses registrasi alat kesehatan di Indonesia. Teliti, detail-oriented, terorganisir, dan mampu bekerja dengan deadline. Memiliki kemampuan administrasi dan dokumentasi (dapat mengoperasikan Microsoft Office , terutama Word dan Excel) serta memiliki komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Memiliki kemampuan Bahasa Inggris yang baik, terutama dalam membaca dokumen teknis/regulatory. Deskripsi Pekerjaan :

  • Menyiapkan dan mengelola dokumen registrasi dan perizinan alat kesehatan (produk baru, perpanjangan dan pembaruan)

  • Melakukan proses registrasi produk alat kesehatan melalui sistem/regulator yang berlaku.

  • Memastikan kelengkapan dan kesesuaian dokumen produk sesuai ketentuan regulasi yang berlaku.

  • Melakukan monitoring status registrasi izin edar termasuk masa berlaku izin edar.

  • Berkoordinasi dengan principal/supplier terkait dokumen dan data teknis yang dibutuhkan untuk proses registrasi.

  • Melakukan komunikasi dan koordinasi dengan pihak internal maupun instansi/regulator.

  • Bertanggung jawab sebagai Apoteker Penanggung Jawab (APJ) perusahaan sesuai ketentuan dan peraturan yang berlaku.

Kualifikasi :

  • Pendidikan Min. S1 Profesi Apoteker

  • Memiliki STRA yang aktif

  • Memiliki pengalaman kerja di bidang Regulatory Affairs, khususnya alat kesehatan/medical device min. 1 tahun

  • Bersedia untuk menjadi Apoteker Penanggung Jawab

  • Memahami dasar-dasar regulasi dan proses registrasi alat kesehatan di Indonesia.

  • Teliti, detail-oriented, terorganisir, dan mampu bekerja dengan deadline.

  • Memiliki kemampuan administrasi dan dokumentasi (dapat mengoperasikan Microsoft Office, terutama Word dan Excel) serta memiliki komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik.

  • Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.

  • Memiliki kemampuan Bahasa Inggris yang baik, terutama dalam membaca dokumen teknis/regulatory.

jobs.title: Sales Akuisisi EDC - Pekalongan
jobs.description: Kami sedang mencari Sales Canvassing untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Posisi ini cocok untuk kamu yang suka bertemu orang baru, aktif di lapangan, dan tertarik dengan dunia sales. Sebagai Sales Canvassing, kamu akan datang langsung ke toko atau UMKM untuk menawarkan dan memasarkan mesin EDC serta membantu merchant memahami cara penggunaannya. Tanggung Jawab: - Mencari dan mengunjungi UMKM atau merchant secara langsung di area yang sudah ditentukan - Melakukan canvassing/door to door untuk menawarkan mesin EDC - Menjelaskan produk, manfaat, dan cara penggunaan mesin EDC kepada calon merchant - Mengajak merchant untuk menggunakan dan mendaftarkan mesin EDC - Menjaga hubungan baik dengan merchant yang sudah bergabung - Membantu merchant jika mengalami kendala terkait penggunaan produk - Mengejar target penjualan yang sudah ditentukan - Membuat laporan hasil kunjungan dan penjualan Kualifikasi: - Minimal pendidikan SMA/SMK - Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar - Tidak wajib punya pengalaman sales, pengalaman di bidang sales menjadi nilai tambah - Suka bertemu dan berkomunikasi dengan orang baru - Percaya diri untuk menawarkan produk secara langsung - Bersedia bekerja di lapangan dan melakukan kunjungan ke UMKM - Aktif, punya inisiatif, dan tidak mudah menyerah - Terbiasa bekerja dengan target - Bisa bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim Benefit: - Gaji pokok - Allowance pulsa dan transport - BPJS Kesehatan dan Ketenagakerjaan - Training dan kesempatan belajar tentang sales - Kesempatan berkembang dan membangun karier di bidang sales - Lingkungan kerja yang suportif dan kolaboratif Fresh graduate welcome! jobs.title: Data Center Network Engineer
jobs.description: Data Center Network Engineer Role Overview We are looking for a Data Center Network Engineer to support the operation, health, and performance of a high-performance data center network environment. The role will focus on network fabric operations, connectivity, troubleshooting, and performance stability across server, switch, and storage environments. Key Responsibilities Monitor and maintain the health, connectivity, and performance of the data center network fabric. Troubleshoot end-to-end connectivity across server, switch, and storage environments. Perform network health checks, link validation, and performance troubleshooting. Identify and troubleshoot issues related to optics, cabling, ports, VLANs, routing, and network policies. Support switch provisioning, configuration, firmware upgrades, and day-2 network operations. Monitor network traffic, congestion, and overall fabric performance. Perform troubleshooting across Dell, NVIDIA, and third-party network components. Support network performance validation and operational readiness activities. Technical Requirements Strong knowledge of data center Ethernet networking and switching. Experience with large-scale data center network environments. Experience with high-throughput and/or low-latency networking environments. Understanding of network traffic behavior, congestion, and performance tuning. Understanding of lossless Ethernet concepts is preferred. Experience with switch provisioning, firmware lifecycle management, and network monitoring/telemetry. Strong troubleshooting skills across network infrastructure components. Good understanding of server-to-switch and switch-to-storage connectivity. Ideal Background Experience in data center networking . Experience supporting AI/ML or HPC networking environments is preferred. Experience with high-performance Ethernet environments is a plus. Data Center Network Engineer

Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Center Network Engineer to support the operation, health, and performance of a high-performance data center network environment. The role will focus on network fabric operations, connectivity, troubleshooting, and performance stability across server, switch, and storage environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and maintain the health, connectivity, and performance of the data center network fabric.

  • Troubleshoot end-to-end connectivity across server, switch, and storage environments.

  • Perform network health checks, link validation, and performance troubleshooting.

  • Identify and troubleshoot issues related to optics, cabling, ports, VLANs, routing, and network policies.

  • Support switch provisioning, configuration, firmware upgrades, and day-2 network operations.

  • Monitor network traffic, congestion, and overall fabric performance.

  • Perform troubleshooting across Dell, NVIDIA, and third-party network components.

  • Support network performance validation and operational readiness activities.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong knowledge of data center Ethernet networking and switching.

  • Experience with large-scale data center network environments.

  • Experience with high-throughput and/or low-latency networking environments.

  • Understanding of network traffic behavior, congestion, and performance tuning.

  • Understanding of lossless Ethernet concepts is preferred.

  • Experience with switch provisioning, firmware lifecycle management, and network monitoring/telemetry.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across network infrastructure components.

  • Good understanding of server-to-switch and switch-to-storage connectivity.

Ideal Background

  • Experience in data center networking.

  • Experience supporting AI/ML or HPC networking environments is preferred.

  • Experience with high-performance Ethernet environments is a plus.

  • Experience working with multi-vendor network infrastructure is preferred.

jobs.title: Marketing & Bussines Development
jobs.description: Our group spans four distinct businesses, with more to come. We are building a structured, results-driven marketing function to bring our brands together, strengthen their presence, and unlock new opportunities for growth. Lifestyle Capital Club is our premium lifestyle and business hub, featuring padel, a golf simulator, VIP rooms, and premium lounge and dining. Integras is our B2B one-stop printing and packaging business, delivering end-to-end solutions across digital and offset printing — from packaging and paper bags to promotional and commercial materials. We serve businesses across F&B, retail, cosmetics, e-commerce, FMCG, and more. Garage Café operates in F&B, while SLT Autoboutique is our automotive retail arm. Each business has its own audience, character, and commercial opportunity. As part of our Marketing & Business Development team, you'll play a hands-on role in building our brands, creating meaningful market opportunities, developing partnerships, and turning marketing activities into measurable business results. This is a role for someone who enjoys building, executing, testing, and improving — not just making plans. WHAT YOU'LL DO Brand & Positioning • Shape how each brand is positioned and presented across every customer touchpoint. • Maintain consistency in brand identity, messaging, and overall customer experience. Marketing & Communications • Develop and execute marketing campaigns, promotional materials, and brand communications across multiple businesses. • Support partnership proposals, pitch decks, and materials for new business opportunities. Digital Marketing & Content • Manage social media, content, digital campaigns, paid advertising, and other digital channels. • Monitor performance, test ideas, and continuously optimize based on data and results. Business Development & Partnerships • Identify potential business opportunities, partnerships, collaborations, and new customer segments. • Support outreach and relationship-building initiatives that can generate commercial value for the group. Offline Marketing & Activations • Plan and execute events, activations, campaigns, and on-ground initiatives. • Work closely with our internal teams and leverage Integras' in-house production capabilities to bring campaigns to life. Strategic Alignment • Work closely with top management and business-unit teams to ensure marketing activities are aligned with commercial priorities and the group's direction. Performance & Reporting • Set clear objectives and measurable targets for marketing initiatives. • Track performance, analyze results, and provide structured reporting and actionable recommendations to management. WHAT YOU'LL NEED • 2–4 years of hands-on marketing experience, with a proven track record of executing campaigns and initiatives directly. • Comfortable working across digital, offline, content, events, and activations — you're a marketer who enjoys wearing multiple hats. • Strong interest in business development, partnerships, and commercial growth, not just brand awareness. • Experience managing multiple brands, products, or business units is a strong advantage. Agency, startup, or multi-business experience is a plus. • Highly organized and disciplined — you can manage priorities, meet deadlines, and keep reporting structured and consistent. • Builder mindset: excited to create systems, processes, and initiatives from the ground up rather than simply maintaining what already exists. • Able to balance big-picture thinking with hands-on execution and attention to detail. • Comfortable using AI tools, MS Office, and Google Workspace to work smarter and move faster. • Willing to be hands-on and frequently in the field across our different business locations. • Most importantly, we value proven results, ownership, and initiative over formal credentials. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We're looking for someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do. Someone who can look at a business, understand the opportunity, come up with an idea, execute it, measure the result, and make it better. If you enjoy working across different industries, building brands from the ground up, developing new opportunities, and seeing your work directly contribute to business growth — we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Office Girl
jobs.description: Penempatan Bekasi, Cibubur, BSD, Gading Serpong Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab: Menjaga kebersihan area kantor, termasuk ruang kerja, pantry, toilet, dan area umum lainnya. jobs.title: Sales Marketing
jobs.description: Job Responsibilities Develop and execute sales & marketing strategies to increase revenue and customer acquisition. Identify and approach potential clients, corporate accounts, communities, and business partners. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers. Promote 1920 Lounge & Dining through various channels, including social media, partnerships, events, and direct sales. Generate new business opportunities and follow up on potential leads. Coordinate and support promotional campaigns, events, and collaborations. Monitor sales performance and prepare regular sales & marketing reports. Conduct market research and monitor competitors and industry trends. Achieve monthly sales and revenue targets. Collaborate with the operational team to ensure smooth execution of sales initiatives. Requirements Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Sales & Marketing , preferably in hospitality, F&B, lifestyle, or related industries. Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Target-oriented and proactive. Confident in approaching and building relationships with clients. Good understanding of social media and digital marketing. Able to work independently as well as part of a team. Well-organized and able to manage multiple tasks. Professional appearance and strong customer-service mindset. Willing to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays when required.

jobs.title: Shadow Teacher
jobs.description: About the role Kinglory Montessori School is looking for a caring, responsible, and committed Shadow Teacher to support a child in participating meaningfully and independently in our Montessori classroom environment. The Shadow Teacher will work closely with the classroom teachers to provide appropriate support based on the child's individual needs, while gradually encouraging independence, confidence, and participation in the classroom community. Key responsibilities Provide individual support to the assigned child during classroom activities, transitions, outdoor activities, and school routines. Support the child in following classroom routines and participating appropriately in the Montessori environment. Observe the child's needs, behaviour, engagement, and progress, and communicate relevant observations to the classroom teachers. Encourage the child to develop independence rather than becoming overly dependent on adult assistance. Assist the child in accessing and participating in learning activities under the direction of the classroom teacher. Support positive social interactions and communication with peers. Help the child manage transitions, routines, and classroom expectations in a calm and respectful manner. Work collaboratively with the classroom teachers and Learning Coordinator to ensure consistency in supporting the child. Follow the school's Montessori principles, safeguarding policies, classroom procedures, and professional standards. Maintain confidentiality regarding the child and family. About you Minimum Bachelor's degree in Education, Psychology, Special Education, Early Childhood Education, or a related field is preferred. Previous experience working with children is required; experience as a shadow teacher, teaching assistant, learning support assistant, or in an educational setting is an advantage. Patient, calm, empathetic, and able to respond appropriately to children's individual needs. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Able to work collaboratively as part of a teaching team. Willing to learn and apply Montessori principles. Able to maintain professional boundaries and confidentiality. Responsible, reliable, and committed to the child's wellbeing and development. Good English communication skills are an advantage.

jobs.title: Software Developer Lead
jobs.description: Lead and manage the software development team for Syspex automation and technology projects. Lead software development, integration and deployment for AI Camera, machine vision, robotics, AMR, automation and smart factory solutions. Understand customer requirements and translate automation requirements into software/system solutions. Lead integration between machines, robots, AMR, AI cameras, PLC, sensors, MES/WMS/ERP and other systems. Develop or supervise development of AI Camera applications, including camera integration, AI detection, data processing, monitoring and dashboard applications. Lead software architecture, database, API, communication protocols and system integration. Review software design, coding standards, testing, troubleshooting and deployment. Work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Design & Engineering, Project Management and Technical teams. Provide technical direction and mentoring to software team members. Lead PoC, prototype and new technology development for Syspex's automation solutions. Maintain software documentation, source code, system architecture and development standards. Continuously evaluate new technologies in AI, computer vision, IoT, robotics, AMR and industrial software. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, Automation, Electrical Engineering or related field. Minimum 5–8 years of software development experience, with experience leading a software/development team. Proven experience in software architecture, system integration and project delivery. Strong programming knowledge in one or more of: Python, C#, C++, JavaScript/TypeScript. Good understanding of API, REST, database, TCP/IP, MQTT, OPC UA and industrial communication. Understanding of AI, Computer Vision, Machine Vision and AI Camera development/integration. Experience with OpenCV, AI/ML frameworks or edge AI is an advantage. Understanding of PLC, robotics, AMR, IoT and industrial automation. Experience integrating software with robots, AMR, cameras, PLCs, sensors, MES/WMS/ERP or other industrial systems. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Able to review and manage software source code and development practices. Strong leadership, communication and project management skills. Able to work hands-on when required, not only manage the team.

jobs.title: Content Creator
jobs.description: Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal D3/Sederajat, terbuka untuk Fresh Graduate. Usia Maks 28 tahun Aktif mengikuti dan memahami tren media sosial terkini, khususnya Instagram dan TikTok, termasuk Reels, TikTok, trending audio, viral format, hook, dan content trends. Percaya diri tampil di depan kamera, komunikatif, ekspresif, dan tidak canggung saat on-camera. Kreatif, inovatif, memiliki ide out-of-the-box, serta berani mencoba format dan konsep konten baru. Terbiasa menggunakan Instagram & TikTok, termasuk membuat dan mengunggah konten, memahami basic Insight/Analytics, serta melakukan scheduling/posting. Memahami dasar content planning, storytelling, copywriting, caption, hook, dan CTA menjadi nilai tambah. Mampu melakukan basic video editing menggunakan CapCut, Adobe Premiere, VN, atau aplikasi sejenis. Memiliki kemampuan dasar dalam pengambilan foto/video menggunakan smartphone menjadi nilai tambah. Teliti, rapi, dan terorganisir dalam mengelola content calendar, jadwal posting, caption, serta data/performance report. Memiliki inisiatif tinggi, cepat belajar, adaptif terhadap tren, dan mampu bekerja dengan target serta deadline. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim dengan komunikasi yang baik. Memiliki portfolio konten, akun media sosial aktif, atau contoh hasil karya menjadi nilai tambah. Penempatan di Pluit, Jakarta Utara Job Desc : Content Planning: Menyusun ide dan content calendar IG & TikTok, melakukan riset tren, serta mengembangkan konsep konten kreatif dan inovatif. Content Production: Tampil sebagai talent/host, membantu proses shooting, serta melakukan basic editing video menjadi nilai plus. Social Media Management: Mengunggah dan menjadwalkan konten, mengelola komentar/DM, serta memastikan konsistensi caption, hashtag, dan branding. Reporting & Analysis: Membuat laporan performa konten, menganalisis insight IG & TikTok, serta memberikan rekomendasi berdasarkan hasil data.

jobs.title: Staff Accounting
jobs.description: Kualifikasi: Lulusan S1 jurusan Accounting Memiliki pengalaman diposisi Accounting/ Tax minimal 2 tahun. Memiliki Pengalaman Kerja di Industri Manufaktur lebih diutamakan. Memahami prinsip akuntansi dan keuangan serta perpajakan. Teliti, jujur, disiplin, sistematis dalam bekerja dan mampu bekerja sesuai Deadline. Bertanggung jawab, Multitasking , konsisten dan profesional dalam penyelesaian tugas. Mampu bekerjasama dalam team maupun perorangan. Mampu beradaptasi dengan cepat. Bersedia di tempatkan di Gempol – Pasuruan Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Melakukan pelaporan Tax Memastikan laporan-laporan keuangan, neraca, dan laba rugi perusahaan akurat dan terbit tepat waktu. Administrasi & Penjadwalan Mengatur jadwal sesi latihan, mencatat progress klien, dan mengelola data. 9. Menjaga Relasi dengan Klien Membangun hubungan yang baik agar klien merasa nyaman dan loyal.

jobs.title: Travel & Personal Assistant (Private Household, Travel-Led)
jobs.description: We are hiring a Travel and Personal Assistant to support 1–2 principals and their family. Around half the role is travel: not booking a flight and a hotel, but designing and running complex multi-destination trips, redeeming miles and points to pay for them, and rebuilding them when plans change. The remainder is running the personal side of the household — calendar, residence, entertaining, and gifting — largely by coordination. This is an onsite role, with travel to Singapore approximately twice a month, and more often when a project or event requires it. Flights and accommodation for these visits are covered. The Position There will be 6 to 8 travel times per year mixed with personal and work purposes: 3 to 4 long-haul and 3 to 4 short-haul trips. Long-haul trips include one trip up to a month across 4 to 5 destinations. Across the year, the family is away for roughly [60 to 85 days]. The candidate is expected to plan for these trips, but will not be required to travel together on the trips. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of travel planning, including researching destinations, booking accommodations, and creating detailed itineraries. This role requires strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a deep understanding of the travel industry. Indicative split of the workload: Travel: planning, award redemption, contingency design, in-trip changes [50%] Calendar, correspondence, entertaining, and events [20%] Residence, vendors, improvement projects, household coordination [15%] Shopping, gifting, groceries, errands [15%] Responsibilities Travel design and destination knowledge Design multi-destination itineraries of up to a month across continents. Bring real destination knowledge. Know which neighbourhood to stay in, which season to avoid, which restaurants need booking months ahead, and which guide is worth the money. Where you do not know a destination, research it properly and source local expertise rather than relying on aggregator rankings. Source and vet guides, drivers, villa agents, and destination management companies. Verify them before the trip, not after a problem. Build the itinerary around the realities of a long trip: laundry, luggage logistics between cities, working with the medical team to get medication supply for the full duration, connectivity and local mobile data, currency, and rest days. Miles, points, and award redemption Manage the family's frequent flyer and hotel loyalty accounts: balances, expiry dates, status qualification, and transfer partner options across [programmes]. Book award travel as the default where it delivers value. Find saver-level availability, understand which partner space is not visible online and must be booked by phone, and know the routing, stopover, and open-jaw rules of each programme. Calculate value per point before redeeming, factoring in fuel and carrier surcharges, and be able to justify why an award booking beats paying cash, or the reverse. Understand cancellation, redeposit, and change rules on award tickets, which differ by programme and are materially less forgiving than cash fares. Know the cost of changing an award booking before making it. Contingency design and in-trip changes Hold the only authoritative version of every itinerary. When something changes, update the master document and reissue it so the client is never working from a superseded version. Produce a contingency pack for every trip. Each itinerary must be self-supporting: 24-hour direct lines for every airline, hotel, and supplier; the travel insurance assistance number; local emergency numbers. Reconfirm each onward flight, hotel, transfer, and reservation at least 24 hours ahead, during working hours. Handle changes end to end. When one leg moves, hotels, transfers, guides, restaurants, and subsequent flights all need rebuilding. Be available for genuine emergencies outside working hours. Maintain a live travel profile for each family member: passport numbers and expiry, visa status by country, loyalty numbers and tier, seat and room preferences, dietary requirements, medical notes, and insurance details. Manage visas across multi-country itineraries. Track passport validity against six-month entry rules, sequence consular appointments so nothing clashes with a departure date, and escalate early anything that will not clear in time. Arrange travel insurance and know what each policy covers before departure rather than after a claim. Coordinate the Singapore end while the family is away with the helper onsite: pet care, mail, deliveries, contractor access, and household cover. Debrief in writing after each trip: which suppliers underperformed, actual cost against estimate, and what should change next time. Calendar, correspondence, and entertaining Manage the principal's calendar, including time-zone coordination. Act as the first point of contact for vendors, service providers, and the family's professional advisers. Arrange gatherings at the apartment: menu, ordering, staffing, and set-up. Brief the helper on the plan and attend in person for larger events. Arrange larger events through external vendors: caterers, florists, staffing, equipment hire, and venue coordination. Obtain and compare quotations and manage against the agreed budget. This will be a maximum of twice a year. Arrange boat charters and day trips: vessel booking, catering, guest lists, marina transfers, and weather contingency. Manage restaurant reservations, tickets, and guest arrangements at the residence. Residence, vendors, and household coordination Liaise with interior designers, contractors, and suppliers on maintenance and improvement projects. Obtain quotations, schedule access, and check work against specification before approving payment. Attend site walk-throughs and handovers. Manage recurring maintenance: air-conditioning servicing, appliance repairs, pest control, plumbing and electrical, condominium management liaison, and warranty claims. Arrange payments for household maintenance and bills. Health, wellbeing, and pets Liaise with the family's medical team on prescriptions, supplements, and dosing schedules, and ensure the helper has clear, current, written instructions on what is prepared and when. Arrange dog grooming, veterinary appointments, vaccinations, and pet documentation, including pet travel where required. Manage gifting end to end: occasion tracking, sourcing, wrapping, cards, and delivery timing. Maintain a gift log so items are not repeated. Maintain organized digital records: contracts, warranties, insurance policies, service histories, receipts, and travel documents. Manage renewals: memberships, subscriptions, licenses, and vehicle servicing. Handle all personal, financial, and family information with complete discretion. Requirements Proven experience in travel planning, ideally within a luxury or corporate environment. A bachelor's degree in hospitality, Travel Management, or a related field is preferred but not required. In-depth knowledge of global travel destinations, logistics, and industry trends. Strong organizational skills and the ability to multitask effectively. Excellent communication and customer service skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and travel planning software. Ability to work independently, make decisions under pressure, and adapt to last-minute changes. Availability to accommodate urgent travel needs and work outside of standard business hours as required.
