This role requires strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a deep understanding of the travel industry.

Indicative split of the workload:

Travel: planning, award redemption, contingency design, in-trip changes [50%]

Calendar, correspondence, entertaining, and events [20%]

Residence, vendors, improvement projects, household coordination [15%]

Shopping, gifting, groceries, errands [15%]

Responsibilities

Travel design and destination knowledge

  • Design multi-destination itineraries of up to a month across continents.

  • Bring real destination knowledge. Know which neighbourhood to stay in, which season to avoid, which restaurants need booking months ahead, and which guide is worth the money. Where you do not know a destination, research it properly and source local expertise rather than relying on aggregator rankings.

  • Source and vet guides, drivers, villa agents, and destination management companies. Verify them before the trip, not after a problem.

  • Build the itinerary around the realities of a long trip: laundry, luggage logistics between cities, working with the medical team to get medication supply for the full duration, connectivity and local mobile data, currency, and rest days.

Miles, points, and award redemption

  • Manage the family's frequent flyer and hotel loyalty accounts: balances, expiry dates, status qualification, and transfer partner options across [programmes].

  • Book award travel as the default where it delivers value. Find saver-level availability, understand which partner space is not visible online and must be booked by phone, and know the routing, stopover, and open-jaw rules of each programme.

  • Calculate value per point before redeeming, factoring in fuel and carrier surcharges, and be able to justify why an award booking beats paying cash, or the reverse.

  • Understand cancellation, redeposit, and change rules on award tickets, which differ by programme and are materially less forgiving than cash fares. Know the cost of changing an award booking before making it.

Contingency design and in-trip changes

  • Hold the only authoritative version of every itinerary. When something changes, update the master document and reissue it so the client is never working from a superseded version.

  • Produce a contingency pack for every trip. Each itinerary must be self-supporting: 24-hour direct lines for every airline, hotel, and supplier; the travel insurance assistance number; local emergency numbers.

  • Reconfirm each onward flight, hotel, transfer, and reservation at least 24 hours ahead, during working hours.

  • Handle changes end to end. When one leg moves, hotels, transfers, guides, restaurants, and subsequent flights all need rebuilding.

  • Be available for genuine emergencies outside working hours.

  • Maintain a live travel profile for each family member: passport numbers and expiry, visa status by country, loyalty numbers and tier, seat and room preferences, dietary requirements, medical notes, and insurance details.

  • Manage visas across multi-country itineraries. Track passport validity against six-month entry rules, sequence consular appointments so nothing clashes with a departure date, and escalate early anything that will not clear in time.

  • Arrange travel insurance and know what each policy covers before departure rather than after a claim.

  • Coordinate the Singapore end while the family is away with the helper onsite: pet care, mail, deliveries, contractor access, and household cover.

  • Debrief in writing after each trip: which suppliers underperformed, actual cost against estimate, and what should change next time.

Calendar, correspondence, and entertaining

  • Manage the principal's calendar, including time-zone coordination.

  • Act as the first point of contact for vendors, service providers, and the family's professional advisers.

  • Arrange gatherings at the apartment: menu, ordering, staffing, and set-up. Brief the helper on the plan and attend in person for larger events.

  • Arrange larger events through external vendors: caterers, florists, staffing, equipment hire, and venue coordination. Obtain and compare quotations and manage against the agreed budget. This will be a maximum of twice a year.

  • Arrange boat charters and day trips: vessel booking, catering, guest lists, marina transfers, and weather contingency.

  • Manage restaurant reservations, tickets, and guest arrangements at the residence.

Residence, vendors, and household coordination

  • Liaise with interior designers, contractors, and suppliers on maintenance and improvement projects. Obtain quotations, schedule access, and check work against specification before approving payment. Attend site walk-throughs and handovers.

  • Manage recurring maintenance: air-conditioning servicing, appliance repairs, pest control, plumbing and electrical, condominium management liaison, and warranty claims.

  • Arrange payments for household maintenance and bills.

Health, wellbeing, and pets

  • Liaise with the family's medical team on prescriptions, supplements, and dosing schedules, and ensure the helper has clear, current, written instructions on what is prepared and when.

  • Arrange dog grooming, veterinary appointments, vaccinations, and pet documentation, including pet travel where required.

  • Manage gifting end to end: occasion tracking, sourcing, wrapping, cards, and delivery timing. Maintain a gift log so items are not repeated.

  • Maintain organized digital records: contracts, warranties, insurance policies, service histories, receipts, and travel documents.

  • Manage renewals: memberships, subscriptions, licenses, and vehicle servicing.

  • Handle all personal, financial, and family information with complete discretion.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in travel planning, ideally within a luxury or corporate environment.

  • A bachelor's degree in hospitality, Travel Management, or a related field is preferred but not required.

  • In-depth knowledge of global travel destinations, logistics, and industry trends.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to multitask effectively.

  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and travel planning software.

  • Ability to work independently, make decisions under pressure, and adapt to last-minute changes.

  • Availability to accommodate urgent travel needs and work outside of standard business hours as required.

jobs.title: Senior UX Researcher
jobs.description: About this Position: We're looking for a Senior UX Researcher with strong research expertise, sharp product thinking, and a passion for turning user insights into meaningful product and business impact. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working across qualitative and quantitative methods, and influencing product decisions through research, we'd love to meet you. Why this role is interesting At Astro, research lives close to real decisions. The problems are fast-moving and often shaped by user behavior, business needs and operational realities. In this role, you will help teams untangle complexity and turn them into a clear product direction. You will have the space to challenge assumptions, bring clarity to ambiguity, and make research useful beyond the final deck. Job Description: As our Astronaut, your missions are: Own and lead end-to-end UX research projects, from problem framing and research planning to execution, synthesis, and actionable recommendations. Partner with Product Managers, Designers, Data teams, Operations, and other stakeholders to identify and prioritize high-impact research opportunities. Translate ambiguous product and business problems into clear research objectives, hypotheses, and research questions. Design and conduct qualitative and quantitative research, including user interviews, usability testing, surveys, journey mapping, segmentation, and behavioral research. Analyze and synthesize findings across multiple data sources to uncover meaningful user behaviors, needs, pain points, and opportunities. Translate research findings into clear, actionable recommendations that inform product strategy, design decisions, prioritization, and business outcomes. Communicate research findings through compelling storytelling and presentations tailored to different audiences, including senior stakeholders. Use product metrics and behavioral data to complement user research and build a holistic understanding of users. Proactively identify opportunities where research can create meaningful impact, while challenging assumptions and ensuring we are solving the right problems.

jobs.title: Business Development Officer
jobs.description: Responsibilities : Membangun hubungan strategis dengan business owner dan decision maker di industri reklame, tekstil, dan industri kreatif lainnya, bukan sekadar transaksi jual-beli. Memahami tantangan usaha klien secara mendalam: target market, kapasitas produksi, dan pola pembelian, untuk memberikan solusi yang relevan. Aktif mencari peluang baru melalui riset market dan kunjungan lapangan/kanvas ke calon klien potensial. Menyampaikan value dari solusi Laysander (bukan sekadar fitur produk) sesuai kebutuhan nyata klien, termasuk konsultasi bisnis, audit kebutuhan, dan after-sales service. Mengelola dan membina lead melalui sistem Laysander, memastikan setiap prospect ditindaklanjuti secara konsisten sampai closing dan retensi jangka panjang. Berkolaborasi dengan tim internal (marketing, teknis, engineer) maupun mitra eksternal untuk memastikan setiap komitmen ke klien terpenuhi. Menjadi trusted advisor bagi klien, membantu mereka bertumbuh, bukan hanya menjual produk. Jika Anda tidak hanya mencari pekerjaan, tetapi juga ingin bertumbuh bersama perusahaan dan dalam hidup, kirimkan CV terbaru Anda sekarang. Semua CV akan diperlakukan secara rahasia, dan hanya kandidat yang lolos seleksi awal yang akan dihubungi.

jobs.title: FIELD COLLECTION - ADIRA FINANCE (CAB. TEBET & KELAPA GADING)
jobs.description: Collection Adira Finance adalah bagian divisi di PT Adira Dinamika Multifinance, Tbk yang bertugas mengelola, menagih, dan mengamankan angsuran atau unit objek pembiayaan (mobil/motor) dari nasabah yang mengalami keterlambatan pembayaran (overdue). Mereka berfungsi sebagai penagih lapangan (field collection) atau via telepon (desk collection) untuk memastikan target penagihan tercapai. Prosple Indonesia Prosple Indonesia. Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Collection Adira Finance: Penagihan (Collection): Menghubungi nasabah yang menunggak melalui telepon atau kunjungan langsung (field visit) untuk melakukan penagihan angsuran. Penarikan Unit: Melakukan penarikan unit objek pembiayaan jika nasabah tidak mampu melunasi tunggakan setelah diberikan surat peringatan (somasi). Negosiasi & Solusi: Menawarkan program restrukturisasi atau penstrukturan kembali kredit (Rehab) kepada nasabah yang mengalami kesulitan pembayaran. Administrasi: Membuat laporan harian kunjungan, melakukan survei, dan menyerahkan uang hasil penagihan atau unit tarikan ke pihak warehouse. Jenis Collection: Field Collection: Petugas lapangan yang melakukan kunjungan langsung ke rumah atau kantor nasabah. Desk Collection: Petugas yang mengingatkan nasabah via telepon atau media komunikasi lainnya sebelum jatuh tempo atau saat overdue. Posisi ini biasanya diisi oleh karyawan yang memiliki kemampuan negosiasi, komunikasi yang baik, serta memahami area kerja.
